Chal.EditApproximation.almostLinearEditDistanceRawBand : ∀ (epsilon : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction),
  0 < epsilon.value →
    epsilon.value < 1 →
      (∀ (source target : List ℤ) (N : ℕ),
          source.length + target.length ≤ N →
            2 / 3 ≤
              (Chal.EditApproximation.computedFullLaw (List.map Chal.EditApproximation.integerSymbolCode source)
                    (List.map Chal.EditApproximation.integerSymbolCode target) N epsilon).real
                {outcome |
                  Chal.EditDistortion.edit source target ≤
                      Chal.EditApproximation.integerBinaryAnswerRawBand source target N epsilon outcome ∧
                    ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.integerBinaryAnswerRawBand source target N epsilon outcome) ≤
                      (1 + ↑epsilon.value) * ↑(Chal.EditDistortion.edit source target)}) ∧
        (∀ (source target : List ℤ) (N : ℕ),
            source = target →
              ∀
                (outcome :
                  Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFullOutcome (List.map Chal.EditApproximation.integerSymbolCode source)
                    (List.map Chal.EditApproximation.integerSymbolCode target) N),
                Chal.EditApproximation.integerBinaryAnswerRawBand source target N epsilon outcome = 0) ∧
          (∀ (C : ℕ) (eta : ℝ),
              0 < eta →
                ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                  ∀ (source target : List ℤ),
                    source.length + target.length ≤ N →
                      (∀ z ∈ source ++ target, z.natAbs ≤ (N + 2) ^ C) →
                        ∫ (outcome :
                            Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFullOutcome
                              (List.map Chal.EditApproximation.integerSymbolCode source)
                              (List.map Chal.EditApproximation.integerSymbolCode target) N),
                            Chal.EditApproximation.integerBinaryWorkRawBand source target N epsilon
                              outcome ∂Chal.EditApproximation.computedFullLaw
                              (List.map Chal.EditApproximation.integerSymbolCode source)
                              (List.map Chal.EditApproximation.integerSymbolCode target) N epsilon ≤
                          (↑N + 2) ^ (1 + eta)) ∧
            ∀ (C : ℕ),
              ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                ∀ (source target : List ℤ),
                  source.length + target.length ≤ N →
                    (∀ z ∈ source ++ target, z.natAbs ≤ (N + 2) ^ C) →
                      ∀
                        (outcome :
                          Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFullOutcome
                            (List.map Chal.EditApproximation.integerSymbolCode source)
                            (List.map Chal.EditApproximation.integerSymbolCode target) N),
                        Chal.EditApproximation.integerBinarySpaceFootprintRawBand source target N epsilon outcome ≤
                          (N + 2) ^ (C + 65564)
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue : List Bool → ℕ :=
fun x => List.brecOn x Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue._f
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitSum : Bool → Bool → Bool → Bool :=
fun a b carry => a ^^ b ^^ carry
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitCarry : Bool → Bool → Bool → Bool :=
fun a b carry => a && b || a && carry || b && carry
structure Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational : Type
number of parameters: 0
fields:
  Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.num : ℤ
  Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.den : ℕ
  Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.den_pos : 0 < self.den
constructor:
  Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.mk (num : ℤ) (den : ℕ) (den_pos : 0 < den) :
    Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational
def Chal.EditApproximation.orderingMatches : Ordering → ℕ → ℕ → Prop :=
fun o a b => o = Ordering.lt ∧ a < b ∨ o = Ordering.eq ∧ a = b ∨ o = Ordering.gt ∧ b < a
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitOrdering : Ordering → Bool → Bool → Ordering :=
fun high a b =>
  match high with
  | Ordering.lt => Ordering.lt
  | Ordering.gt => Ordering.gt
  | Ordering.eq => if a = b then Ordering.eq else if a = true then Ordering.gt else Ordering.lt
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitDifference : Bool → Bool → Bool → Bool :=
fun a b borrow => a ^^ b ^^ borrow
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitBorrow : Bool → Bool → Bool → Bool :=
fun a b borrow => !a && (b || borrow) || b && borrow
structure Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary : Type
number of parameters: 0
fields:
  Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.negative : Bool
  Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.bits : List Bool
constructor:
  Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.mk (negative : Bool) (bits : List Bool) : Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary
def Chal.EditApproximation.signedMagnitude : Bool → ℕ → ℤ :=
fun negative magnitude => if negative = true then -↑magnitude else ↑magnitude
def Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordWithWork : List Bool → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun x => List.brecOn x Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordWithWork._f
def Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCut : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun lo width M i => lo + i * width / M
def Chal.EditApproximation.gridRound : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun spacing position => spacing * (position / spacing)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalMinimum : ℚ → List ℚ → ℚ :=
fun fallback x => List.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalMinimum._f fallback)
structure Chal.EditApproximation.RationalBellmanAction.{u_1, u_2} (Parent : Type u_1) (Child : Type u_2) (M : ℕ) :

    (center : Parent) (connection : ℚ) (childState : Fin M → Child) :
    Chal.EditApproximation.RationalBellmanAction Parent Child M
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalRefinementUpdate : ℚ → ℚ → Option ℚ → ℚ :=
fun δ cone x =>
  match x with
  | none => cone
  | some online => min cone (max (cone / (1 + δ)) online)
def Chal.EditApproximation.heightExponent : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun N => Nat.clog 2 (Nat.clog 2 (N + 2))
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseExponent : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun ell => (Nat.log 2 ell).sqrt.sqrt

def Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsBetween : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → List ℕ :=
fun g lo hi => List.map (fun i => g * i) (List.range' (lo ⌈/⌉ g) (hi / g + 1 - lo ⌈/⌉ g))

fun U a gap => max ↑⌈↑U / a⌉₊ |gap|

fun b P => max 1 (b / P)

def Chal.EditApproximation.cellGridPoints : ℚ → ℕ → ℕ → List ℕ :=
fun side g cell =>
  List.map (fun i => g * i) (List.range' ⌈↑cell * side / ↑g⌉₊ (⌈(↑cell + 1) * side / ↑g⌉₊ - ⌈↑cell * side / ↑g⌉₊))

fun exponent h => ⌈max 1 (2 ^ (-↑exponent) * h)⌉₊

def Chal.EditApproximation.localCellCoordinates : ℚ → ℕ → ℕ → List ℕ :=
fun side p radius =>
  have first := ⌊↑(p - radius) / side⌋₊;
  have last := ⌊↑(p + radius) / side⌋₊;
  List.range' first (last + 1 - first)

@[irreducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.inputBitLengthWithWork : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
WellFounded.Nat.fix (fun x => x) fun n a =>
  if h : n = 0 then (0, 1)
  else
    let tail := a (n / 2) ⋯;
    (tail.1 + 1, tail.2 + 2)

fun a b => if a < b then (b * b + a, 4) else (a * a + a + b, 5)

def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalActionValue.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (Parent → Parent → ℚ) →
        ℚ → (Child → ℚ) → Parent → Chal.EditApproximation.RationalBellmanAction Parent Child M → ℚ :=
fun {Parent} {Child} {M} distance L child query action =>
  L * distance query action.center + action.connection + ∑ i, child (action.childState i)

    tau := 1 / ↑ell ^ 4, theta := 1 / ↑ell ^ 40, gamma := 1 / ↑ell ^ 20, eta := ↑ell ^ 5 }

def Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScalesWithWork : ℕ → List ℕ × ℕ :=
fun N =>
  have count := max 1 N.bits.length;
  have values :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (fun e =>
        have word := Chal.EditApproximation.powerTwoWord e;
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue word, e + 3))
      (List.range count);
  (values.1, values.2 + N.bits.length + count + 2)

def Chal.EditApproximation.dpSingleton.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq α] → α → List α → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {α} [DecidableEq α] a word =>
  if word = [] then (1, 1)
  else
    have count := Chal.EditApproximation.dpLength word;
    have found := Chal.EditApproximation.dpMember a word;
    (count.1 - if found.1 = true then 1 else 0, count.2 + found.2 + 2)

def Chal.EditApproximation.integerInputInspectionWithWork : List ℤ → List ℤ → (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ :=
fun source target =>
  have left := Chal.EditApproximation.integerMagnitudeWithWork source;
  have right := Chal.EditApproximation.integerMagnitudeWithWork target;
  have lengths := (Chal.EditApproximation.dpLength source, Chal.EditApproximation.dpLength target);
  have symbols := Chal.EditApproximation.inputBitLengthWithWork (2 * max left.1 right.1);
  have positions := Chal.EditApproximation.inputBitLengthWithWork lengths.2.1;
  ((symbols.1, positions.1), left.2 + right.2 + lengths.1.2 + lengths.2.2 + symbols.2 + positions.2 + 4)

def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalBellman.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (Parent → ℚ) →
        (Parent → Parent → ℚ) →
          ℚ → List (Chal.EditApproximation.RationalBellmanAction Parent Child M) → (Child → ℚ) → Parent → ℚ :=

  Chal.EditApproximation.rationalMinimum (fallback query)

def Chal.EditApproximation.dpCandidate.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq α] → α → List α → List ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {α} [DecidableEq α] a target previous j k =>
  have suffix := Chal.EditApproximation.dpDrop j target;
  have piece := Chal.EditApproximation.dpTake k suffix.1;
  have one := Chal.EditApproximation.dpSingleton a piece.1;
  have old := Chal.EditApproximation.dpGetD previous (j + k);
  (one.1 + old.1, suffix.2 + piece.2 + one.2 + old.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.dpCellAllocation.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → List α → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun {α} target j =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.dpCandidateAllocation target j 0 +
      (List.map (Chal.EditApproximation.dpCandidateAllocation target j) (List.range (target.length - j + 1))).sum +
    4 * (target.length - j + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.initialThresholdQ : ℕ → ℚ :=
fun N => ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N) ^ 4
def Chal.EditApproximation.initialLambda : ℕ → ℚ :=
fun N => 1 / (64 * ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N))

def Chal.EditApproximation.inspectAccuracyWithWork : ℕ →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Option Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun budget epsilon =>
  have numerator := Chal.EditApproximation.inspectBitPrefix budget epsilon.numerator.bits;
  have denominator := Chal.EditApproximation.inspectBitPrefix budget epsilon.denominator;
  (if (numerator.1 && denominator.1) = true then some epsilon else none, numerator.2 + denominator.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddAllocation : List Bool → List Bool → Bool → ℕ :=
fun left right carry =>
  List.brecOn (motive := fun left => List Bool → Bool → ℕ) left Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddAllocation._f right carry
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitSubtractAllocation : List Bool → List Bool → Bool → ℕ :=
fun left right borrow =>
  List.brecOn (motive := fun left => List Bool → Bool → ℕ) left Chal.EditApproximation.bitSubtractAllocation._f right
    borrow
def Chal.EditApproximation.materializedAssignmentsAllocation.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → (M : ℕ) → (Fin M → List α) → ℕ :=
fun {α} x x_1 =>
  Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x => (Fin x → List α) → ℕ) x Chal.EditApproximation.materializedAssignmentsAllocation._f x_1
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryEraseAllocation.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (α → α → Bool × ℕ) → (α → α → ℕ) → List α → ℕ :=
fun {α} equal allocation xs => Chal.EditApproximation.queryEraseLoopAllocation equal allocation xs []
def Chal.EditApproximation.querySortAllocation.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → (α → α → Bool × ℕ) → (α → α → ℕ) → List α → ℕ :=
fun {α} le allocation x => List.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.querySortAllocation._f le allocation)
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun a b => Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddWithWork a.bits b.bits false
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun x x_1 => List.brecOn (motive := fun x => List Bool → List Bool × ℕ) x Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork._f x_1
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → Ordering × ℕ :=
fun a b => Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork a.bits b.bits
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalSubtractWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.bitSubtractWithWork a.bits b.bits false;
  (result.1, result.2.2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters : ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.IntegerParameters :=
fun N =>
  have H := Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N;
  have ell := Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N;
  have p := Chal.EditApproximation.coarseExponent ell;
  { H := H, ell := ell, p := p, B := H ^ p, initialFactor := H ^ (p + 4),
    M := 2 ^ (Chal.EditApproximation.heightExponent N / 20), P := H ^ (p + 20),
    T := 2 ^ ((3 * Chal.EditApproximation.heightExponent N + 3) / 4), S := H / ell ^ 2 }
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModWithWork : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool × List Bool × ℕ :=
fun divisor x => List.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModWithWork._f divisor)
def Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork : List Bool → List Bool → Bool × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  have compared := Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork b a;
  (!decide (compared.1 = Ordering.lt), compared.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedInitialExponent : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun N =>
  (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseExponent (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N) + 4) *
    Chal.EditApproximation.heightExponent N
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryOrderedInputsWithWork.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (α → α → Bool × ℕ) → (α → α → Bool × ℕ) → List α → List α × ℕ :=
fun {α} equal le xs =>
  have unique := Chal.EditApproximation.queryEraseWithWork equal xs;
  have sorted := Chal.EditApproximation.querySortWithWork le unique.1;
  (sorted.1, unique.2 + sorted.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryActionInputsWithWork.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} → {M : ℕ} → List (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M) → List Child × ℕ :=
fun {Parent} {Child} {M} actions =>
  have inputs :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
      (fun action => Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun i => (action.childState i, 1)) (List.finRange M))
      actions;
  (inputs.1, inputs.2 + M + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.largeAccuracyInput : ℕ → ℚ → Prop :=
fun N epsilon =>
  2 ^ 1000 ≤ Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N ∧ 10 ≤ ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N) * epsilon
def Chal.EditApproximation.dpCell.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq α] → α → List α → List ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {α} [DecidableEq α] a target previous j =>
  have fallback := Chal.EditApproximation.dpCandidate a target previous j 0;
  have candidates :=
    List.map (Chal.EditApproximation.dpCandidate a target previous j) (List.range (target.length - j + 1));
  have minimum := Chal.EditApproximation.dpMinimum fallback.1 (List.map Prod.fst candidates);
  (minimum.1,
    fallback.2 + (List.map Prod.snd candidates).sum + minimum.2 + (Chal.EditApproximation.dpLength target).2 +
        3 * candidates.length +
      4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.suffixDPAllocation.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → List α → List α → ℕ :=
fun {α} x x_1 => List.brecOn (motive := fun x => List α → ℕ) x Chal.EditApproximation.suffixDPAllocation._f x_1
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun a b => Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddAllocation a.bits b.bits false
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryOrderedInputsAllocation.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (α → α → Bool × ℕ) → (α → α → Bool × ℕ) → (α → α → ℕ) → (α → α → ℕ) → List α → ℕ :=
fun {α} equal le equalAllocation leAllocation xs =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.queryEraseAllocation equal equalAllocation xs +
    Chal.EditApproximation.querySortAllocation le leAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.queryEraseWithWork equal xs).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryActionInputsAllocation.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} → {M : ℕ} → List (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M) → ℕ :=
fun {Parent} {Child} {M} actions =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation
    (fun action => Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun i => (action.childState i, 1)) (List.finRange M))
    (fun x => Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun x => 1) (List.finRange M) + M) actions
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun a b => Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork a.bits b.bits
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool × List Bool × ℕ :=
fun n d => Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModWithWork d.bits n.bits
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitCeilDivWithWork : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun divisor bits =>
  have divided := Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModWithWork divisor bits;
  have zeroCheck := Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork divided.2.1 [];
  if zeroCheck.1 = Ordering.eq then (divided.1, divided.2.2 + zeroCheck.2 + 3)
  else
    have rounded := Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddWithWork divided.1 [true] false;
    (rounded.1, divided.2.2 + zeroCheck.2 + rounded.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.wordMinWithWork : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  have compared := Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork a b;
  (if compared.1 = true then a else b, compared.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.wordInsertWithWork : List Bool → List (List Bool) → List (List Bool) × ℕ :=
fun a x => List.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.wordInsertWithWork._f a)
def Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  have test := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork a b;
  if test.1 = Ordering.lt then ([], test.2 + 1)
  else
    have result := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalSubtractWithWork a b;
    (result.1, test.2 + result.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedPassCount : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun N =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicSeedPassCount (Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N)
    (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedInitialExponent N)
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork : List Bool → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun base x => Nat.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork._f base)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryEncodedLEWithWork.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → (α → ℕ × ℕ) → α → α → Bool × ℕ :=
fun {α} code a b =>
  have left := code a;
  have right := code b;
  have comparison := Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork left.1.bits right.1.bits;
  (comparison.1, left.2 + right.2 + comparison.2 + left.1.size + right.1.size + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSuffixDP.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq α] → List α → List α → List ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {α} [DecidableEq α] x x_1 =>
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => List α → List ℕ × ℕ) x Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSuffixDP._f x_1
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedCoarseDepth : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun N n => Nat.clog (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).B (max 1 n)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryRangeValidWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → Bool × ℕ :=
fun B range =>
  have positive := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork 0 range;
  have bounded := Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork range.bits B.bits;
  (decide (positive.1 = Ordering.lt) && bounded.1, positive.2 + bounded.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarsePaddedReadWithWork.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → ℕ → List α → ℕ → Option (Option α) × ℕ :=
fun {α} n source offset =>
  have inside := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork offset n;
  (if inside.1 = Ordering.lt then some source[offset]? else none, inside.2 + n.size + offset.size + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseRangeCopyWithWork : (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → List ℕ × ℕ :=
fun read x x_1 =>
  Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x => ℕ → List ℕ × ℕ) x_1 (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseRangeCopyWithWork._f read) x
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulAllocation : List Bool → List Bool → ℕ :=
fun x x_1 => List.brecOn (motive := fun x => List Bool → ℕ) x Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulAllocation._f x_1
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModAllocation : List Bool → List Bool → ℕ :=
fun divisor x => List.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModAllocation._f divisor)
def Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  a.bits.length + b.bits.length +
    if (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork a b).1 = Ordering.lt then 0
    else Chal.EditApproximation.bitSubtractAllocation a.bits b.bits false
def Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun n lo hi =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.naturalWordLEAllocation lo.bits hi.bits +
      Chal.EditApproximation.naturalWordLEAllocation hi.bits n.bits +
    if
        ((Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork lo.bits hi.bits).1 &&
            (Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork hi.bits n.bits).1) =
          true then
      2
    else 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.translatedEndpointAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun reference root endpoint =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.bitSubtractAllocation endpoint.bits root.bits false +
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation reference
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalSubtractWithWork endpoint root).1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.wordInsertAllocation : List Bool → List (List Bool) → ℕ :=
fun a x => List.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.wordInsertAllocation._f a)
def Chal.EditApproximation.wordSortWithWork : List (List Bool) → List (List Bool) × ℕ :=
fun x => List.brecOn x Chal.EditApproximation.wordSortWithWork._f
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryGridRoundWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun spacing position =>
  have quotient := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork position spacing;
  have rounded := Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork spacing.bits quotient.1;
  (rounded.1, quotient.2.2 + rounded.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → List ℕ × ℕ :=
fun g lo hi =>
  have lower := Chal.EditApproximation.bitCeilDivWithWork g.bits lo.bits;
  have upper := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork hi g;
  have stop := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue upper.1) 1;
  have count :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue stop.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower.1);
  have indices :=
    List.range' (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower.1) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue count.1);
  have points :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (fun i =>
        have product := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork g i;
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue product.1, product.2 + i.size + 2))
      indices;
  (points.1, lower.2 + upper.2.2 + stop.2 + count.2 + points.2 + g.size + lo.size + hi.size + 5)
def Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun b P =>
  have quotient := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork b P;
  have test := Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork quotient.1 [true];
  (if test.1 = true then [true] else quotient.1, quotient.2.2 + test.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCutWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun lo width M i =>
  have product := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork i width;
  have quotient := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue product.1) M;
  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue quotient.1);
  (result.1, product.2 + quotient.2.2 + result.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.triangularMassWithWork : ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun K =>
  have next := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork K 1;
  have product := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork K (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue next.1);
  have quotient := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue product.1) 2;
  (quotient.1, next.2 + product.2 + quotient.2.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.refinementBaseWithWork : List Bool → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun ell =>
  have power := Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork ell 10;
  have increment := Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddWithWork power.1 [true] false;
  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordWithWork increment.1;
  (result.1, power.2 + increment.2 + result.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryPairWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  have test := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork a b;
  if test.1 = Ordering.lt then
    have square := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork b b;
    have result := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue square.1) a;
    (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue result.1, test.2 + square.2 + result.2 + 3)
  else
    have square := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork a a;
    have linear := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue square.1) a;
    have result := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue linear.1) b;
    (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue result.1, test.2 + square.2 + linear.2 + result.2 + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryCellValidWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ → Bool × ℕ :=
fun n exponent cell =>
  have cap :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork n
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.powerTwoWord exponent));
  have left := Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork cell.1.bits cap.1;
  have right := Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork cell.2.bits cap.1;
  (left.1 && right.1, cap.2 + left.2 + right.2 + exponent + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork : (bound : ℕ) → ℕ → 0 < bound → Fin bound × ℕ :=
fun bound value hb =>
  have proof_bitOrdering_matches_4 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_matches_5 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_lt_16 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitSubtractor_value_17 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_8;
  have proof_bitSubtractionRippleEquation_18 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitSubtractWithWork_value_19 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitWordValue_lt_pow_length_20 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitSubtractWithWork_length_21 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_16;
  have proof_bitSubtractWithWork_sub_22 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitDivModWithWork_value_23 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitWordValue_bits_15 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_19;
  have proof_binaryNaturalDivModWithWork_spec_24 := ⋯;
  let result := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork value bound;
  (⟨Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue result.2.1, ⋯⟩, result.2.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseDenominatorWithWork : List Bool →
  List Bool → List Bool → List Bool → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun allowanceDen q L branching D =>
  have first := Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork L branching;
  have base := Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork first.1 q;
  have trimmedBase := Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordWithWork base.1;
  have power := Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork trimmedBase.1 D;
  have initial := Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork allowanceDen q;
  have product := Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork initial.1 power.1;
  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordWithWork product.1;
  (result.1, first.2 + base.2 + trimmedBase.2 + power.2 + initial.2 + product.2 + result.2 + 7)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseFramedReadWithWork.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  ℕ → ℕ → List α → ℕ → Option (Option α) × ℕ :=
fun {α} k n word i =>
  have lower := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork i k;
  if lower.1 = Ordering.lt then (none, lower.2 + k.size + n.size + i.size + 2)
  else
    have finish := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork k n;
    have upper := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork i (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue finish.1);
    if upper.1 = Ordering.lt then
      have offset := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork i k;
      (some word[Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue offset.1]?,
        lower.2 + finish.2 + upper.2 + offset.2 + k.size + n.size + i.size + 4)
    else (none, lower.2 + finish.2 + upper.2 + k.size + n.size + i.size + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseDescriptorWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun B d n start =>
  have capacity := Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork B.bits d;
  have remaining := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork n start;
  have clipped := Chal.EditApproximation.wordMinWithWork capacity.1 remaining.1;
  (clipped.1, capacity.2 + remaining.2 + clipped.2 + B.size + d.size + n.size + start.size + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseChildOffsetWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun offset capacity index =>
  have displacement := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork index capacity;
  have result :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork offset (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue displacement.1);
  (result.1, displacement.2 + result.2 + index.size + capacity.size + offset.size + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseInputGuardWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Bool × ℕ :=
fun sourceLo sourceHi targetLo targetHi =>
  have sourceWidth := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork sourceHi sourceLo;
  have targetWidth := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork targetHi targetLo;
  have twice := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork 2 (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue sourceWidth.1);
  have compared :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue twice.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue targetWidth.1);
  (decide (compared.1 = Ordering.lt), sourceWidth.2 + targetWidth.2 + twice.2 + compared.2 + 6)
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerAllocation : List Bool → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun base x => Nat.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerAllocation._f base)
def Chal.EditApproximation.bitCeilDivAllocation : List Bool → List Bool → ℕ :=
fun divisor bits =>
  have divided := Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModWithWork divisor bits;
  Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModAllocation divisor bits +
    if (Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork divided.2.1 []).1 = Ordering.eq then 0
    else 1 + Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddAllocation divided.1 [true] false
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun a b => Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulAllocation a.bits b.bits
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun a b => Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModAllocation b.bits a.bits
def Chal.EditApproximation.triangularMassAllocation : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun K =>
  have next := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork K 1).1;
  have product := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork K (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue next)).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddAllocation K.bits (Nat.bits 1) false +
      Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulAllocation K.bits (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue next).bits +
    Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModAllocation (Nat.bits 2) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue product).bits
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryIntervalRoundWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → (List Bool × List Bool) × ℕ :=
fun spacing lo hi =>
  have left := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryGridRoundWithWork spacing lo;
  have right := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryGridRoundWithWork spacing hi;
  ((left.1, right.1), left.2 + right.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedQueryBase : ℕ → List Bool :=
fun N => (Chal.EditApproximation.refinementBaseWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N).bits).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarsePreparedSlicesWithWork : List ℕ →
  List ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Option (List ℕ × List ℕ) × ℕ :=
fun source target sourceLo sourceHi targetLo targetHi =>
  have guard := Chal.EditApproximation.coarseInputGuardWithWork sourceLo sourceHi targetLo targetHi;
  if guard.1 = true then (none, guard.2)
  else
    have copiedSource :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.coarseRangeCopyWithWork (fun i => source[i]?.getD 0) sourceLo (sourceHi - sourceLo);
    have copiedTarget :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.coarseRangeCopyWithWork (fun i => target[i]?.getD 0) targetLo (targetHi - targetLo);
    (some (copiedSource.1, copiedTarget.1), guard.2 + copiedSource.2 + copiedTarget.2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun g lo hi =>
  have lower := (Chal.EditApproximation.bitCeilDivWithWork g.bits lo.bits).1;
  have upper := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork hi g).1;
  have stop := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue upper) 1).1;
  have count :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue stop)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower)).1;
  have indices := List.range' (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue count);
  Chal.EditApproximation.bitCeilDivAllocation g.bits lo.bits + Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivAllocation hi g +
          Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue upper) 1 +
        Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue stop)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower) +
      indices.length +
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun i => Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation g i)
      indices
def Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCutAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun lo width M i =>
  have product := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork i width).1;
  have quotient :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue product) M).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation i width +
      Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue product) M +
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue quotient)
def Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun b P =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivAllocation b P +
      Chal.EditApproximation.naturalWordLEAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork b P).1 [true] +
    1
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryCellValidAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ → ℕ :=
fun n exponent cell =>
  have cap :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork n
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.powerTwoWord exponent))).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation n
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.powerTwoWord exponent)) +
          Chal.EditApproximation.naturalWordLEAllocation cell.1.bits cap +
        Chal.EditApproximation.naturalWordLEAllocation cell.2.bits cap +
      exponent +
    1
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryPairAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  a.bits.length + b.bits.length +
    if (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork a b).1 = Ordering.lt then
      Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation b b +
        Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation
          (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork b b).1) a
    else
      Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation a a +
          Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork a a).1) a +
        Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation
          (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue
            (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork
                (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork a a).1) a).1)
          b
def Chal.EditApproximation.binaryGridRoundAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun spacing position =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivAllocation position spacing +
    Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulAllocation spacing.bits
      (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalDivModWithWork position spacing).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.wordSortAllocation : List (List Bool) → ℕ :=
fun x => List.brecOn x Chal.EditApproximation.wordSortAllocation._f
def Chal.EditApproximation.reduceOnlineIntegerAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun K integer =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.triangularMassAllocation K +
      Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModAllocation
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.triangularMassWithWork K).1).bits integer.bits +
    integer.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarsePreparedInputStorage : List ℕ → List ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun source target sourceLo sourceHi targetLo targetHi =>
  match (Chal.EditApproximation.coarsePreparedSlicesWithWork source target sourceLo sourceHi targetLo targetHi).1 with
  | none => 1
  | some (x, y) => 1 + Chal.EditApproximation.storedNaturalBits x + Chal.EditApproximation.storedNaturalBits y
def Chal.EditApproximation.optimizerTriangularMass : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun K => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, (j + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalLogApproximation : ℚ → ℕ → ℚ :=
fun r K => 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, ((r - 1) / (r + 1)) ^ (2 * k + 1) / (2 * ↑k + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalLinearizationMaximizer.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  Finset ι → List (ι → ℚ) → (ι → ℚ) → ι → ℚ :=
fun {ι} coordinates vertices gradient =>
  (List.argmax (fun p => ∑ i ∈ coordinates, gradient i * p i) vertices).getD fun x => 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.bandCoordinates.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} → [Fintype β] → [DecidableEq β] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset (β → σ) → Finset (β × σ) :=
fun {β} {σ} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq σ] band =>
  band.biUnion fun action => Finset.image (fun child => (child, action child)) Finset.univ
def Chal.EditApproximation.actionVector.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} → [Fintype β] → [DecidableEq σ] → (β → ℚ) → (β → σ) → β × σ → ℚ :=
fun {β} {σ} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq σ] mass action coordinate =>
  if coordinate.2 = action coordinate.1 then mass coordinate.1 / ∑ child, mass child else 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalOptimisticHistory.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  ℚ → (ℕ → ι → ℚ) → (ℕ → ι → ℚ) → ℕ → ι → ℚ :=
fun {ι} κ gain decrement t i => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range t, (gain j i + (1 - 2 * κ) * decrement j i)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rejectionBitCount : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun N => Nat.clog 2 N
def Chal.EditApproximation.vectorMapWithWork.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} → (d : ℕ) → (Fin d → α × ℕ) → Vector α d × ℕ :=
fun {α} d f =>
  have cells := Vector.ofFn f;
  (Vector.map Prod.fst cells, (Vector.map Prod.snd cells).toList.sum + 6 * d)
def Chal.EditApproximation.TreeLayer : ℕ → ℕ → Type :=
fun M x => Nat.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.TreeLayer._f M)
def Chal.EditApproximation.intervalTreeDepth : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun M nx => Nat.clog M (max 1 nx)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalMaximum : ℚ → List ℚ → ℚ :=
fun fallback x => List.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalMaximum._f fallback)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalDyadicCeiling : ℚ → ℚ :=
fun value => 2 ^ Int.clog 2 value
def Chal.EditApproximation.listedBandCoordinates.{u_1} : {M : ℕ} →
  {σ : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq σ] → List (Fin M → σ) → List (Fin M × σ) :=
fun {M} {σ} [DecidableEq σ] band =>
  (List.flatMap (fun action => List.ofFn fun child => (child, action child)) band).dedup
def Chal.EditApproximation.childGain.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} → (β → ℚ) → (ℕ → β × σ → ℚ) → ℕ → β × σ → ℚ :=
fun {β} {σ} mass table t i => -table t i / mass i.1
def Chal.EditApproximation.childDecrement.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} → (β → ℚ) → (ℕ → β × σ → ℚ) → ℕ → β × σ → ℚ :=
fun {β} {σ} mass table t i => (table t i - table (t + 1) i) / mass i.1
def Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → Bool × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork a b;
  (decide (result.1 = Ordering.eq), result.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.translatedEndpointWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun reference root endpoint =>
  have difference := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalSubtractWithWork endpoint root;
  have result :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork reference (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue difference.1);
  (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue result.1, difference.2 + result.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalOnlineMinimum : List ℚ → Option ℚ :=
fun x =>
  match x with
  | [] => none
  | first :: rest => some (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalMinimum first rest)
def Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicQueryWindow : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → List ℕ :=
fun N w a F =>
  List.filter (fun b => decide (w / (16 * F) ≤ ↑b ∧ ↑b ≤ 8 * a * w)) (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScales N)
def Chal.EditApproximation.actionCurrentInputCover.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} →
    [DecidableEq Child] → {M : ℕ} → List (Chal.EditApproximation.RationalBellmanAction Parent Child M) → Finset Child :=
fun {Parent} {Child} [DecidableEq Child] {M} actions =>
  (List.finRange actions.length).toFinset.biUnion fun index => Finset.image (actions.get index).childState Finset.univ
def Chal.EditApproximation.boundedOnlineInteger : (n : ℕ) → 0 < n → ℕ → Fin n :=
fun n hn integer => ⟨integer % n, ⋯⟩
def Chal.EditApproximation.orderedInputs.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  [DecidableEq ι] → (encode : ι → ℕ) → Function.Injective encode → Finset ι → List ι :=
fun {ι} [DecidableEq ι] encode hinjective inputs =>
  let x := LinearOrder.lift' encode hinjective;
  inputs.sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2
def Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws : ℕ → ℕ → Type :=
fun B x => Nat.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws._f B)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseThresholdContribution : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ :=
fun threshold scale value => if threshold ≤ value then max value scale else 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseChildThreshold : (B : ℕ) → ℚ → ℚ → Fin B → ℚ :=
fun B Q allowance draw => allowance * ↑(↑draw + 1) / (↑B * Q)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseCommonDenominator : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun allowanceDen q L B D => allowanceDen * q * (L * B * q) ^ D
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalSmoothedGradient.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} → ℕ → (ι → ℚ) → (ι → ℚ) → ι → ℚ :=
fun {ι} G linear p i => -Chal.EditApproximation.rationalLogApproximation (p i + 1 / ↑G ^ 50) (G ^ 60) - 1 + linear i
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalOnlineLinear.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  ℚ → ℚ → (ℕ → ι → ℚ) → (ℕ → ι → ℚ) → ℕ → ι → ℚ :=
fun {ι} η κ gain decrement t i => η * (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalOptimisticHistory κ gain decrement t i + gain t i)
def Chal.EditApproximation.triangularChoice : (K : ℕ) →
  Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.optimizerTriangularMass K) → Fin K :=
fun x x_1 =>
  Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x => Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.optimizerTriangularMass x) → Fin x) x
    Chal.EditApproximation.triangularChoice._f x_1
@[reducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode : ℕ → ℕ → Type :=
fun M J => (d : Fin (J + 1)) × Chal.EditApproximation.TreeLayer M ↑d
def Chal.EditApproximation.finiteRationalOptimizer.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  Finset ι → List (ι → ℚ) → (ι → ℚ) → ℕ → ℕ → ι → ℚ :=
fun {ι} coordinates vertices linear G x =>
  Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x => ι → ℚ) x
    (Chal.EditApproximation.finiteRationalOptimizer._f coordinates vertices linear G)
@[reducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalInternalNode : ℕ → ℕ → Type :=
fun M J => { node // ↑node.fst < J }
def Chal.EditApproximation.finiteOptimizerAction.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} →
    [Fintype β] →
      [DecidableEq β] → [DecidableEq σ] → (band : List (β → σ)) → band ≠ [] → (β → ℚ) → (β × σ → ℚ) → ℕ → ℕ → β → σ :=
fun {β} {σ} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq σ] band hband mass linear G j =>
  have coordinates := Chal.EditApproximation.bandCoordinates band.toFinset;
  have vertices := List.map (Chal.EditApproximation.actionVector mass) band;
  have gradient :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.rationalSmoothedGradient G linear
      (Chal.EditApproximation.finiteRationalOptimizer coordinates vertices linear G j);
  (List.argmax
        (fun action =>
          ∑ coordinate ∈ coordinates, gradient coordinate * Chal.EditApproximation.actionVector mass action coordinate)
        band).getD
    (band.head hband)
def Chal.EditApproximation.finiteOptimizerActionDraw.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} →
    [Fintype β] →
      [DecidableEq β] →
        [DecidableEq σ] →
          (band : List (β → σ)) →
            band ≠ [] →
              (β → ℚ) → (β × σ → ℚ) → ℕ → (K : ℕ) → Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.optimizerTriangularMass K) → β → σ :=
fun {β} {σ} [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq σ] band hband mass linear G K integer =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.finiteOptimizerAction band hband mass linear G
    ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.triangularChoice K integer)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.width : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun a => max a.numerator.bits.length a.denominator.length
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.denominatorInteger : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary :=
fun a => { negative := false, bits := a.denominator }
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
{ numerator := { negative := false, bits := [] }, denominator := [true],
  denominator_pos := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero._proof_1 }
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.canonicalizeWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun a =>
  have proof_trimBitWordWithWork_value_6 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.canonicalizeWithWork._proof_1;
  have numerator := Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordWithWork a.numerator.bits;
  let denominator := Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordWithWork a.denominator;
  ({ numerator := { negative := a.numerator.negative, bits := numerator.1 }, denominator := denominator.1,
      denominator_pos := ⋯ },
    numerator.2 + denominator.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo : ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun n =>
  have proof_powerTwoWord_value_13 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo._proof_1;
  { numerator := { negative := false, bits := [true] }, denominator := Chal.EditApproximation.powerTwoWord n,
    denominator_pos := ⋯ }
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.doubleFraction : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun a =>
  { numerator := { negative := a.numerator.negative, bits := false :: a.numerator.bits }, denominator := a.denominator,
    denominator_pos := ⋯ }
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.absolute : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun a =>
  { numerator := { negative := false, bits := a.numerator.bits }, denominator := a.denominator, denominator_pos := ⋯ }
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalCeilingWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  List Bool × ℕ :=
fun a =>
  if a.numerator.negative = true then ([], 1)
  else
    have result := Chal.EditApproximation.bitCeilDivWithWork a.denominator a.numerator.bits;
    (result.1, result.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.ofNaturalWord : List Bool → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun bits =>
  { numerator := { negative := false, bits := bits }, denominator := [true],
    denominator_pos := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero._proof_1 }
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalFloorWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  List Bool × ℕ :=
fun a =>
  if a.numerator.negative = true then ([], 1)
  else
    have quotient := Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModWithWork a.denominator a.numerator.bits;
    (quotient.1, quotient.2.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryDataReadBudget.{u_1} : ℕ → ℕ → {κ : Type u_1} → List κ → ℕ :=
fun M n {κ} keys => 1 + keys.length * (24 * max M.size n.size + 9)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineParametersWithWork : (ell : List Bool) →
  0 < Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue ell →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) × ℕ :=
fun ell hell =>
  have proof_trimBitWordWithWork_value_6 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.canonicalizeWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_bitAdder_value_1 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineParametersWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_bitAddWithWork_value_2 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitMulWithWork_value_0 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitPowerWithWork_value_76 := ⋯;
  have etaPower := Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork ell 5;
  let kappaPower := Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork ell 4;
  have eta :=
    { numerator := { negative := false, bits := etaPower.1 }, denominator := [true],
      denominator_pos := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero._proof_1 };
  have kappa :=
    { numerator := { negative := false, bits := [true] }, denominator := kappaPower.1, denominator_pos := ⋯ };
  ((eta, kappa), etaPower.2 + kappaPower.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.refinementDecrementWithWork : (ell : List Bool) →
  0 < Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue ell → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun ell hell =>
  have proof_trimBitWordWithWork_value_6 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.canonicalizeWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_bitAdder_value_1 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineParametersWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_bitAddWithWork_value_2 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitMulWithWork_value_0 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitPowerWithWork_value_76 := ⋯;
  let denominator := Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork ell 10;
  ({ numerator := { negative := false, bits := [true] }, denominator := denominator.1, denominator_pos := ⋯ },
    denominator.2 + 1)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalListEqualWithWork : List ℕ → List ℕ → Bool × ℕ :=
fun x x_1 =>
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => List ℕ → Bool × ℕ) x Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalListEqualWithWork._f
    x_1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.canonicalizeAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=

  Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordAllocation a.numerator.bits +
    Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordAllocation a.denominator
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.invAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun a => if (Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork a.numerator.bits []).1 = Ordering.eq then 1 else 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalCeilingAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun a =>
  if a.numerator.negative = true then 0 else Chal.EditApproximation.bitCeilDivAllocation a.denominator a.numerator.bits
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gatheredLookupAllocation.{u_1} : {κ : Type u_1} →
  (κ → κ → Bool × ℕ) → (κ → κ → ℕ) → List κ → List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → κ → ℕ :=
fun {κ} equal allocation x x_1 x_2 =>
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → κ → ℕ) x
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gatheredLookupAllocation._f equal allocation) x_1 x_2
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalFloorAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun a =>
  if a.numerator.negative = true then 0 else Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModAllocation a.denominator a.numerator.bits
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.signedPowerTwoAllocation : ℤ → ℕ :=
fun e => if 0 ≤ e then e.toNat + 2 else (-e).toNat + 2
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.invWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun a =>
  have proof_bitOrdering_matches_4 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.invWithWork._proof_12;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_matches_5 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_eq_3 := ⋯;
  let comparison := Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork a.numerator.bits [];
  if h : comparison.1 = Ordering.eq then (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero, comparison.2 + 2)
  else
    ({ numerator := { negative := a.numerator.negative, bits := a.denominator }, denominator := a.numerator.bits,
        denominator_pos := ⋯ },
      comparison.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.signedPowerTwoWithWork : ℤ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun e =>
  if 0 ≤ e then
    ({ numerator := { negative := false, bits := Chal.EditApproximation.powerTwoWord e.toNat }, denominator := [true],
        denominator_pos := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero._proof_1 },
      e.toNat + 3)
  else (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo (-e).toNat, (-e).toNat + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.fixedDenominatorWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  (denominator : List Bool) →
    0 < Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue denominator → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun a denominator hden =>
  have product := Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork a.numerator.bits denominator;
  have quotient := Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModWithWork a.denominator product.1;
  have raw :=
    { numerator := { negative := a.numerator.negative, bits := quotient.1 }, denominator := denominator,
      denominator_pos := hden };
  have answer := raw.canonicalizeWithWork;
  (answer.1, product.2 + quotient.2.2 + answer.2 + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.finalAnswerWithWork : ℕ →

fun N a =>
  have floor := a.naturalFloorWithWork;
  have clamped := Chal.EditApproximation.wordMinWithWork N.bits floor.1;
  (clamped.1, floor.2 + clamped.2 + N.size + 2)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.fixedDenominatorAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

      denominator_pos := hden };

      Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModAllocation a.denominator product.1 +
    raw.canonicalizeAllocation

    Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicSeedExponent (Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedInitialExponent N) pass

    (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicSeedExponent (Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedInitialExponent N) pass -
      Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N)

def Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.value : Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary → ℤ :=
fun a => Chal.EditApproximation.signedMagnitude a.negative (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue a.bits)
def Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.ofInt : ℤ → Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary :=
fun a => { negative := decide (a < 0), bits := a.natAbs.bits }
def Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.neg : Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary →
  Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary :=
fun a => { negative := !a.negative, bits := a.bits }
def Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.addWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary →
  Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary → Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  if a.negative = b.negative then
    have total := Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddWithWork a.bits b.bits false;
    ({ negative := a.negative, bits := total.1 }, total.2 + 4)
  else
    have comparison := Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork a.bits b.bits;
    match comparison.1 with
    | Ordering.eq => ({ negative := false, bits := [] }, comparison.2 + 4)
    | Ordering.lt =>
      have difference := Chal.EditApproximation.bitSubtractWithWork b.bits a.bits false;
      ({ negative := b.negative, bits := difference.1 }, comparison.2 + difference.2.2 + 4)
    | Ordering.gt =>
      have difference := Chal.EditApproximation.bitSubtractWithWork a.bits b.bits false;
      ({ negative := a.negative, bits := difference.1 }, comparison.2 + difference.2.2 + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.mulWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary →
  Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary → Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  have product := Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork a.bits b.bits;
  ({ negative := a.negative ^^ b.negative, bits := product.1 }, product.2 + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.nonzeroWithWork : List Bool → Bool × ℕ :=
fun bits =>
  have comparison := Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork bits [];
  (if comparison.1 = Ordering.eq then false else true, comparison.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.addAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary →
  Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary → ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  if a.negative = b.negative then Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddAllocation a.bits b.bits false
  else
    match (Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork a.bits b.bits).1 with
    | Ordering.eq => 0
    | Ordering.lt => Chal.EditApproximation.bitSubtractAllocation b.bits a.bits false
    | Ordering.gt => Chal.EditApproximation.bitSubtractAllocation a.bits b.bits false
def Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.mulAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary →
  Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary → ℕ :=
fun a b => Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulAllocation a.bits b.bits
def Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.ltWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary →
  Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary → Bool × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  if a.negative = true then
    if b.negative = true then
      have comparison := Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork b.bits a.bits;
      (comparison.1 == Ordering.lt, comparison.2 + 2)
    else
      have left := Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.nonzeroWithWork a.bits;
      have right := Chal.EditApproximation.SignedBinary.nonzeroWithWork b.bits;
      (left.1 || right.1, left.2 + right.2 + 4)
  else
    if b.negative = true then (false, 2)
    else
      have comparison := Chal.EditApproximation.bitCompareWithWork a.bits b.bits;
      (comparison.1 == Ordering.lt, comparison.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.value : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℚ :=
fun a => ↑a.numerator.value / ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue a.denominator)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.representation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational :=
fun a => { num := a.numerator.value, den := Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue a.denominator, den_pos := ⋯ }
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.addWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  have proof_bitAdder_value_1 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineParametersWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_bitAddWithWork_value_2 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitMulWithWork_value_0 := ⋯;
  have first := a.numerator.mulWithWork b.denominatorInteger;
  have second := b.numerator.mulWithWork a.denominatorInteger;
  have numerator := first.1.addWithWork second.1;
  let denominator := Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork a.denominator b.denominator;
  ({ numerator := numerator.1, denominator := denominator.1, denominator_pos := ⋯ },
    first.2 + second.2 + numerator.2 + denominator.2 + 8)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.mulWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  have proof_bitAdder_value_1 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineParametersWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_bitAddWithWork_value_2 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitMulWithWork_value_0 := ⋯;
  have numerator := a.numerator.mulWithWork b.numerator;
  let denominator := Chal.EditApproximation.bitMulWithWork a.denominator b.denominator;

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.ltWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

  have left := a.numerator.mulWithWork b.denominatorInteger;

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseReadShiftWithWork : (k : ℕ) →
  ℕ → List ℕ → Option (Option ℕ) → ℕ → Fin (2 * k + 1) → ℕ × ℕ :=

  match letter with
  | none => (0, 1)
  | some letter =>
    have position := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork start ↑shift;

      Chal.EditApproximation.coarseFramedReadWithWork k n target (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue position.1);
    have matched := Chal.EditApproximation.coarseLetterMatchWithWork actual.1 letter;
    (if matched.1 = true then 0 else 1, position.2 + actual.2 + matched.2 + 3)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseContributionWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun threshold scale a =>
  have test := threshold.leWithWork a;
  if test.1 = true then
    have result := a.maxWithWork scale;
    (result.1, test.2 + result.2 + 2)
  else
    have result := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseGridNatWithWork a.denominator ⋯ 0;
    (result.1, test.2 + result.2 + 2)

  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
      Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → Fin d → ℕ :=

  complement.canonicalMulAllocation (previous.get i) + step.canonicalMulAllocation (selected.get i) +
    (complement.canonicalMulWithWork (previous.get i)).1.canonicalAddAllocation
      (step.canonicalMulWithWork (selected.get i)).1

    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.maxWithWork product).1.naturalCeilingAllocation

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.affineErrorWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Bool × ℕ :=
fun position offset velocity prediction tolerance =>
  have displacement := position.subWithWork offset;
  have product := velocity.canonicalMulWithWork prediction;
  have error := displacement.1.subWithWork product.1;
  have comparison := error.1.absolute.leWithWork tolerance;

  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=

  have product := tau.canonicalMulWithWork theta;
  have scale := product.1.canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b);
  have result := scale.1.divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M);
  (result.1, product.2 + scale.2 + result.2 + b.size + M.size + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.medianSeedWithWork : ℕ →
  ℕ → List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun N multiplier values =>
  have rounded :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scaledCeilingWithWork multiplier) values;
  have sorted := Chal.EditApproximation.wordSortWithWork rounded.1;
  have middle := sorted.1.getD (values.length / 2) [];
  have clamped := Chal.EditApproximation.wordMinWithWork N.bits middle;
  (clamped.1, rounded.2 + sorted.2 + values.length + clamped.2 + N.size + 3)

  ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → List Bool × ℕ :=

  have qm :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat Q).canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M);
  have numerator := qm.1.canonicalMulWithWork h;
  have ratio := numerator.1.divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b);
  have ceiling := ratio.1.naturalCeilingWithWork;
  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.wordMinWithWork M.bits ceiling.1;
  (result.1, qm.2 + numerator.2 + ratio.2 + ceiling.2 + result.2 + M.size + Q.size + b.size + 5)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gainReadWithWork.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} →
    (β → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
      (ℕ → β × σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) → ℕ → β × σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {β} {σ} mass read s i =>
  have word := read s i;
  have result := word.1.neg.divWithWork (mass i.1);
  (result.1, word.2 + result.2 + 1)

  have first := read s i;
  have second := read (s + 1) i;
  have difference := first.1.subWithWork second.1;
  have result := difference.1.divWithWork (mass i.1);
  (result.1, first.2 + second.2 + difference.2 + result.2 + 1)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellCoordinatesWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  ℕ → ℕ → List ℕ × ℕ :=
fun side p radius =>
  have lower := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork p radius;
  have upper := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork p radius;
  have firstQ :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower.1)).divWithWork side;
  have lastQ :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue upper.1)).divWithWork side;
  have first := firstQ.1.naturalFloorWithWork;
  have last := lastQ.1.naturalFloorWithWork;
  have stop := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue last.1) 1;
  have count :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue stop.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue first.1);
  have values :=
    List.range' (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue first.1) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue count.1);
  (values,
    lower.2 + upper.2 + firstQ.2 + lastQ.2 + first.2 + last.2 + stop.2 + count.2 + values.length + p.size +
        radius.size +
      9)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellGridPointsWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  ℕ → ℕ → List ℕ × ℕ :=
fun side g cell =>
  have next := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork cell 1;
  have lower := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat cell).canonicalMulWithWork side;
  have upper :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue next.1)).canonicalMulWithWork side;
  have firstQ := lower.1.divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat g);
  have lastQ := upper.1.divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat g);
  have first := firstQ.1.naturalCeilingWithWork;
  have last := lastQ.1.naturalCeilingWithWork;
  have count :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue last.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue first.1);
  have indices :=
    List.range' (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue first.1) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue count.1);
  have points :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (fun i =>
        have product := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork g i;
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue product.1, product.2 + i.size + 2))
      indices;
  (points.1,
    next.2 + lower.2 + upper.2 + firstQ.2 + lastQ.2 + first.2 + last.2 + count.2 + points.2 + indices.length +
          cell.size +
        g.size +
      10)

  have step :=
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (j + 2))).1;
  have complement := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.subWithWork step).1;

    (displacement.subWithWork product).1.absolute.leAllocation tolerance
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandToleranceAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=

  have product := (tau.canonicalMulWithWork theta).1;

        scale.divAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M) +
      b.size +
