def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialScaleGuardAllocation : ℕ →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun U b A =>
  have square := (A.canonicalMulWithWork A).1;
  have denominator := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 16).canonicalMulWithWork square).1;
  have lower := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat U).divWithWork denominator).1;
  have factor := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 4).canonicalMulWithWork A).1;
  have upper := (factor.canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat U)).1;
  A.canonicalMulAllocation A + (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 16).canonicalMulAllocation square +
                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat U).divAllocation denominator +
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 4).canonicalMulAllocation A +
            factor.canonicalMulAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat U) +
          lower.leAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b) +
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b).leAllocation upper +
      U.size +
    b.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialCenterGuardAllocation : ℕ →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun b U A =>
  have lower :=
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b).divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2)).1;
  have factor := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 4).canonicalMulWithWork A).1;
  have upper := (factor.canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b)).1;
  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b).divAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2) +
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 4).canonicalMulAllocation A +
            factor.canonicalMulAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b) +
          lower.leAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat U) +
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat U).leAllocation upper +
      b.size +
    U.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scaledSeedAllocation : ℕ →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun U a gap =>
  have ratio := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat U).divWithWork a).1;
  have rounded := ratio.naturalCeilingWithWork.1;
  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat U).divAllocation a + ratio.naturalCeilingAllocation +
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.ofNaturalWord rounded).maxAllocation gap.absolute +
      U.size +
    2
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.centerEligibilityAllocation : ℕ →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun b F a initial =>
  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 4).canonicalMulAllocation a +
                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b).divAllocation
                  ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 4).canonicalMulWithWork a).1 +
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 8).canonicalMulAllocation
                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F) +
            ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 8).canonicalMulWithWork
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F)).1.canonicalMulAllocation
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b) +
          ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b).divWithWork
                  ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 4).canonicalMulWithWork a).1).1.leAllocation
            initial +
        initial.leAllocation
          (((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 8).canonicalMulWithWork
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F)).1.canonicalMulWithWork
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b)).1 +
      b.size +
    F.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.refinementScaleGuardAllocation : ℕ →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun F b a w =>
  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 16).canonicalMulAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F) +
                w.divAllocation
                  ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 16).canonicalMulWithWork
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F)).1 +
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 8).canonicalMulAllocation a +
            ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 8).canonicalMulWithWork a).1.canonicalMulAllocation w +
          (w.divWithWork
                  ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 16).canonicalMulWithWork
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F)).1).1.leAllocation
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b) +
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b).leAllocation
          (((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 8).canonicalMulWithWork a).1.canonicalMulWithWork w).1 +
      b.size +
    F.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellCoordinatesAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun side p radius =>
  have lower := (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork p radius).1;
  have upper := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork p radius).1;
  have firstQ :=
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower)).divWithWork side).1;
  have lastQ :=
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue upper)).divWithWork side).1;
  have first := firstQ.naturalFloorWithWork.1;
  have last := lastQ.naturalFloorWithWork.1;
  have stop := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue last) 1).1;
  have count :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue stop)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue first)).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation p radius +
                      Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation p radius +
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat
                          (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower)).divAllocation
                      side +
                  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue upper)).divAllocation
                    side +
                firstQ.naturalFloorAllocation +
              lastQ.naturalFloorAllocation +
            Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue last) 1 +
          Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue stop)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue first) +
        Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue count +
      p.size +
    radius.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellGridPointsAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun side g cell =>
  have next := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork cell 1).1;
  have lower := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat cell).canonicalMulWithWork side).1;
  have upper :=
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue next)).canonicalMulWithWork
        side).1;
  have firstQ := (lower.divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat g)).1;
  have lastQ := (upper.divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat g)).1;
  have first := firstQ.naturalCeilingWithWork.1;
  have last := lastQ.naturalCeilingWithWork.1;
  have count :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue last)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue first)).1;
  have indices := List.range' (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue first) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue count);
  Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation cell 1 +
                        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat cell).canonicalMulAllocation side +
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat
                            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue next)).canonicalMulAllocation
                        side +
                    lower.divAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat g) +
                  upper.divAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat g) +
                firstQ.naturalCeilingAllocation +
              lastQ.naturalCeilingAllocation +
            Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue last)
              (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue first) +
          Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation
            (fun i => Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation g i + i.size) indices +
        indices.length +
      cell.size +
    g.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.medianSeedAllocation : ℕ →
  ℕ → List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun N multiplier values =>
  have rounded :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scaledCeilingWithWork multiplier) values).1;
  have sorted := (Chal.EditApproximation.wordSortWithWork rounded).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scaledCeilingAllocation multiplier) values +
        Chal.EditApproximation.wordSortAllocation rounded +
      Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEAllocation N.bits (sorted.getD (values.length / 2) []) +
    N.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupSampleCountAllocation : ℕ →
  ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun M Q b h =>
  have qm :=
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat Q).canonicalMulWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M)).1;
  have numerator := (qm.canonicalMulWithWork h).1;
  have ratio := (numerator.divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b)).1;
  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat Q).canonicalMulAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M) +
                qm.canonicalMulAllocation h +
              numerator.divAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b) +
            ratio.naturalCeilingAllocation +
          Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEAllocation M.bits ratio.naturalCeilingWithWork.1 +
        M.size +
      Q.size +
    b.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.refinementUpdateAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Option Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun delta cone x =>
  match x with
  | none => 0
  | some online =>
    have denominator := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.canonicalAddWithWork delta).1;
    have lower := (cone.divWithWork denominator).1;
    have clipped := (lower.maxWithWork online).1;
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.canonicalAddAllocation delta + cone.divAllocation denominator +
        lower.maxAllocation online +
      cone.minAllocation clipped
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coefficientAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun kappa =>
  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulAllocation kappa +
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.subAllocation
        ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulWithWork kappa).1 +
    0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gainReadAllocation.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} →
    (β → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
      (ℕ → β × σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) → (ℕ → β × σ → ℕ) → ℕ → β × σ → ℕ :=
fun {β} {σ} mass read footprint s i => footprint s i + (read s i).1.neg.divAllocation (mass i.1) + 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.decrementReadAllocation.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} →
    (β → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
      (ℕ → β × σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) → (ℕ → β × σ → ℕ) → ℕ → β × σ → ℕ :=
fun {β} {σ} mass read footprint s i =>
  footprint s i + footprint (s + 1) i + (read s i).1.subAllocation (read (s + 1) i).1 +
      ((read s i).1.subWithWork (read (s + 1) i).1).1.divAllocation (mass i.1) +
    0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.logarithmWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun r k =>
  have numerator := r.subWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one;
  have denominator := r.canonicalAddWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one;
  have ratio := numerator.1.divWithWork denominator.1;
  have subtotal := ratio.1.logarithmPartialWithWork k;
  have result := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulWithWork subtotal.1;
  (result.1, numerator.2 + denominator.2 + ratio.2 + subtotal.2 + result.2 + 5)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.optimisticTermReadWithWork.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} →
    (β → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
      (ℕ → β × σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → β × σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {β} {σ} mass read coefficient s i =>
  have gain := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gainReadWithWork mass read s i;
  have decrement := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.decrementReadWithWork mass read s i;
  have scaled := coefficient.canonicalMulWithWork decrement.1;
  have total := gain.1.canonicalAddWithWork scaled.1;
  (total.1, gain.2 + decrement.2 + scaled.2 + total.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryExponentsWithWork : ℕ →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → List ℕ × ℕ :=
fun N F a w =>
  have count := max 1 N.bits.length;
  have selected :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.filterWithWork
      (fun e =>
        have guard := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.refinementScaleGuardWithWork F (2 ^ e) a w;
        (guard.1, guard.2 + e + 2))
      (List.range count);
  (selected.1, selected.2 + count + N.bits.length + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.seedMedianWithWork : ℕ →
  ℕ → List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun N multiplier values =>
  have median := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.medianSeedWithWork N multiplier values;
  have trimmed := Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordWithWork median.1;
  (trimmed.1, median.2 + trimmed.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseGridPenaltyWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun two source =>
  have left := two.coarseGridLeftWithWork source;
  have right := two.coarseGridLeftWithWork source.reverse;
  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseGridZipMinimumWithWork left.1 right.1.reverse;
  (result.1, left.2 + right.2 + result.2 + 3 * source.length)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseChildThresholdWithWork : (B : ℕ) →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Fin B → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun B q allowance draw =>
  have numerator := allowance.canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (↑draw + 1));
  have divisor :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat B).canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat q);
  have result := numerator.1.coarseDivideWithWork divisor.1;
  (result.1, numerator.2 + divisor.2 + result.2 + (↑draw + 1).size + B.size + q.size + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseChildAllowanceWithWork : ℕ →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun L threshold =>
  have result := threshold.coarseDivideWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat L);
  (result.1, result.2 + L.size + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.logarithmPartialAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun b x => Nat.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.logarithmPartialAllocation._f b)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandMassAllocation : {M : ℕ} →

  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.dotListAllocation (Vector.ofFn values.get)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalDistanceLeAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=

  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat a).distanceAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b) +

            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat radius) +

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryExponentsAllocation : ℕ →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun N F a w =>
  have count := max 1 N.bits.length;
  Chal.EditApproximation.filterAllocation
        (fun e =>
          ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.refinementScaleGuardWithWork F (2 ^ e) a w).1,
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.refinementScaleGuardWithWork F (2 ^ e) a w).2 + e + 2))
        (fun e => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.refinementScaleGuardAllocation F (2 ^ e) a w + e + 1)
        (List.range count) +
      count +
    N.bits.length

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.optimisticTermReadAllocation.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} →
    (β → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
      (ℕ → β × σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        (ℕ → β × σ → ℕ) → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → β × σ → ℕ :=
fun {β} {σ} mass read footprint coefficient s i =>
  have gain := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gainReadWithWork mass read s i).1;
  have decrement := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.decrementReadWithWork mass read s i).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gainReadAllocation mass read footprint s i +
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.decrementReadAllocation mass read footprint s i +
        coefficient.canonicalMulAllocation decrement +
      gain.canonicalAddAllocation (coefficient.canonicalMulWithWork decrement).1 +
    0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gradientCellWithWork : {d : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d →
      Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → Fin d → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {d} G linear point i =>
  have smoothing := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat G).powWithWork 50;
  have inverse := smoothing.1.invWithWork;
  have shifted := (point.get i).canonicalAddWithWork inverse.1;
  have logarithm := shifted.1.logarithmWithWork (G ^ 60);
  have deficit := logarithm.1.neg.subWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one;
  have result := deficit.1.canonicalAddWithWork (linear.get i);
  (result.1, smoothing.2 + inverse.2 + shifted.2 + logarithm.2 + deficit.2 + result.2 + G.size + 70)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryScalesWithWork : ℕ →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → List ℕ × ℕ :=

  have scales :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (fun e => (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.powerTwoWord e), e + 3)) exponents.1;
  (scales.1, exponents.2 + scales.2 + 1)

  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.seedMedianWithWork N multiplier words;
  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.ofNaturalWord result.1, result.2 + result.1.length + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseBinaryPenaltyWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.logarithmAllocation : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun r n =>
  have numerator := (r.subWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one).1;
  have denominator := (r.canonicalAddWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one).1;
  have ratio := (numerator.divWithWork denominator).1;
  r.subAllocation Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one +
          r.canonicalAddAllocation Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one +
        numerator.divAllocation denominator +
      ratio.logarithmPartialAllocation n +
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulAllocation (ratio.logarithmPartialWithWork n).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryScalesAllocation : ℕ →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=

  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryExponentsAllocation N F a value +
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun e => e + 1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryExponentsWithWork N F a value).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseIndexChildren : {B : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          (Fin B → ℕ) →

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gradientCellAllocation : {d : ℕ} →
  ℕ → Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → Fin d → ℕ :=
fun {d} G linear point i =>
  have smoothing := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat G).powWithWork 50).1;
  have inverse := smoothing.invWithWork.1;
  have shifted := ((point.get i).canonicalAddWithWork inverse).1;
  have logarithm := (shifted.logarithmWithWork (G ^ 60)).1;
  have deficit := (logarithm.neg.subWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one).1;
  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat G).powAllocation 50 + smoothing.invAllocation +
              (point.get i).canonicalAddAllocation inverse +
            shifted.logarithmAllocation (G ^ 60) +
          logarithm.neg.subAllocation Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one +
        deficit.canonicalAddAllocation (linear.get i) +
      G.size +
    1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseIndexedWithWork : {B : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          List ℕ →
            List ℕ →
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                (d : ℕ) →
                  ℕ →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B d →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                        ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.CoarseBinaryArray × ℕ :=
fun {B} k q L n source target two x x_1 x_2 x_3 x_4 =>
  Nat.brecOn (motive := fun x =>
    ℕ →
      Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B x →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.CoarseBinaryArray × ℕ)
    x (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseIndexedWithWork._f k q L n source target two) x_1 x_2 x_3 x_4
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gradientAllocation : {d : ℕ} →
  ℕ → Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → ℕ :=
fun {d} G linear point =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.vectorMapAllocation d
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gradientCellAllocation G linear point)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gradientWithWork : {d : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d →
      Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d × ℕ :=
fun {d} G linear point =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.vectorMapWithWork d (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gradientCellWithWork G linear point)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scoredArgmaxWithWork.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (α → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) → List α → Option (α × Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) × ℕ :=
fun {α} score x => List.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scoredArgmaxWithWork._f score)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.optimizerUpdateWithWork : {d : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d →
      Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d × ℕ :=
fun {d} j previous selected =>
  have step :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (j + 2));
  have complement := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.subWithWork step.1;
  have result :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.vectorMapWithWork d fun i =>
      have first := complement.1.canonicalMulWithWork (previous.get i);
      have second := step.1.canonicalMulWithWork (selected.get i);
      have total := first.1.canonicalAddWithWork second.1;
      (total.1, first.2 + second.2 + total.2 + 4);
  (result.1, step.2 + complement.2 + result.2 + (j + 2).size + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandMassTotalWithWork : {M : ℕ} →
  Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {M} mass =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.dotWithWork mass (Vector.replicate M Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coefficientWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun kappa =>
  have scaled := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulWithWork kappa;
  have difference := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.subWithWork scaled.1;
  (difference.1, scaled.2 + difference.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalDistanceLeWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Bool × ℕ :=
fun a b radius =>
  have distance :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat a).distanceWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b);
  have result := distance.1.leWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat radius);
  (result.1, distance.2 + result.2 + a.size + b.size + radius.size + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineMinimumWithWork : List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Option Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun x =>
  match x with
  | [] => (none, 1)
  | first :: rest =>
    have result := first.minimumWithWork rest;
    (some result.1, result.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.refinementUpdateWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
    Option Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun delta cone x =>
  match x with
  | none => (cone, 1)
  | some online =>
    have denominator := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.canonicalAddWithWork delta;
    have lower := cone.divWithWork denominator.1;
    have clipped := lower.1.maxWithWork online;
    have result := cone.minWithWork clipped.1;
    (result.1, denominator.2 + lower.2 + clipped.2 + result.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.equalWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Bool × ℕ :=
fun a b =>
  have left := a.leWithWork b;
  have right := b.leWithWork a;
  (left.1 && right.1, left.2 + right.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.roundedSpacingWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → List Bool × ℕ :=
fun theta envelope =>
  have product := theta.canonicalMulWithWork envelope;
  have clipped := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.maxWithWork product.1;
  have rounded := clipped.1.naturalCeilingWithWork;
  (rounded.1, product.2 + clipped.2 + rounded.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.maximizerWithWork : {d : ℕ} →
  Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d →
    List (Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d) → Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d × ℕ :=
fun {d} gradient vertices =>
  have selected :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scoredArgmaxWithWork
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.dotWithWork gradient) vertices;
  ((Option.map Prod.fst selected.1).getD (Vector.replicate d Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero),
    selected.2 + d + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupTermsWithWork : {M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
    Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
      Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M → List (Fin M) → List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {M} h envelope values indices =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
    (fun i =>
      have test := (envelope.get i).equalWithWork h;
      (if test.1 = true then values.get i else Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero, test.2 + 2))
    indices
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.selectGroupWithWork.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  (members : List ι) → members ≠ [] → (ι → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) → ι × ℕ :=
fun {ι} members hne estimate =>
  have selected :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scoredArgmaxWithWork
      (fun member =>
        have result := estimate member;
        (result.1.neg, result.2 + 1))
      members;
  ((Option.map Prod.fst selected.1).getD (members.head hne), selected.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.finiteOptimizerWithWork : {d : ℕ} →
  List (Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d) →
    Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → ℕ → ℕ → Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d × ℕ :=
fun {d} vertices linear G x =>
  Nat.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.finiteOptimizerWithWork._f vertices linear G)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.selectionWithWork.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {d : ℕ} →
    List (α × Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d) →
      Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → ℕ → ℕ → Option α × ℕ :=
fun {α} {d} vertices linear G j =>
  have iterate := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.finiteOptimizerWithWork (List.map Prod.snd vertices) linear G j;
  have gradient := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gradientWithWork G linear iterate.1;
  have selected :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scoredArgmaxWithWork
      (fun vertex => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.dotWithWork gradient.1 vertex.2) vertices;
  (Option.map (fun chosen => chosen.1.1) selected.1, iterate.2 + gradient.2 + selected.2 + 1)

  List.flatMap
    (fun lo => List.filterMap (fun hi => Chal.EditApproximation.makeTargetState n lo hi) (List.range (n + 1)))
    (List.range (n + 1))

def Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateWithWork : (n : ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → Option (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) × ℕ :=
fun n lo hi =>
  have proof_bitOrdering_matches_4 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.invWithWork._proof_12;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_matches_5 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_lt_16 := ⋯;
  have proof_wordLEWithWork_value_26 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitWordValue_bits_15 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_19;
  let first := Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork lo.bits hi.bits;
  let second := Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork hi.bits n.bits;
  if h : (first.1 && second.1) = true then
    (some { lo := lo, hi := hi, ordered := ⋯, valid := ⋯ }, first.2 + second.2 + 4)
  else (none, first.2 + second.2 + 2)

def Chal.EditApproximation.queryChildCodeWithWork : {M n : ℕ} →
  Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {M n} input =>
  have width := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork n 1;
  have high := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue width.1) input.2.hi;
  have coordinate :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork input.2.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue high.1);
  have scaled := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork M (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue coordinate.1);
  have result :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (↑input.1) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue scaled.1);
  (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue result.1, width.2 + high.2 + coordinate.2 + scaled.2 + result.2 + 5)
def Chal.EditApproximation.querySliceHeadWithWork.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (source : List α) → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length → Option α × ℕ :=
fun {α} source interval =>
  have test := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork interval.lo interval.hi;
  (if test.1 = Ordering.lt then source[interval.lo]? else none, test.2 + interval.lo.size + interval.hi.size + 3)
@[irreducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.rankedBitProgramValue.{u_1} : {κ : Type u_1} →
  (rank : κ → ℕ) →
    ((key : κ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery { child // rank child < rank key } Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
      κ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun {κ} rank program =>
  WellFounded.Nat.fix (fun x => rank x) fun key a =>
    Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.value (fun child => a ↑child ⋯) (program key)
def Chal.EditApproximation.scheduledRefinementWordWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun N pass =>
  if pass < Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedPassCount N then
    have e :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicSeedExponent (Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedInitialExponent N) pass -
        Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N;
    have value := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.signedPowerTwoWithWork ↑e;
    (value.1, value.2 + 5)
  else (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 1, 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coordinateEqualAllocation : {M n : ℕ} →
  Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {M n} a b =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation ↑a.1 ↑b.1 +
        Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation a.2.lo b.2.lo +
      Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation a.2.hi b.2.hi +
    2
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryIntervalEqualAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} a b =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation a.lo b.lo + Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation a.hi b.hi + 1
def Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChildAllocation : {n M : ℕ} → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Fin M → ℕ :=
fun {n M} parent i =>
  have width := (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork parent.hi parent.lo).1;
  have next := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (↑i) 1).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation parent.hi parent.lo +
          Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation (↑i) 1 +
        Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCutAllocation parent.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue width) M ↑i +
      Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCutAllocation parent.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue width) M
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue next) +
    2
def Chal.EditApproximation.zeroConnectionAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun {n} start x x_1 =>

def Chal.EditApproximation.queryChildCodeAllocation : {M n : ℕ} → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {M n} input =>
  have width := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork n 1).1;
  have high :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue width) input.2.hi).1;
  have coordinate :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork input.2.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue high)).1;
  have scaled := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork M (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue coordinate)).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation n 1 +
          Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue width) input.2.hi +
        Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation input.2.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue high) +
      Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation M (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue coordinate) +
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation (↑input.1) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue scaled)
def Chal.EditApproximation.roundStateAllocation : {n : ℕ} → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} spacing q =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.binaryGridRoundAllocation spacing q.lo +
      Chal.EditApproximation.binaryGridRoundAllocation spacing q.hi +
    2
def Chal.EditApproximation.actionEqualAllocation : {n M : ℕ} →
  (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → ℕ :=
fun {n M} a b =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.allAllocation
    (fun i =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation (a i).lo (b i).lo +
        Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation (a i).hi (b i).hi)
    (List.finRange M)

def Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildStateList : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →

def Chal.EditApproximation.bandCutShift : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx → (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → Fin M → ℚ :=

def Chal.EditApproximation.localInitialConeCenters : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      ℚ →
        (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
          Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) :=
fun {n} N P A U q =>
  List.flatMap
    (fun b =>
      List.filter (fun r => decide (↑b / 2 ≤ ↑(U r) ∧ ↑(U r) ≤ 4 * A * ↑b))
        (Chal.EditApproximation.localTargetStates n (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacing b P) (U q) q))
    (List.filter (fun b => decide (↑(U q) / (16 * A ^ 2) ≤ ↑b ∧ ↑b ≤ 4 * A * ↑(U q)))
      (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScales N))
def Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxWithWork : (n : ℕ) →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) × ℕ :=
fun n g radius lo hi =>
  have leftLow := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork lo radius;
  have leftHigh := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork lo radius;
  have rightLow := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork hi radius;
  have rightHigh := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork hi radius;
  have left :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsWithWork g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue leftLow.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue leftHigh.1);
  have right :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsWithWork g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue rightLow.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue rightHigh.1);
  have states :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
      (fun s => Chal.EditApproximation.filterMapWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateWithWork n s) right.1) left.1;
  (states.1, leftLow.2 + leftHigh.2 + rightLow.2 + rightHigh.2 + left.2 + right.2 + states.2 + 6)
def Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChildWithWork : {n M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n × ℕ :=
fun {n M} parent i =>
  have proof_bitWordValue_bits_15 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_19;
  have proof_bitOrdering_matches_4 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.invWithWork._proof_12;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_matches_5 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_lt_16 := ⋯;
  have proof_binaryNaturalCompareWithWork_lt_53 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitSubtractor_value_17 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_8;
  have proof_bitSubtractionRippleEquation_18 := Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChildWithWork._proof_7;
  have proof_bitSubtractWithWork_value_19 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitWordValue_lt_pow_length_20 := Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChildWithWork._proof_8;
  have proof_bitSubtractWithWork_length_21 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_16;
  have proof_bitSubtractWithWork_sub_22 := ⋯;
  have proof_binaryNaturalSubtractWithWork_value_54 := ⋯;
  have proof_saturatingSubtractWithWork_value_50 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitAdder_value_1 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineParametersWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_bitAddWithWork_value_2 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitMulWithWork_value_0 := ⋯;
  have proof_binaryNaturalMulWithWork_value_55 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitDivModWithWork_value_23 := ⋯;
  have proof_binaryNaturalDivModWithWork_spec_24 := ⋯;
  have proof_binaryNaturalAddWithWork_value_52 := ⋯;
  have proof_balancedCutWithWork_value_51 := ⋯;
  let width := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork parent.hi parent.lo;
  let next := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (↑i) 1;
  let left := Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCutWithWork parent.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue width.1) M ↑i;
  let right :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCutWithWork parent.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue width.1) M
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue next.1);
  have heql := ⋯;
  have heqh := ⋯;
  ({ lo := Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue left.1, hi := Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue right.1, ordered := ⋯,
      valid := ⋯ },
    width.2 + next.2 + left.2 + right.2 + 4)

def Chal.EditApproximation.groupRoundedStateList.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →

def Chal.EditApproximation.queryGapStatesWithWork : (n : ℕ) →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) × ℕ :=
fun n g anchor radius sourceLength gapRadius =>
  have lo := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork anchor radius;
  have hi := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork anchor radius;
  have left :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsWithWork g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lo.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue hi.1);
  have states :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
      (fun first =>
        have center := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork first sourceLength;
        have lower :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue center.1) gapRadius;
        have upper :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue center.1) gapRadius;
        have right :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsWithWork g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower.1)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue upper.1);
        have valid :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.filterMapWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateWithWork n first) right.1;
        (valid.1, center.2 + lower.2 + upper.2 + right.2 + valid.2 + 4))
      left.1;
  (states.1, lo.2 + hi.2 + left.2 + states.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryOnlineKeyEqualWithWork : {n : ℕ} →

fun {n} a b =>
  have scale := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork a.1 b.1;
  have state := Chal.EditApproximation.queryIntervalEqualWithWork a.2 b.2;
  (scale.1 && state.1, scale.2 + state.2 + 1)

def Chal.EditApproximation.refinementParameterWordsWithWork : ℕ →
  ℕ →
    (word : List Bool) →
      0 < Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue word → Chal.EditApproximation.RefinementParameterWords × ℕ :=

    online.2 + factor.2 + decrement.2 + 5)

def Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun n g radius lo hi =>
  have leftLow := (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork lo radius).1;
  have leftHigh := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork lo radius).1;
  have rightLow := (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork hi radius).1;
  have rightHigh := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork hi radius).1;
  have left :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsWithWork g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue leftLow)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue leftHigh)).1;
  have right :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsWithWork g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue rightLow)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue rightHigh)).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation lo radius +
              Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation lo radius +
            Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation hi radius +
          Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation hi radius +
        Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsAllocation g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue leftLow)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue leftHigh) +
      Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsAllocation g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue rightLow)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue rightHigh) +
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation
      (fun s => Chal.EditApproximation.filterMapWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateWithWork n s) right)
      (fun s =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.filterMapAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateWithWork n s)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateAllocation n s) right)
      left

def Chal.EditApproximation.queryGapStatesAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun n g anchor radius sourceLength gapRadius =>
  have lo := (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork anchor radius).1;
  have hi := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork anchor radius).1;
  have left :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsWithWork g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lo)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue hi)).1;
  have build := fun first =>
    have center := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork first sourceLength;
    have lower :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue center.1) gapRadius;
    have upper :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue center.1) gapRadius;
    have right :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsWithWork g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower.1)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue upper.1);
    have valid := Chal.EditApproximation.filterMapWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateWithWork n first) right.1;
    (valid.1, center.2 + lower.2 + upper.2 + right.2 + valid.2 + 4);
  have allocation := fun first =>
    have center := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork first sourceLength).1;
    have lower :=
      (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue center) gapRadius).1;
    have upper :=
      (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue center) gapRadius).1;
    have right :=
      (Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsWithWork g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue upper)).1;
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation first sourceLength +
            Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue center) gapRadius +
          Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue center) gapRadius +
        Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsAllocation g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lower)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue upper) +
      Chal.EditApproximation.filterMapAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateWithWork n first)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateAllocation n first) right;
  Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation anchor radius +
        Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation anchor radius +
      Chal.EditApproximation.gridPointsAllocation g (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue lo)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue hi) +
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation build allocation left

def Chal.EditApproximation.localInitialConeTable.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →

def Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildGridWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →

  have child := Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChildWithWork parent i;

  have leftOffset := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork child.1.lo parent.lo;
  have rightOffset := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork child.1.hi parent.lo;
  have left := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork r.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue leftOffset.1);
  have right :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork r.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue rightOffset.1);
  have grid :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxWithWork ny (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius.1) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue left.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue right.1);

def Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildGridAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →

    (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork r.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue leftOffset)).1;
  have right :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork r.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue rightOffset)).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChildAllocation parent i + Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingAllocation b P +
              Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation 10 b +
            Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation child.lo parent.lo +
          Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation child.hi parent.lo +
        Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation r.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue leftOffset) +
      Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation r.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue rightOffset) +
    Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxAllocation ny (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue left)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue right)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandEnvelopeReadWithWork : {M n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {M n} b band read i =>
  have values := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun action => read i (action i)) band;
  have floor := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b).divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M);
  have maximum := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero.maximumWithWork values.1;
  have input := floor.1.maxWithWork maximum.1;
  have result := input.1.dyadicCeilingWithWork;
  (result.1, values.2 + floor.2 + maximum.2 + input.2 + result.2 + band.length + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineLinearReadWithWork.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} →
    (β → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
      (ℕ → β × σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → β × σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {β} {σ} mass read eta kappa t i =>
  have coefficient := kappa.coefficientWithWork;
  have terms :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.vectorMapWithWork t fun s =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.optimisticTermReadWithWork mass read coefficient.1 (↑s) i;
  have history := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandMassTotalWithWork terms.1;
  have current := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gainReadWithWork mass read t i;
  have total := history.1.canonicalAddWithWork current.1;
  have result := eta.canonicalMulWithWork total.1;
  (result.1, coefficient.2 + terms.2 + history.2 + current.2 + total.2 + result.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.targetCellsWithWork : {n : ℕ} →

    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandCoordinatesWithWork : {M n : ℕ} →

  have unique := Chal.EditApproximation.dedupByWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.coordinateEqualWithWork raw.1;
  (unique.1, raw.2 + unique.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedBandCoordinateWithWork : {M n : ℕ} →
  Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) →
        Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {M n} mass total action coordinate =>
  have test := Chal.EditApproximation.coordinateEqualWithWork coordinate (coordinate.1, action coordinate.1);
  have result :=
    if test.1 = true then (mass.get coordinate.1).divWithWork total
    else (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero, 1);
  (result.1, test.2 + result.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.representativeScaleReadWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
        (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
          List Bool →
            Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ → List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) × ℕ :=

  have b := 2 ^ e;
  have spacing := Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork b P;
  have points :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxWithWork n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) query.lo query.hi;
  have selected :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.filterWithWork
      (fun r =>
        have word := read r;
        have guard := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.centerEligibilityWithWork b F a word.1;
        (guard.1, guard.2 + word.2))
      points.1;
  have labeled := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun r => ((b, r), 1)) selected.1;
  (labeled.1, spacing.2 + points.2 + selected.2 + labeled.2 + e + 5)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupRoundedStatesWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    ℕ →
      ℕ → ℕ × ℕ → Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent b exponent cell i h =>
  have theta := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent;
  have spacing := theta.roundedSpacingWithWork h;
  have child := Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChildWithWork parent i;
  have offset := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork child.1.lo parent.lo;
  have base := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat cell.1).canonicalMulWithWork theta;
  have position := base.1.canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b);
  have floor := position.1.naturalFloorWithWork;
  have anchor :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue floor.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue offset.1);
  have radius := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork 12 b;
  have length := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork child.1.hi child.1.lo;
  have twice := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulWithWork h;
  have gap := twice.1.naturalCeilingWithWork;
  have states :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.queryGapStatesWithWork ny (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue anchor.1) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius.1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue length.1) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue gap.1);
  (states.1,
    spacing.2 + child.2 + offset.2 + base.2 + position.2 + floor.2 + anchor.2 + radius.2 + length.2 + twice.2 + gap.2 +
          states.2 +
        exponent +
      12)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryParentReadWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) →
    List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=

  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gatheredWordLookupWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.queryIntervalEqualWithWork

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialGridReadWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
      (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List Bool × ℕ) →
        ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) × ℕ :=
fun {n} P A read radius q b =>
  have spacing := Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork b P;
  have points :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxWithWork n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing.1) radius q.lo q.hi;
  have selected :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.filterWithWork
      (fun r =>
        have word := read r;
        have guard :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialCenterGuardWithWork b
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue word.1) A;
        (guard.1, guard.2 + word.2))
      points.1;
  (selected.1, spacing.2 + points.2 + selected.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryInitialConeCentersWithWork : {n : ℕ} →

    ℕ →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius.1) q.lo q.hi;

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.anchorGuardAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ → (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → Fin M → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r b states i =>
  have left :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.translatedEndpointWithWork r.lo parent.lo
        (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).lo).1;
  have right :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.translatedEndpointWithWork r.lo parent.lo
        (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).hi).1;
  have radius := Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork 6 b).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.translatedEndpointAllocation r.lo parent.lo (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).lo +
          Chal.EditApproximation.translatedEndpointAllocation r.lo parent.lo
            (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).hi +
        Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation 6 b +
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalDistanceLeAllocation left (states i).lo radius +
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalDistanceLeAllocation right (states i).hi radius
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandEnvelopeReadAllocation : {M n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) → Fin M → ℕ :=
fun {M n} b band read footprint i =>
  have values := (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun action => read i (action i)) band).1;
  have floor :=
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b).divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M)).1;
  have maximum := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero.maximumWithWork values).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun action => footprint i (action i)) band +
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b).divAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M) +
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero.maximumAllocation values +
        floor.maxAllocation maximum +
      (floor.maxWithWork maximum).1.dyadicCeilingAllocation +
    0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.targetCellsAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=

  have left := (side.cellCoordinatesWithWork q.lo radius).1;

      (fun lo => Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun hi => ((lo, hi), 1)) right)
      (fun x => Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun x => 1) right) left

      (fun lo => Chal.EditApproximation.filterMapWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateWithWork n lo) right)
      (fun lo =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.filterMapAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateWithWork n lo)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.makeStateAllocation n lo) right)
      left
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryRawCentersAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=

      Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxWithWork n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing.1)

    (states.1, spacing.2 + states.2 + 1);

      Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxAllocation n
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork b P).1)

    (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork build
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryScalesWithWork N F a value).1).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryScalesAllocation N F a value + value.naturalCeilingAllocation +
      Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation build allocation
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryScalesWithWork N F a value).1 +
    Chal.EditApproximation.queryEraseAllocation Chal.EditApproximation.queryIntervalEqualWithWork
      Chal.EditApproximation.queryIntervalEqualAllocation centers
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryOnlineKeysAllocation : {n : ℕ} →

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.representativeScaleReadAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
        (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
          (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) → List Bool → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun {n} P F a read allocation radius query e =>
  have b := 2 ^ e;
  have spacing := (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork b P).1;
  have points :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxWithWork n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) query.lo query.hi).1;
  have test := fun r =>
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.centerEligibilityWithWork b F a (read r).1).1,
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.centerEligibilityWithWork b F a (read r).1).2 + (read r).2);
  have selected := (Chal.EditApproximation.filterWithWork test points).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingAllocation b P +
            Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxAllocation n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing)
              (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) query.lo query.hi +
          Chal.EditApproximation.filterAllocation test
            (fun r => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.centerEligibilityAllocation b F a (read r).1 + allocation r)
            points +
        Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun x => 1) selected +
      e +
    1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryWideInputsAllocation : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx → ℕ → List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M parent P representatives =>
  have build := fun br =>
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
      (fun i =>
        have states := Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildGridWithWork parent br.2 br.1 P i;
        have labeled := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun r => ((i, r), 1)) states.1;
        (labeled.1, states.2 + labeled.2 + 1))
      (List.finRange M);
  have one := fun br i =>
    Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildGridAllocation parent br.2 br.1 P i +
      Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun x => 1)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildGridWithWork parent br.2 br.1 P i).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation build
        (fun br =>
          Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation
            (fun i =>
              have states := Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildGridWithWork parent br.2 br.1 P i;
              have labeled := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun r => ((i, r), 1)) states.1;
              (labeled.1, states.2 + labeled.2 + 1))
            (one br) (List.finRange M))
        representatives +
      Chal.EditApproximation.queryEraseAllocation Chal.EditApproximation.coordinateEqualWithWork
        Chal.EditApproximation.coordinateEqualAllocation
        (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork build representatives).1 +
    M
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryRawHistoryInputsAllocation : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx → ℕ → ℕ → List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M parent P history representatives =>
  have child := fun br i =>
    have states := Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildGridWithWork parent br.2 br.1 P i;
    have times :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
        (fun t => Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun r => ((i, t, r), 1)) states.1) (List.range history);
    (times.1, states.2 + times.2 + history + 2);
  have one := fun br i =>
    Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildGridAllocation parent br.2 br.1 P i + history +
      Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation
        (fun t =>
          Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun r => ((i, t, r), 1))
            (Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildGridWithWork parent br.2 br.1 P i).1)
        (fun x =>
          Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun x => 1)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildGridWithWork parent br.2 br.1 P i).1)
        (List.range history);
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation
      (fun br => Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork (child br) (List.finRange M))
      (fun br => Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation (child br) (one br) (List.finRange M))
      representatives +
    M
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupRoundedStatesAllocation : {nx : ℕ} →
  {ny : ℕ} →
    {M : ℕ} →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ → Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent b exponent cell i h =>
  have theta := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent;
  have spacing := (theta.roundedSpacingWithWork h).1;
  have child := (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChildWithWork parent i).1;
  have offset := (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork child.lo parent.lo).1;
  have base := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat cell.1).canonicalMulWithWork theta).1;
  have position := (base.canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b)).1;
  have floor := position.naturalFloorWithWork.1;
  have anchor :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue floor)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue offset)).1;
  have radius := (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork 12 b).1;
  have length := (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork child.hi child.lo).1;
  have twice := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulWithWork h).1;
  have gap := twice.naturalCeilingWithWork.1;
  theta.roundedSpacingAllocation h + Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChildAllocation parent i +
                          Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation child.lo parent.lo +
                        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat cell.1).canonicalMulAllocation theta +
                      base.canonicalMulAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b) +
                    position.naturalFloorAllocation +
                  Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue floor)
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue offset) +
                Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulAllocation 12 b +
              Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation child.hi child.lo +
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulAllocation h +
          twice.naturalCeilingAllocation +
        Chal.EditApproximation.queryGapStatesAllocation ny (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue anchor) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue length) (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue gap) +
      exponent +
    2

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineLinearReadAllocation.{u_1, u_2} : {β : Type u_1} →
  {σ : Type u_2} →
    (β → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
      (ℕ → β × σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        (ℕ → β × σ → ℕ) →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → β × σ → ℕ :=
fun {β} {σ} mass read footprint eta kappa t i =>
  have coefficient := kappa.coefficientWithWork.1;
  have terms :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.vectorMapWithWork t fun s =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.optimisticTermReadWithWork mass read coefficient (↑s) i).1;
  have history := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandMassTotalWithWork terms).1;
  have current := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gainReadWithWork mass read t i).1;
  (kappa.coefficientAllocation +
              Chal.EditApproximation.vectorMapAllocation t fun s =>
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.optimisticTermReadAllocation mass read footprint coefficient (↑s)
                  i) +
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandMassAllocation terms +
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gainReadAllocation mass read footprint t i +
        history.canonicalAddAllocation current +
      eta.canonicalMulAllocation (history.canonicalAddWithWork current).1 +
    0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedBandCoordinateAllocation : {M n : ℕ} →

      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=

  Chal.EditApproximation.coordinateEqualAllocation coordinate (coordinate.1, action coordinate.1) +
    if (Chal.EditApproximation.coordinateEqualWithWork coordinate (coordinate.1, action coordinate.1)).1 = true then
      (mass.get coordinate.1).divAllocation total
    else 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryInitialConeCentersAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} N P A value q =>
  have radius := value.naturalCeilingWithWork.1;
  have active :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.filterWithWork
        (fun b =>
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialScaleGuardWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) b
            A)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScalesWithWork N).1).1;
  have build := fun b =>
    have spacing := (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork b P).1;

      Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxWithWork n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) q.lo q.hi;
    (states.1, (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork b P).2 + states.2 + 1);
  value.naturalCeilingAllocation + Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScalesAllocation N +
      Chal.EditApproximation.filterAllocation
        (fun b =>
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialScaleGuardWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) b
            A)
        (fun b =>
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialScaleGuardAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius)
            b A)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScalesWithWork N).1 +
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation build
      (fun b =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingAllocation b P +
          Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxAllocation n
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork b P).1)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) q.lo q.hi)
      active
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.connectionWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

      List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.envelopeVectorReadWithWork : {M n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanActionReadWithWork.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (Parent → Parent → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          (Child → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
            Parent →
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {Parent} {Child} {M} distance L read query action =>
  have words := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun i => read (action.childState i)) (List.finRange M);
  have dist := distance query action.center;
  have spatial := L.canonicalMulWithWork dist.1;
  have connection := spatial.1.canonicalAddWithWork action.connection;
  have children := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListWithWork words.1;
  have result := connection.1.canonicalAddWithWork children.1;
  (result.1, words.2 + dist.2 + spatial.2 + connection.2 + children.2 + result.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellCentersReadWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
              ℕ × ℕ → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) × ℕ :=
fun {n} P F b a theta initial cell =>
  have spacing := Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork b P;
  have side := theta.canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b);
  have states :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellStatesWithWork n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing.1) side.1
      cell;
  have selected :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.filterWithWork
      (fun r =>
        have word := initial r;
        have tested := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.centerEligibilityWithWork b F a word.1;
        (tested.1, word.2 + tested.2))
      states.1;
  (selected.1, spacing.2 + side.2 + states.2 + selected.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedBandVerticesWithWork : {M n d : ℕ} →

        ((action, vertex.1), vertex.2))
      band;
  (List.map Prod.fst vertices, total.2 + (List.map Prod.snd vertices).sum + 8 * band.length)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineIndexSetupWithWork : {M n : ℕ} →

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeysWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryInitialSeedReadWithWork : {n : ℕ} →

      List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) →
        List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List Bool × ℕ :=

  have test := Chal.EditApproximation.queryIntervalEqualWithWork r q;
  if test.1 = true then
    have result := value.naturalCeilingWithWork;

    have found := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryParentReadWithWork keys words r;
    have result := found.1.naturalCeilingWithWork;
    (result.1, test.2 + found.2 + result.2 + 1)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.selectGroupAllocation.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  List ι → (ι → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) → (ι → ℕ) → ℕ :=

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanActionReadAllocation.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (Parent → Parent → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        (Parent → Parent → ℕ) →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            (Child → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
              (Child → ℕ) → Parent → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M → ℕ :=
fun {Parent} {Child} {M} distance distanceAllocation L read footprint query action =>
  have words :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun i => read (action.childState i)) (List.finRange M)).1;
  have dist := (distance query action.center).1;
  have spatial := (L.canonicalMulWithWork dist).1;
  have connection := (spatial.canonicalAddWithWork action.connection).1;
  have children := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListWithWork words).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun i => footprint (action.childState i)) (List.finRange M) +
            distanceAllocation query action.center +
          L.canonicalMulAllocation dist +
        spatial.canonicalAddAllocation action.connection +
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListAllocation words +
    connection.canonicalAddAllocation children

                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandMassTotalWithWork mass).1 action (coordinates.get i))
          band).sum +
    4 * band.length

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixReadWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
        (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
          ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r states read j p =>
  have words :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (fun i => if ↑i < j then read i (states i) else (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero, 1))
      (List.finRange M);
  have finish :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat
          (Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCut parent.lo (parent.hi - parent.lo) M j)).canonicalAddWithWork
      p;
  have connection :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.lo).connectionWithWork finish.1 (List.take j (List.ofFn states));
  have total := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListWithWork words.1;
  have result := connection.1.canonicalAddWithWork total.1;
  (result.1,
    words.2 + finish.2 + connection.2 + total.2 + result.2 +
            (Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCut parent.lo (parent.hi - parent.lo) M j).size +
          r.lo.size +
        6 * M +
      5)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanReadWithWork.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (Parent → Parent → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            (Child → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
              Parent →
                List (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M) →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {Parent} {Child} {M} distance L fallback read query actions =>
  have scores :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanActionReadWithWork distance L read query) actions;
  have result := fallback.minimumWithWork scores.1;
  (result.1, scores.2 + result.2 + 1)
