  (inputs.1, representatives.2 + inputs.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointConnectionAllocation : {n M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → ℕ :=
fun {n M} r states =>
  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.lo).connectionAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.hi)
          (List.ofFn states) +
        r.lo.size +
      r.hi.size +
    M
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixReadAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
        (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
          (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r states read allocation j p =>
  have words :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
        (fun i => if ↑i < j then read i (states i) else (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero, 1))
        (List.finRange M)).1;
  have finish :=
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat
            (Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCut parent.lo (parent.hi - parent.lo) M j)).canonicalAddWithWork
        p).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun i => if ↑i < j then allocation i (states i) else 0)
                  (List.finRange M) +
                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCut parent.lo (parent.hi - parent.lo) M j)).canonicalAddAllocation
                  p +
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.lo).connectionAllocation finish
                (List.take j (List.ofFn states)) +
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListAllocation words +
          ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.lo).connectionWithWork finish
                  (List.take j (List.ofFn states))).1.canonicalAddAllocation
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListWithWork words).1 +
        (Chal.EditApproximation.balancedCut parent.lo (parent.hi - parent.lo) M j).size +
      r.lo.size +
    2 * M
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.optimizerAllocation : {d : ℕ} →
  List (Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d) → Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun {d} vertices linear G x =>
  Nat.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.optimizerAllocation._f vertices linear G)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryEarlierRepresentativesAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (P : ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          0 < P →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} N P F exponent hP a initial allocation q =>
  have groups := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeysWithWork N F exponent a (initial q).1 q).1;
  have build := fun key =>
    have centers :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellCentersReadWithWork P F key.1 a
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) initial key.2;
    have labeled := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun r => ((key.1, r), 1)) centers.1;
    (labeled.1, centers.2 + labeled.2 + 1);
  allocation q + Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localRepresentativeReadAllocation N P F a initial allocation q +
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeysAllocation N F exponent a (initial q).1 q +
          Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation build
            (fun key =>
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellCentersReadAllocation P F key.1 a
                  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) initial allocation key.2 +
                Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun x => 1)
                  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellCentersReadWithWork P F key.1 a
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) initial key.2).1)
            groups +
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryOnlineKeysAllocation N P F hP a (initial q).1 q +
      2 * (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localRepresentativeReadWithWork N P F a initial q).1.length +
    (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork build groups).1.length
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryWarmupInputsAllocation : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M parent N P F a initial allocation q =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localRepresentativeReadAllocation N P F a initial allocation q +
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryWideInputsAllocation M parent P
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localRepresentativeReadWithWork N P F a initial q).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanReadAllocation.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (Parent → Parent → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        (Parent → Parent → ℕ) →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Child → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                (Child → ℕ) → Parent → List (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M) → ℕ :=
fun {Parent} {Child} {M} distance distanceAllocation L fallback read footprint query actions =>
  have scores :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanActionReadWithWork distance L read query) actions).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanActionReadAllocation distance distanceAllocation L read footprint
        query)
      actions +
    fallback.minimumAllocation scores
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixMinimumReadWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
        actions ≠ [] →
          (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
            ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r actions hne read j p =>
  have fallback := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixReadWithWork parent r (actions.head hne) read j p;
  have scores :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (fun action => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixReadWithWork parent r action read j p) actions;
  have result := fallback.1.minimumWithWork scores.1;
  (result.1, fallback.2 + scores.2 + result.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localContinuationReadWithWork.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (Parent → Parent → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Child → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                (Child → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                  Parent →
                    List (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M) →
                      List (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M) →
                        List (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M) →
                          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {Parent} {Child} {M} distance L delta fallback old current query wide groups online =>
  have warm := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanReadWithWork distance L fallback old query wide;
  have cone := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanReadWithWork distance L warm.1 current query groups;
  have scores :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanActionReadWithWork distance L current query) online;
  have onlineMin := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineMinimumWithWork scores.1;
  have result := delta.refinementUpdateWithWork cone.1 onlineMin.1;
  (result.1, warm.2 + cone.2 + scores.2 + onlineMin.2 + result.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixMinimumReadAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
        actions ≠ [] →
          (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
            (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r actions hne read allocation j p =>
  have fallback := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixReadWithWork parent r (actions.head hne) read j p).1;
  have scores :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
        (fun action => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixReadWithWork parent r action read j p) actions).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixReadAllocation parent r (actions.head hne) read allocation j p +
      Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation
        (fun action => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixReadAllocation parent r action read allocation j p)
        actions +
    fallback.minimumAllocation scores
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localContinuationReadAllocation.{u_1, u_2} : {Parent : Type u_1} →
  {Child : Type u_2} →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (Parent → Parent → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        (Parent → Parent → ℕ) →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                (Child → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                  (Child → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                    (Child → ℕ) →
                      (Child → ℕ) →
                        Parent →
                          List (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M) →
                            List (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M) →
                              List (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction Parent Child M) → ℕ :=
fun {Parent} {Child} {M} distance distanceAllocation L delta fallback old current oldAllocation currentAllocation query
    wide groups online =>
  have warm := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanReadWithWork distance L fallback old query wide).1;
  have cone := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanReadWithWork distance L warm current query groups).1;
  have scores :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanActionReadWithWork distance L current query) online).1;
  have onlineMin := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineMinimumWithWork scores).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanReadAllocation distance distanceAllocation L fallback old oldAllocation
            query wide +
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanReadAllocation distance distanceAllocation L warm current
            currentAllocation query groups +
        Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanActionReadAllocation distance distanceAllocation L current
            currentAllocation query)
          online +
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineMinimumAllocation scores +
    delta.refinementUpdateAllocation cone onlineMin
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointActionAllocation : {ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → ℕ :=
fun {ny M} center states => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointConnectionAllocation center states + M + 1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.selectionAllocation.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {d : ℕ} →
    List (α × Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d) →
      Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction d → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun {α} {d} vertices linear G j =>
  have iterate :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.finiteOptimizerWithWork (List.map Prod.snd vertices) linear G j).1;
  have gradient := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gradientWithWork G linear iterate).1;
  vertices.length + Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.optimizerAllocation (List.map Prod.snd vertices) linear G j +
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gradientAllocation G linear iterate +
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scoredArgmaxAllocation
      (fun vertex => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.dotWithWork gradient vertex.2)
      (fun vertex => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.dotListAllocation gradient vertex.2 (List.finRange d))
      vertices
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cutGuardReadWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
        actions ≠ [] →
          (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
            (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Fin M → Bool × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r actions hne read states velocity tolerance j =>
  if ↑j = 0 then (true, 1)
  else
    have shift :=
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (states j).lo).subWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent j).lo);
    have offset :=
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.lo).subWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat parent.lo);
    have prediction :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixMinimumReadWithWork parent r actions hne read (↑j) shift.1;
    have result := shift.1.affineErrorWithWork offset.1 velocity prediction.1 tolerance;
    (result.1,
      shift.2 + offset.2 + prediction.2 + result.2 + (states j).lo.size +
              (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent j).lo.size +
            r.lo.size +
          parent.lo.size +
        5)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cutGuardReadAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
        actions ≠ [] →
          (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
            (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) →
              (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Fin M → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r actions hne read allocation states velocity tolerance j =>
  if ↑j = 0 then 0
  else
    have shift :=
      ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (states j).lo).subWithWork
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent j).lo)).1;
    have offset :=
      ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.lo).subWithWork
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat parent.lo)).1;
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (states j).lo).subAllocation
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent j).lo) +
                  (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.lo).subAllocation
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat parent.lo) +
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixMinimumReadAllocation parent r actions hne read allocation
                  (↑j) shift +
              shift.affineErrorAllocation offset velocity
                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.prefixMinimumReadWithWork parent r actions hne read (↑j) shift).1
                tolerance +
            (states j).lo.size +
          (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent j).lo.size +
        r.lo.size +
      parent.lo.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandPredicateReadAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      ℕ →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
                actions ≠ [] →
                  (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) →
                      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r b tau theta velocity actions hne read allocation states =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.zeroConnectionAllocation r.lo (List.ofFn states) r.hi + M +
        Chal.EditApproximation.allAllocation
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.anchorGuardAllocation parent r b states) (List.finRange M) +
      tau.bandToleranceAllocation theta b M +
    Chal.EditApproximation.allAllocation
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cutGuardReadAllocation parent r actions hne read allocation states velocity
        (tau.bandToleranceWithWork theta b M).1)
      (List.finRange M)

def Chal.EditApproximation.actionEqualWithWork : {n M : ℕ} →
  (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → Bool × ℕ :=
fun {n M} a b =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.allWithWork
    (fun i =>
      have left := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork (a i).lo (b i).lo;
      have right := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork (a i).hi (b i).hi;
      (left.1 && right.1, left.2 + right.2 + 1))
    (List.finRange M)
def Chal.EditApproximation.localRefinementRepresentatives : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        ℚ →
          (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℚ) →
            Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) :=
fun {n} N P F a initial q =>
  List.flatMap
    (fun b =>
      List.map (fun r => (b, r))
        (List.filter (fun r => decide (↑b / (4 * a) ≤ initial r ∧ initial r ≤ 8 * ↑F * ↑b))
          (Chal.EditApproximation.localTargetStates n (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacing b P) ⌈initial q⌉₊ q)))
    (List.filter (fun b => decide (initial q / (16 * ↑F) ≤ ↑b ∧ ↑b ≤ 8 * a * initial q))
      (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScales N))

def Chal.EditApproximation.wideEarlierInputCover : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
          Finset (Fin M × ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) :=
fun {nx ny M} parent P history representatives =>
  representatives.toFinset.biUnion fun br =>
    Finset.univ.biUnion fun i =>
      (Finset.range history).biUnion fun t =>
        Finset.image (fun r => (i, t, r)) (Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildStateList parent br.2 br.1 P i).toFinset
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryEarlierRepresentatives : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          ℚ →
            (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℚ) →
              Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) :=
fun {n} N P F exponent a initial q =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.localRefinementRepresentatives N P F a initial q ++
      List.flatMap
        (fun key =>
          List.map (fun r => (key.1, r))
            (Chal.EditApproximation.cellRepresentativeStates n P F key.1 a initial (2 ^ (-↑exponent)) key.2))
        (Chal.EditApproximation.localGroupQueryKeys N F exponent a initial q) ++
    List.map (fun b => (b, Chal.EditApproximation.roundInterval (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacing b P) q))
      (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicQueryWindow N (initial q) a ↑F)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalWidePrefixMinimum : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
        actions ≠ [] → (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℚ) → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r actions hnonempty child j p =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.rationalMinimum
    (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalWidePrefixCost parent r (actions.head hnonempty) child j p)
    (List.map (fun action => Chal.EditApproximation.rationalWidePrefixCost parent r action child j p) actions)
def Chal.EditApproximation.roundedBandAction : {ny M : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
        (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℚ) →
          (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny :=
fun {ny M} thetaExponent b band initial action i =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.roundInterval (Chal.EditApproximation.bandRoundSpacing thetaExponent b band initial i)
    (action i)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryEarlierInputCover : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℚ →
                (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℚ) →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                    Finset (Fin M × ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) :=
fun {nx ny M} parent N P F exponent history a initial q =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.wideEarlierInputCover parent P history
    (Chal.EditApproximation.queryEarlierRepresentatives N P F exponent a initial q)
def Chal.EditApproximation.canonicalRoundedBandAction : {ny M : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      (band : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
        band ≠ [] →
          (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℚ) → Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny :=
fun {ny M} thetaExponent b band hnonempty initial =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.roundedBandAction thetaExponent b band initial (band.head hnonempty)
def Chal.EditApproximation.parameterClogWithWork : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun n =>
  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.inputBitLengthWithWork (n - 1);
  (result.1, result.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.parameterLogWithWork : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun n =>
  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.inputBitLengthWithWork n;
  (result.1 - 1, result.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.parameterRootSearch : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun n x => Nat.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.parameterRootSearch._f n)
def Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun a x => Nat.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork._f a)
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalCoarseInputStorage : {M J : ℕ} →
  List ℕ → (target : List ℕ) → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J target.length → ℕ :=
fun {M J} source target entry =>
  have interval := Chal.EditApproximation.physicalSourceInterval source.length entry.1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.coarsePreparedInputStorage source target interval.lo interval.hi entry.2.lo entry.2.hi
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedQueryPassWithWork : ℕ →
  ℕ → (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × Chal.EditApproximation.RefinementParameterWords) × ℕ :=
fun N pass =>
  have proof_bitWordValue_bits_15 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_19;
  have seed := Chal.EditApproximation.scheduledSeedWordWithWork N pass;
  have parameters :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.refinementParameterWordsWithWork N pass (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N).bits ⋯;
  ((seed.1, parameters.1), seed.2 + parameters.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.storedIntegerBits : List ℤ → ℕ :=
fun values => 1 + (List.map (fun z => z.natAbs.size + 2) values).sum
def Chal.EditApproximation.parameterSqrtWithWork : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun n => Chal.EditApproximation.parameterRootSearch n n
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedQuerySetupWithWork : (N : ℕ) →
  (Vector (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × Chal.EditApproximation.RefinementParameterWords)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedPassCount N + 1) ×
      List Bool) ×
    ℕ :=
fun N =>
  have parameters :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.vectorMapWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedPassCount N + 1) fun i =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.computedQueryPassWithWork N ↑i;
  have base := Chal.EditApproximation.refinementBaseWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N).bits;
  ((parameters.1, base.1), parameters.2 + base.2 + 5)
def Chal.EditApproximation.integerParametersWithWork : ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.IntegerParameters × ℕ :=
fun N =>
  have first := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterClogWithWork (N + 2);
  have heightExponent := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterClogWithWork first.1;
  have height := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork 2 heightExponent.1;
  have smallExponent := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterClogWithWork (max 1 heightExponent.1);
  have small := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork 2 smallExponent.1;
  have logarithm := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterLogWithWork small.1;
  have firstRoot := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterSqrtWithWork logarithm.1;
  have secondRoot := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterSqrtWithWork firstRoot.1;
  have branching := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork 2 (heightExponent.1 / 20);
  have coarseBranching := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork height.1 secondRoot.1;
  have factor := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork height.1 (secondRoot.1 + 4);
  have grid := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork height.1 (secondRoot.1 + 20);
  have rounds := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork 2 ((3 * heightExponent.1 + 3) / 4);
  have spacingDenominator := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork small.1 2;
  ({ H := height.1, ell := small.1, p := secondRoot.1, B := coarseBranching.1, initialFactor := factor.1,
      M := branching.1, P := grid.1, T := rounds.1, S := height.1 / spacingDenominator.1 },
    first.2 + heightExponent.2 + height.2 + smallExponent.2 + small.2 + logarithm.2 + firstRoot.2 + secondRoot.2 +
                  branching.2 +
                coarseBranching.2 +
              factor.2 +
            grid.2 +
          rounds.2 +
        spacingDenominator.2 +
      15)
structure Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest (M J ny : ℕ) : Type
number of parameters: 3
fields:
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.pass : ℕ
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.copy : ℕ
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.node : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.index : ℕ
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.state : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny
constructor:
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.mk {M J ny : ℕ} (pass copy : ℕ)
    (node : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J) (index : ℕ) (state : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) :
    Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny
def Chal.EditApproximation.rawRefinementCenters : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) :=
fun {n} N P F a value q =>
  (List.flatMap
      (fun b => Chal.EditApproximation.localTargetStates n (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacing b P) ⌈value⌉₊ q)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicQueryWindow N value a ↑F)).eraseDups
def Chal.EditApproximation.wideWarmupInputs : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    ℕ → List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → List (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) :=
fun {nx ny M} parent P representatives =>
  (List.flatMap
      (fun br =>
        List.flatMap
          (fun i => List.map (fun r => (i, r)) (Chal.EditApproximation.wideChildStateList parent br.2 br.1 P i))
          (List.finRange M))
      representatives).eraseDups
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryMeanRead.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  (count : ℕ) →
    (Fin count → Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun {ι} count reader =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.charge (count + 1)
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.collect reader (List.ofFn fun i => i) fun words =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryMeanWithWork count words))
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalNodeCodeWithWork : {M J : ℕ} → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {M J} node =>
  have path := Chal.EditApproximation.treeLayerCodeWithWork M (↑node.fst) node.snd;
  have power := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork M J;
  (path.1 + power.1 * ↑node.fst, path.2 + power.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalParametersWithWork : ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.RationalParameters × ℕ :=
fun ell =>
  have fourth := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork ell 4;
  have fifth := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork ell 5;
  have tenth := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork ell 10;
  have twentieth := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork ell 20;
  have fortieth := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork ell 40;
  ({ F := ↑ell, initialSlope := 32 * ↑ell, coneSlope := 128 * ↑ell, delta := 1 / ↑tenth.1, kappa := 1 / ↑fourth.1,
      tau := 1 / ↑fourth.1, theta := 1 / ↑fortieth.1, gamma := 1 / ↑twentieth.1, eta := ↑fifth.1 },
    fourth.2 + fifth.2 + tenth.2 + twentieth.2 + fortieth.2 + 20)
def Chal.EditApproximation.onlineMassWithWork : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun M P H =>
  have width := 40 * P + 2;
  have square := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork width 2;
  have dimension := H + M * square.1 + 2;
  have rounds := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork dimension 80;
  (rounds.1 * (rounds.1 + 1) / 2, square.2 + rounds.2 + 9)
def Chal.EditApproximation.refinementInitialSupport : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) :=
fun {n} N P F exponent a value q =>
  q ::
    (Chal.EditApproximation.rawRefinementCenters N P F a value q ++
        List.flatMap
          (fun key =>
            Chal.EditApproximation.cellTargetStates n (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacing key.1 P)
              (2 ^ (-↑exponent) * ↑key.1) key.2)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.localGroupQueryKeys N F exponent a (fun x => value) q) ++
      List.map (fun b => Chal.EditApproximation.roundInterval (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacing b P) q)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicQueryWindow N value a ↑F))
def Chal.EditApproximation.refinementBandInputList : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            ℚ →
              (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℚ) →
                Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → List (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) :=
fun {nx ny M} parent N P F exponent a initial q =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.wideWarmupInputs parent P
    (Chal.EditApproximation.queryEarlierRepresentatives N P F exponent a initial q)
def Chal.EditApproximation.previousPassRequest : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny →
          Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny :=
fun {M J ny} T S copy parent state =>
  { pass := parent.pass - 1, copy := copy, node := parent.node, index := T + S, state := state }
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalEntryCodeWithWork : {M J n : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J n → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {M J n} entry =>
  have node := Chal.EditApproximation.physicalNodeCodeWithWork entry.1;
  have width := n + 1;
  (entry.2.lo + width * entry.2.hi + width * width * node.1, node.2 + 8)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryPhysicalBoundedWithWork : {M J n : ℕ} →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J n → Bool × ℕ :=
fun {M J n} passes copies T S request =>
  have pass := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork request.pass passes;
  have copy := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork request.copy copies;
  have cap := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork T S;
  have index := Chal.EditApproximation.wordLEWithWork request.index.bits cap.1;
  (decide (pass.1 = Ordering.lt) && decide (copy.1 = Ordering.lt) && index.1, pass.2 + copy.2 + cap.2 + index.2 + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.globalParameterWork : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun N =>
  (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParametersWithWork N).2 +
      (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalParametersWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N)).2 +
    (Chal.EditApproximation.onlineMassWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).M
        (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).P (Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N)).2
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalLargeInputWithWork : ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Bool × ℕ :=
fun N epsilon =>
  have inspected := Chal.EditApproximation.inspectAccuracyWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N) epsilon;
  if inspected.1.isSome = true then
    have product :=
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N)).canonicalMulWithWork epsilon;
    have accuracy := product.1.ltWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 10);
    have threshold :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N) (2 ^ 1000);
    have mass :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.onlineMassWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).M
        (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).P (Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N);
    have width := Chal.EditApproximation.inputBitLengthWithWork mass.1;
    have capacity := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N) width.1;
    (decide (threshold.1 ≠ Ordering.lt ∧ accuracy.1 ≠ true ∧ capacity.1 ≠ Ordering.lt),
      inspected.2 + product.2 + accuracy.2 + threshold.2 + mass.2 + width.2 + capacity.2 + 10)
  else (false, inspected.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalTableCodeAllocation : {M J n : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J n → ℕ :=
fun {M J n} request => 2 * ↑request.node.fst + 2 * J + 20
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryPhysicalBoundedAllocation : {M J n : ℕ} →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J n → ℕ :=
fun {M J n} passes copies T S request =>
  request.pass.bits.length + passes.bits.length + request.copy.bits.length + copies.bits.length +
      Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddAllocation T S +
    Chal.EditApproximation.naturalWordLEAllocation request.index.bits
      (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalAddWithWork T S).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalTableCodeWithWork : {M J n : ℕ} →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J n → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {M J n} copies T S request =>
  have entry := Chal.EditApproximation.physicalEntryCodeWithWork (request.node, request.state);
  have power := Chal.EditApproximation.parameterPowerWithWork M J;
  have capacity := (n + 1) * (n + 1) * (power.1 * (J + 1));
  (request.index + (T + S + 1) * (request.copy + copies * (entry.1 + capacity * request.pass)), entry.2 + power.2 + 15)
def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.remainingDepth : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny → ℕ :=
fun {M J ny} request => J - ↑request.node.fst
def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.rank : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny → ℕ :=
fun {M J ny} T S request => request.pass * (T + S + 1) + request.index
def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.Bounded : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny → Prop :=
fun {M J ny} passes copies T S request => request.pass < passes ∧ request.copy < copies ∧ request.index ≤ T + S
def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.warmup : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J →
        ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny :=
fun {M J ny} pass copy node j state => { pass := pass, copy := copy, node := node, index := j, state := state }
def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.refinement : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J →
        ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny :=
fun {M J ny} pass copy node T t state => { pass := pass, copy := copy, node := node, index := T + t, state := state }
def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.sameIndexChild : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  (request : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny) →
    ↑request.node.fst < J →
      Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny :=
fun {M J ny} request hbelow i state =>
  { pass := request.pass, copy := request.copy, node := Chal.EditApproximation.physicalChild request.node hbelow i,
    index := request.index, state := state }
def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny → ℕ :=
fun {M J ny} T S request => request.remainingDepth + Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.rank T S request
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupChildQuery : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  (pass copy T S t : ℕ) →
    (node : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J) →
      ↑node.fst < J →
        (q : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
          Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
            Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
              { child //
                Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.warmup pass copy node (t + 1) q) } :=
fun {M J ny} pass copy T S t node hbelow q input =>
  have proof_combinedRank_lt_of_progress_80 := @Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupChildQuery._proof_3;
  have proof_warmup_previous_child_progress_81 := ⋯;
  have proof_combinedRank_warmup_child_79 := ⋯;
  Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.read
    ⟨Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.warmup pass copy
        (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalChild node hbelow input.1) t input.2,
      ⋯⟩
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalRefinementCurrentQuery : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  (pass copy T S t : ℕ) →
    (node : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J) →
      ↑node.fst < J →
        (q : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
          Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
            Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
              { child //
                Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.refinement pass copy node T t q) } :=
fun {M J ny} pass copy T S t node hbelow q input =>
  have proof_combinedRank_lt_of_progress_80 := @Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupChildQuery._proof_3;
  have proof_sameIndexChild_progress_95 := ⋯;
  have proof_combinedRank_sameIndexChild_94 := ⋯;
  Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.read
    ⟨Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.refinement pass copy
        (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalChild node hbelow input.1) T t input.2,
      ⋯⟩
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalRefinementEarlierQuery : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  (pass copy T S t : ℕ) →
    (node : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J) →
      ↑node.fst < J →
        (q : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
          Fin M × ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
            Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
              { child //
                Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.refinement pass copy node T t q) } :=
fun {M J ny} pass copy T S t node hbelow q input =>
  have proof_combinedRank_lt_of_progress_80 := @Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupChildQuery._proof_3;
  have proof_refinement_history_child_progress_96 := ⋯;
  if hs : input.2.1 < t then
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.read
      ⟨Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.refinement pass copy
          (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalChild node hbelow input.1) T input.2.1 input.2.2,
        ⋯⟩
      Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
  else Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalRefinementWarmupRead : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  (pass copy T S t : ℕ) →
    0 < t →
      (node : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J) →
        (q : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
          (otherNode : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J) →
            ↑node.fst ≤ ↑otherNode.fst →
              (j : ℕ) →
                j ≤ T →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
                      { child //
                        Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                          Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S
                            (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.refinement pass copy node T t q) } :=
fun {M J ny} pass copy T S t ht node q otherNode hnode j hj r =>
  have proof_combinedRank_lt_of_progress_80 := @Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupChildQuery._proof_3;
  Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.read
    ⟨Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.warmup pass copy otherNode j r, ⋯⟩
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
def Chal.EditApproximation.previousPassRead : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  (T S : ℕ) →
    (parent : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny) →
      0 < parent.pass →
        Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
          ℕ →
            Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
              { child //
                Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S parent } :=
fun {M J ny} T S parent hpass state copy =>
  have proof_combinedRank_lt_of_progress_80 := @Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupChildQuery._proof_3;
  have proof_rank_lt_previous_pass_98 := @Chal.EditApproximation.previousPassRead._proof_2;
  have proof_previousPassRequest_progress_97 := ⋯;
  Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.read ⟨Chal.EditApproximation.previousPassRequest T S copy parent state, ⋯⟩
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
@[reducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Type :=
fun M J ny passes copies T S =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J ny ⊕
    { request // Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.Bounded passes copies T S request }
def Chal.EditApproximation.chargedPreviousPass : {M J ny passes copies T S : ℕ} →
  { r // Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.Bounded passes copies T S r } →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      Fin copies → { r // Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.Bounded passes copies T S r } :=
fun {M J ny passes copies T S} parent state copy =>
  ⟨Chal.EditApproximation.previousPassRequest T S (↑copy) (↑parent) state, ⋯⟩
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryPhysicalTableRead : {M J n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (T S : ℕ) →
      (parent : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J n) →
        { r //
            Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S r <
              Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S parent } →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery
            { r //
              Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S r <
                Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S parent }
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun {M J n} copies T S parent child =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.charge ((Chal.EditApproximation.physicalTableCodeWithWork copies T S ↑child).2 + 1)
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.read child Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.done)
@[reducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFamilyTableKey : List ℕ → List ℕ → ℕ → Type :=
fun source target N =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).M
    (Chal.EditApproximation.intervalTreeDepth (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).M source.length)
    target.length (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedPassCount N + 1) (Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N ^ 2)
    (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).T (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).S
def Chal.EditApproximation.chargedPhysicalCodeWithWork : {M J n passes copies T S : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest M J n passes copies T S → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {M J n passes copies T S} x =>
  match x with
  | Sum.inl entry =>
    have result := Chal.EditApproximation.physicalEntryCodeWithWork entry;
    (2 * result.1, result.2 + 2)
  | Sum.inr request =>
    have result := Chal.EditApproximation.physicalTableCodeWithWork copies T S ↑request;
    (2 * result.1 + 1, result.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryPhysicalWarmupRead : {M J n : ℕ} →

                  j ≤ T →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery
                        { child //
                          Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                            Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S
                              (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.refinement pass copy node T t q) }
                        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun {M J n} copies pass copy T S t ht node q otherNode hnode j hj r =>
  have proof_combinedRank_lt_of_progress_80 := @Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupChildQuery._proof_3;
  Chal.EditApproximation.queryPhysicalTableRead copies T S
    (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.refinement pass copy node T t q)
    ⟨Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.warmup pass copy otherNode j r, ⋯⟩

  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_matches_5 := ⋯;

  have proof_binaryNaturalCompareWithWork_lt_53 := ⋯;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.charge ((Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork input.2.1 t).2 + 1)
    (if hs : (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork input.2.1 t).1 = Ordering.lt then

def Chal.EditApproximation.integerClosedRange : ℤ → ℤ → List ℤ :=
fun lo hi => List.map (fun i => lo + ↑i) (List.range (hi - lo + 1).toNat)
def Chal.EditApproximation.groupSampleCount : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℕ :=
fun M Q b h => min M ⌈↑Q * ↑M * h / ↑b⌉₊
def Chal.EditApproximation.groupScaleTrueCost : {M : ℕ} → ℚ → (Fin M → ℚ) → (Fin M → ℚ) → ℚ :=
fun {M} h envelope value => ∑ i, if envelope i = h then value i else 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.selectGroupMember.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} → (members : List ι) → members ≠ [] → (ι → ℚ) → ι :=
fun {ι} members hnonempty estimate =>
  (List.argmax (fun member => -estimate member) members).getD (members.head hnonempty)
def Chal.EditApproximation.groupDyadicScales : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → List ℚ :=
fun M b F =>
  List.map (fun exponent => 2 ^ exponent)
    (Chal.EditApproximation.integerClosedRange (Int.clog 2 (↑b / ↑M)) (Int.log 2 (64 * F * ↑b)))
def Chal.EditApproximation.groupScaleEstimate : {M : ℕ} →
  (k : ℕ) → ℚ → (Fin M → ℚ) → (Fin M → ℚ) → (Fin k → Fin M) → ℚ :=
fun {M} k h envelope value draw =>
  if k = M then Chal.EditApproximation.groupScaleTrueCost h envelope value
  else ↑M / ↑k * ∑ j, if envelope (draw j) = h then value (draw j) else 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseDrawMeasure : (B : ℕ) →
  [NeZero B] →
    [inst : MeasurableSpace (Fin B)] →
      [MeasurableSingletonClass (Fin B)] →
        (D : ℕ) → MeasureTheory.Measure (Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B D) :=
fun B [NeZero B] [MeasurableSpace (Fin B)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Fin B)] x =>
  Nat.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseDrawMeasure._f B)
def Chal.EditApproximation.groupMemberEstimate : {M T : ℕ} →
  (Fin T → ℚ) →
    (count : Fin T → ℕ) → ℚ → (Fin M → ℚ) → (Fin M → ℚ) → ((scale : Fin T) → Fin (count scale) → Fin M) → ℚ :=
fun {M T} scales count connection envelope value draw =>
  connection +
    ∑ scale, Chal.EditApproximation.groupScaleEstimate (count scale) (scales scale) envelope value (draw scale)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupScalesWithWork : ℕ →
  ℕ → ℕ → List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun eM eb eF =>
  have exponents := Chal.EditApproximation.integerClosedRange (↑eb - ↑eM) ↑(6 + eF + eb);
  have values :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.signedPowerTwoWithWork exponents;
  (values.1, values.2 + exponents.length + eM.size + eb.size + eF.size + 8)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandPredicateReadWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      ℕ →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
                actions ≠ [] →
                  (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → Bool × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r b tau theta velocity actions hne read states =>
  have connection := Chal.EditApproximation.zeroConnectionWithWork r.lo (List.ofFn states) r.hi;
  have anchors :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.allWithWork
      (fun i =>
        have leftAnchor :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.translatedEndpointWithWork r.lo parent.lo
            (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).lo;
        have rightAnchor :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.translatedEndpointWithWork r.lo parent.lo
            (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).hi;
        have radius := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalMulWithWork 6 b;
        have left :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalDistanceLeWithWork leftAnchor.1 (states i).lo
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius.1);
        have right :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalDistanceLeWithWork rightAnchor.1 (states i).hi
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius.1);
        (left.1 && right.1, leftAnchor.2 + rightAnchor.2 + radius.2 + left.2 + right.2 + 3))
      (List.finRange M);
  have tolerance := tau.bandToleranceWithWork theta b M;
  have cuts :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.allWithWork
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cutGuardReadWithWork parent r actions hne read states velocity tolerance.1)
      (List.finRange M);
  (connection.1 && anchors.1 && cuts.1, connection.2 + anchors.2 + tolerance.2 + cuts.2 + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.indexedGroupScales : (raw : List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
  (M b : ℕ) →
    (F : ℚ) →
      List.map Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.value raw = Chal.EditApproximation.groupDyadicScales M b F →
        Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.groupDyadicScales M b F).length → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun raw M b F h i => raw.get ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryOnlineKeysWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (P : ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        0 < P →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) × ℕ :=
fun {n} N P F hP a value q =>
  have proof_bitOrdering_matches_4 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_matches_5 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_lt_16 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitSubtractor_value_17 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_8;
  have proof_bitSubtractionRippleEquation_18 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitSubtractWithWork_value_19 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitWordValue_lt_pow_length_20 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitSubtractWithWork_length_21 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_16;
  have proof_bitSubtractWithWork_sub_22 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitDivModWithWork_value_23 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitWordValue_bits_15 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_19;
  have proof_binaryNaturalDivModWithWork_spec_24 := ⋯;
  have proof_wordLEWithWork_value_26 := ⋯;
  have proof_seedGridSpacingWithWork_value_86 := ⋯;
  have proof_seedGridSpacingWithWork_pos_85 := ⋯;
  have scales := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryScalesWithWork N F a value;
  have keys :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (fun b =>
        let spacing := Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork b P;
        have center := Chal.EditApproximation.roundStateWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing.1) ⋯ q;
        ((b, center.1), spacing.2 + center.2 + 2))
      scales.1;
  (keys.1, scales.2 + keys.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupScalesAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun eM eb eF =>
  have exponents := Chal.EditApproximation.integerClosedRange (↑eb - ↑eM) ↑(6 + eF + eb);
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.signedPowerTwoAllocation
            exponents +
          exponents.length +
        eM.size +
      eb.size +
    eF.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandFromActionsReadWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      ℕ →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
                  actions ≠ [] → List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r b tau theta velocity read actions hne =>
  have margin := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.subWithWork tau;
  have guard := velocity.absolute.leWithWork margin.1;
  if guard.1 = true then
    have filtered :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.filterWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandPredicateReadWithWork parent r b tau theta velocity actions hne read)
        actions;
    (filtered.1, margin.2 + guard.2 + filtered.2 + 2)
  else ([], margin.2 + guard.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryInitialSupportWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (P : ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          0 < P →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) × ℕ :=
fun {n} N P F exponent hP a value q =>
  have raw := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryRawCentersWithWork N P F a value q;
  have groups := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeysWithWork N F exponent a value q;
  have cells :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
      (fun key =>
        have spacing := Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork key.1 P;
        have side :=
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent).canonicalMulWithWork
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat key.1);
        have states :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellStatesWithWork n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing.1)
            side.1 key.2;
        (states.1, spacing.2 + side.2 + states.2 + exponent + 3))
      groups.1;
  have online := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryOnlineKeysWithWork N P F hP a value q;
  have onlineStates := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun key => (key.2, 1)) online.1;
  (q :: (raw.1 ++ cells.1 ++ onlineStates.1),
    raw.2 + groups.2 + cells.2 + online.2 + onlineStates.2 + 2 * raw.1.length + cells.1.length + 5)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryEarlierRepresentativesWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (P : ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          0 < P →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) × ℕ :=
fun {n} N P F exponent hP a initial q =>
  have query := initial q;
  have reps := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localRepresentativeReadWithWork N P F a initial q;
  have groups := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeysWithWork N F exponent a query.1 q;
  have cells :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
      (fun key =>
        have centers :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellCentersReadWithWork P F key.1 a
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) initial key.2;
        have labeled := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun r => ((key.1, r), 1)) centers.1;
        (labeled.1, centers.2 + labeled.2 + 1))
      groups.1;
  have online := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryOnlineKeysWithWork N P F hP a query.1 q;
  (reps.1 ++ cells.1 ++ online.1,
    query.2 + reps.2 + groups.2 + cells.2 + online.2 + 2 * reps.1.length + cells.1.length + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandFromActionsReadAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      ℕ →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) →
                  (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) → actions ≠ [] → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r b tau theta velocity read allocation actions hne =>
  have margin := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.subWithWork tau).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one.subAllocation tau + velocity.absolute.leAllocation margin +
    if (velocity.absolute.leWithWork margin).1 = true then
      Chal.EditApproximation.filterAllocation
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandPredicateReadWithWork parent r b tau theta velocity actions hne read)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandPredicateReadAllocation parent r b tau theta velocity actions hne
          read allocation)
        actions
    else 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryInitialSupportAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (P : ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          0 < P →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} N P F exponent hP a value q =>
  have raw := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryRawCentersWithWork N P F a value q).1;
  have groups := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeysWithWork N F exponent a value q).1;
  have build := fun key =>
    have spacing := Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork key.1 P;
    have side :=
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent).canonicalMulWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat key.1);
    have states :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellStatesWithWork n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing.1) side.1
        key.2;
    (states.1, spacing.2 + side.2 + states.2 + exponent + 3);
  have cells := (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork build groups).1;
  have online := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryOnlineKeysWithWork N P F hP a value q).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryRawCentersAllocation N P F a value q +
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeysAllocation N F exponent a value q +
              Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation build
                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialCellAllocation n P exponent) groups +
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryOnlineKeysAllocation N P F hP a value q +
          Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun x => 1) online +
        2 * raw.length +
      cells.length +
    1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryBandInputsWithWork : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  (M : ℕ) →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
      ℕ →
        (P : ℕ) →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              0 < P →
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                  (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                      List (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M parent N P F exponent hP a initial q =>
  have representatives :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryEarlierRepresentativesWithWork N P F exponent hP a initial q;
  have inputs := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryWideInputsWithWork M parent P representatives.1;
  (inputs.1, representatives.2 + inputs.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryEarlierInputsWithWork : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  (M : ℕ) →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
      ℕ →
        (P : ℕ) →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                0 < P →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                        List (Fin M × ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M parent N P F exponent history hP a initial q =>
  have representatives :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryEarlierRepresentativesWithWork N P F exponent hP a initial q;
  have raw := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryRawHistoryInputsWithWork M parent P history representatives.1;
  have ordered := Chal.EditApproximation.queryOrderedHistoryInputsWithWork raw.1;
  (ordered.1, representatives.2 + raw.2 + ordered.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryEarlierInputsAllocation : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
      ℕ →
        (P : ℕ) →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                0 < P →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M parent N P F exponent history hP a initial allocation q =>
  have reps :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryEarlierRepresentativesWithWork N P F exponent hP a initial q).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryEarlierRepresentativesAllocation N P F exponent hP a initial allocation q +
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryRawHistoryInputsAllocation M parent P history reps +
    Chal.EditApproximation.queryOrderedHistoryInputsAllocation
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryRawHistoryInputsWithWork M parent P history reps).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryBandInputsAllocation : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
      ℕ →
        (P : ℕ) →

            ℕ →

                    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M parent N P F exponent hP a initial allocation q =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryEarlierRepresentativesAllocation N P F exponent hP a initial allocation q +
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryWideInputsAllocation M parent P
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryEarlierRepresentativesWithWork N P F exponent hP a initial q).1

def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalInitialQuery.{u_1, u_2} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  {α : Type u_2} →
    [DecidableEq α] →
      {M J : ℕ} →
        List α →
          (target : List α) →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                ℕ →
                  ℚ →
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J target.length → Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery ι) →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J target.length → Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery ι :=
fun {ι} {α} [DecidableEq α] {M J} source target N P F A seedRead state =>
  have piece := Chal.EditApproximation.physicalSource source state.1;
  if piece.length ≤ 1 then
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
      ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.shortSourceCost piece (Chal.EditApproximation.substring target state.2.lo state.2.hi))
  else
    (seedRead state).bind fun answer =>
      have value := ⌈answer⌉₊;
      have keys := Chal.EditApproximation.rawInitialConeCenters N P A value state.2;
      Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.collect (fun q => seedRead (state.1, q)) keys fun answers =>
        have localTable := fun q =>
          if q = state.2 then value else ⌈Chal.EditApproximation.finiteAnswerTable keys answers q⌉₊;
        Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
          (Chal.EditApproximation.localInitialConeTable piece target localTable N P F A
            (Chal.EditApproximation.refinementFactor A F) state.2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryInitialGather.{u_1, u_2} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  {β : Type u_2} →
    {n : ℕ} →
      ℕ →
        (P : ℕ) →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              0 < P →
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
                        Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
                      (List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) →
                          List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι β) →
                        Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι β :=
fun {ι} {β} {n} N P F exponent hP a q reader next =>
  (reader q).bind fun value =>
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryInitialSupportWithWork N P F exponent hP a value q)).bind
      fun keys => Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.collect reader keys (next keys)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryBandGather.{u_1, u_2} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  {β : Type u_2} →
    {nx ny : ℕ} →
      (M : ℕ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
          ℕ →
            (P : ℕ) →
              ℕ →
                ℕ →
                  0 < P →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                        Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                          (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                              Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
                            (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                                Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
                              (List (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
                                  List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                                    List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι β) →
                                Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι β :=
fun {ι} {β} {nx ny} M parent N P F exponent hP a initial q massReader initialReader next =>
  (Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryBandInputsWithWork M parent N P F exponent hP a initial q)).bind
    fun keys =>
    Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.collect massReader keys fun mass =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.collect initialReader keys (next keys mass)
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalRefinementMassQuery : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  (pass copy T S t : ℕ) →
    0 < t →
      (node : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J) →
        ↑node.fst < J →
          (q : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
            Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
              Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
                { child //
                  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                    Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.refinement pass copy node T t q) } :=
fun {M J ny} pass copy T S t ht node hbelow q input =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.collect
    (fun j =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.physicalRefinementWarmupRead pass copy T S t ht node q
        (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalChild node hbelow input.1) ⋯ ↑j ⋯ input.2)
    (List.ofFn fun j => j) fun values => Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done (values.sum / ↑T)
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalMedianSeedQuery : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (T S : ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          (parent : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny) →
            0 < parent.pass →
              Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
                  { child //
                    Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                      Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S parent } :=
fun {M J ny} N T S copies multiplier parent hpass state =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.collect
    (fun copy => Chal.EditApproximation.previousPassRead T S parent hpass state ↑copy) (List.finRange copies)
    fun values =>
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
      ↑(min N (Chal.EditApproximation.upperMedian (List.map (fun value => ⌈↑multiplier * value⌉₊) values)))
def Chal.EditApproximation.globalSeedRead : {M J ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (T S : ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        (ℕ → ℕ) →
          (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J ny → ℕ) →
            (parent : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J ny) →
              Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J ny →
                Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
                  { child //
                    Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                      Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S parent } :=
fun {M J ny} N T S copies multiplier initial parent state =>
  if state.1 = parent.node then
    if hp : parent.pass = 0 then Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done ↑(initial state)
    else Chal.EditApproximation.physicalMedianSeedQuery N T S copies (multiplier (parent.pass - 1)) parent ⋯ state.2
  else Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.value : Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational → ℚ :=
fun a => ↑a.num / ↑a.den
def Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.zero : Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational :=
{ num := 0, den := 1, den_pos := Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.zero._proof_1 }
def Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.mul : Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational →
  Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational → Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational :=
fun a b => { num := a.num * b.num, den := a.den * b.den, den_pos := ⋯ }
def Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.lt : Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational →
  Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational → Bool :=
fun a b => decide (a.num * ↑b.den < b.num * ↑a.den)
def Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.inv : Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational →
  Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational :=
fun a =>
  if h : a.num = 0 then Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.zero
  else { num := a.num.sign * ↑a.den, den := a.num.natAbs, den_pos := ⋯ }
def Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.div : Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational →
  Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational → Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational :=
fun a b => a.mul b.inv

def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseRootShift : (k : ℕ) → Fin (2 * k + 1) :=
fun k => ⟨k, ⋯⟩
def Chal.EditApproximation.endpointActionConnection : {n M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → ℕ :=
