def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupIndexWithWork : {M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
    Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
      Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M → List (Fin M) → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {M} h envelope values indices =>
  have terms := h.groupTermsWithWork envelope values indices;
  have total := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListWithWork terms.1;
  (total.1, terms.2 + total.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointDistanceWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {n} q r =>
  have left :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat q.lo).distanceWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.lo);
  have right :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat q.hi).distanceWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.hi);
  have result := left.1.canonicalAddWithWork right.1;
  (result.1, left.2 + right.2 + result.2 + q.lo.size + q.hi.size + r.lo.size + r.hi.size + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointConnectionWithWork : {n M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {n M} r states =>
  have result :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.lo).connectionWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.hi)
      (List.ofFn states);
  (result.1, result.2 + r.lo.size + r.hi.size + M + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {n} sourceLength r =>
  have targetLength :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.hi).subWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat r.lo);
  have result := targetLength.1.subWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat sourceLength);
  (result.1, targetLength.2 + result.2 + r.hi.size + r.lo.size + sourceLength.size + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupScaleSourceWithWork : {M : ℕ} →
  (k : ℕ) →
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
      Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
        Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
          (Fin k → Fin M × ℕ) → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {M} k h envelope values draw =>
  have indices :=
    if k = M then (List.finRange M, 0) else Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork draw (List.finRange k);
  have subtotal := h.groupIndexWithWork envelope values indices.1;
  have factor :=
    if k = M then (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one, 1)
    else (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M).divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat k);
  have result := factor.1.canonicalMulWithWork subtotal.1;
  (result.1, indices.2 + subtotal.2 + factor.2 + result.2 + M.size + k.size + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointScoreReadWithWork : {n M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {n M} r read states =>
  have words := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun i => read i (states i)) (List.finRange M);
  have connection := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointConnectionWithWork r states;
  have children := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListWithWork words.1;
  have result := connection.1.canonicalAddWithWork children.1;
  (result.1, words.2 + connection.2 + children.2 + result.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialConeWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
            Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {n} sourceLength U a L query center =>
  have gap := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapWithWork sourceLength center;
  have seed := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scaledSeedWithWork (U center) a gap.1;
  have distance := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointDistanceWithWork query center;
  have spatial := L.canonicalMulWithWork distance.1;
  have result := seed.1.canonicalAddWithWork spatial.1;
  (result.1, gap.2 + seed.2 + distance.2 + spatial.2 + result.2 + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointActionWithWork : {ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)
          (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) M ×
        ℕ :=
fun {ny M} center states =>
  have connection := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointConnectionWithWork center states;
  ({ center := center, connection := connection.1, childState := fun i => (i, states i) }, connection.2 + M + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointScoreReadAllocation : {n M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) → (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → ℕ :=
fun {n M} r read footprint states =>
  have words := (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun i => read i (states i)) (List.finRange M)).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun i => footprint i (states i)) (List.finRange M) +
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointConnectionAllocation r states +
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListAllocation words +
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointConnectionWithWork r states).1.canonicalAddAllocation
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListWithWork words).1 +
    0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialConeAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    ℕ →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} sourceLength U a L query center =>
  have gap := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapWithWork sourceLength center).1;
  have seed := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scaledSeedWithWork U a gap).1;
  have distance := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointDistanceWithWork query center).1;
  have spatial := (L.canonicalMulWithWork distance).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapAllocation sourceLength center +
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.scaledSeedAllocation U a gap +
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointDistanceAllocation query center +
      L.canonicalMulAllocation distance +
    seed.canonicalAddAllocation spatial
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupScaleSourceAllocation : {M : ℕ} →
  (k : ℕ) →
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
      Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
        Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M → (Fin k → Fin M × ℕ) → (Fin k → ℕ) → ℕ :=
fun {M} k h envelope values draw allocation =>
  have indices :=
    if k = M then (List.finRange M, 0) else Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork draw (List.finRange k);
  have factor :=
    if k = M then (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one, 1)
    else (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M).divWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat k);
  ((if k = M then 0 else Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation allocation (List.finRange k)) +
            h.groupIndexAllocation envelope values indices.1 +
          if k = M then 0
          else
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat M).divAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat k)) +
        factor.1.canonicalMulAllocation (h.groupIndexWithWork envelope values indices.1).1 +
      M.size +
    k.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gapGuardAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M → Vector (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) M → Fin M → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent envelope rounded i =>
  have sourceLength :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).hi
        (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).lo).1;
  have gap :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue sourceLength)
        (rounded.get i)).1;
  have bound := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulWithWork (envelope.get i)).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.bitSubtractAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).hi.bits
          (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).lo.bits false +
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue sourceLength)
          (rounded.get i) +
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulAllocation (envelope.get i) +
    gap.absolute.leAllocation bound
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.wideMinimumReadWithWork : {n M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
      (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n)) →
        actions ≠ [] → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {n M} r read actions hne =>
  have fallback := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointScoreReadWithWork r read (actions.head hne);
  have scores :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointScoreReadWithWork r read) actions;
  have result := fallback.1.minimumWithWork scores.1;
  (result.1, fallback.2 + scores.2 + result.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupMemberSourceWithWork : {M T : ℕ} →
  (Fin T → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
    (count : Fin T → ℕ) →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
        Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
          Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
            ((s : Fin T) → Fin (count s) → Fin M × ℕ) → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {M T} scales count connection envelope values draw =>
  have terms :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
      (fun s =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupScaleSourceWithWork (count s) (scales s) envelope values (draw s))
      (List.finRange T);
  have subtotal := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListWithWork terms.1;
  have result := connection.canonicalAddWithWork subtotal.1;
  (result.1, terms.2 + subtotal.2 + result.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.wideActionsFromRepresentativesWithWork : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  (M : ℕ) →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
      List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
        ℕ →
          List
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)
                (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) M) ×
            ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M parent representatives P =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
    (fun br =>
      have grids := Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionGridWithWork M parent br.2 br.1 P;
      have actions :=
        Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
          (fun states => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointActionWithWork br.2 states.get) grids.1;
      (actions.1, grids.2 + actions.2 + 1))
    representatives
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialConeReadWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List Bool × ℕ) →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
            Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {n} sourceLength read a L query center =>
  have seed := read center;
  have result :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialConeWithWork sourceLength
      (fun x => Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue seed.1) a L query center;
  (result.1, seed.2 + result.2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.wideMinimumReadAllocation : {n M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
        (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n)) → actions ≠ [] → ℕ :=
fun {n M} r read footprint actions hne =>
  have fallback := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointScoreReadWithWork r read (actions.head hne)).1;
  have scores :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointScoreReadWithWork r read) actions).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointScoreReadAllocation r read footprint (actions.head hne) +
        Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointScoreReadAllocation r read footprint) actions +
      fallback.minimumAllocation scores +
    0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupMemberSourceAllocation : {M T : ℕ} →
  (Fin T → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
    (count : Fin T → ℕ) →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
        Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
          Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
            ((s : Fin T) → Fin (count s) → Fin M × ℕ) → ((s : Fin T) → Fin (count s) → ℕ) → ℕ :=
fun {M T} scales count connection envelope values draw allocation =>
  have terms :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
        (fun s =>
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupScaleSourceWithWork (count s) (scales s) envelope values (draw s))
        (List.finRange T)).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation
        (fun s =>
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.groupScaleSourceAllocation (count s) (scales s) envelope values (draw s)
            (allocation s))
        (List.finRange T) +
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListAllocation terms +
    connection.canonicalAddAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.sumListWithWork terms).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.wideActionsFromRepresentativesAllocation : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx → List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M parent representatives P =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation
    (fun br =>
      have grids := Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionGridWithWork M parent br.2 br.1 P;
      have actions :=
        Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
          (fun states => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointActionWithWork br.2 states.get) grids.1;
      (actions.1, grids.2 + actions.2 + 1))
    (fun br =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionGridAllocation M parent br.2 br.1 P +
        Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation
          (fun states => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointActionAllocation br.2 states.get)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionGridWithWork M parent br.2 br.1 P).1)
    representatives
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.representativeFromActionsReadWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
                  List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r sourceLength b tau theta read actions =>
  if hne : actions = [] then ([], 1)
  else
    have Z := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.wideMinimumReadWithWork r read actions hne;
    have positive := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero.ltWithWork Z.1;
    if positive.1 = true then
      have gap := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapWithWork sourceLength r;
      have velocity := gap.1.divWithWork Z.1;
      have result :=
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandFromActionsReadWithWork parent r b tau theta velocity.1 read actions
          hne;
      (result.1, Z.2 + positive.2 + gap.2 + velocity.2 + result.2 + 3)
    else ([], Z.2 + positive.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.physicalContinuationReadWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                  List
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)
                        (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) M) →
                    List
                        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)
                          (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) M) →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent representatives P F delta fallback old current groups online query =>
  have wide := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.wideActionsFromRepresentativesWithWork M parent representatives P;
  have L :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 128).canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F);
  have result :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localContinuationReadWithWork
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointDistanceWithWork L.1 delta fallback old current query wide.1 groups
      online;
  (result.1, wide.2 + L.2 + result.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialMinimumReadWithWork : {n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List Bool × ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
              List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {n} sourceLength read N F a query centers =>
  have queryWord := read query;
  have zeroTest := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue queryWord.1) 0;
  if zeroTest.1 = true then (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero, queryWord.2 + zeroTest.2 + 1)
  else
    have L :=
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 32).canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F);
    have coefficient := L.1.canonicalAddWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one;
    have fallback := coefficient.1.canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat N);
    have scores :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialConeReadWithWork sourceLength read a L.1 query) centers;
    have result := fallback.1.minimumWithWork scores.1;
    (result.1, queryWord.2 + zeroTest.2 + L.2 + coefficient.2 + fallback.2 + scores.2 + result.2 + F.size + N.size + 6)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localWarmupReadKernelWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
              (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent N P F a initial child query =>
  have fallback := initial query;
  have representatives := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localRepresentativeReadWithWork N P F a initial query;
  have actions :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.wideActionsFromRepresentativesWithWork M parent representatives.1 P;
  have L :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 128).canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F);
  have result :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bellmanReadWithWork
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointDistanceWithWork L.1 fallback.1 child query actions.1;
  (result.1, fallback.2 + representatives.2 + actions.2 + L.2 + result.2 + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.representativeFromActionsReadAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

                (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) →
                  List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r sourceLength b tau theta read allocation actions =>
  if hne : actions = [] then 0
  else
    have Z := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.wideMinimumReadWithWork r read actions hne).1;
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.wideMinimumReadAllocation r read allocation actions hne +
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero.ltAllocation Z +
      if (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero.ltWithWork Z).1 = true then
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapAllocation sourceLength r +
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapWithWork sourceLength r).1.divAllocation Z +
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandFromActionsReadAllocation parent r b tau theta
            ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapWithWork sourceLength r).1.divWithWork Z).1 read allocation
            actions hne
      else 0

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryOnlineRangeWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →

    ℕ →
      ℕ →

  have width := Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork parent.hi parent.lo;
  have band :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedRepresentativeReadWithWork parent key.2
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue width.1) key.1 P tau
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) child;
  have setup := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineIndexSetupWithWork H band.1;
  have power := Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork setup.1.bits 80;
  have mass := Chal.EditApproximation.triangularMassWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue power.1);
  (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue mass.1, width.2 + band.2 + setup.2 + power.2 + mass.2 + 4)

    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
              (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) →
                ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent P exponent H tau child allocation key =>
  have width := (Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractWithWork parent.hi parent.lo).1;
  have band :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedRepresentativeReadWithWork parent key.2
        (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue width) key.1 P tau
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) child).1;
  have setup := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineIndexSetupWithWork H band).1;
  have power := (Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork setup.bits 80).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.saturatingSubtractAllocation parent.hi parent.lo +
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedRepresentativeReadAllocation parent key.2
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue width) key.1 P tau
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) child allocation +
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineIndexSetupAllocation H band +
      Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerAllocation setup.bits 80 +
    Chal.EditApproximation.triangularMassAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue power)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.Footprint.normalize.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  {program : Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction} →
    program.Footprint →

  heap.bind
    (fun word =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.finishCachedWithWork (word, 0) base hbase remaining))
    fun word =>
    Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.Footprint.computeOf
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.finishCachedWithWork (word, 0) base hbase remaining)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.finishCachedAllocation (word, 0) 0 base hbase remaining)
def Chal.EditApproximation.bandActionPredicate : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      ℕ →
        ℚ →
          ℚ →
            ℚ →
              (actions : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
                actions ≠ [] →
                  (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℚ) →
                    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → Prop :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r b tau theta velocity actions hnonempty child states =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.endpointActionConnection r states = 0 ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin M),
        (r.lo + ((Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).lo - parent.lo)).dist (states i).lo ≤ 6 * b ∧
          (r.lo + ((Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).hi - parent.lo)).dist (states i).hi ≤ 6 * b) ∧
      ∀ (j : Fin M),
        0 < ↑j →
          |Chal.EditApproximation.bandCutShift parent states j - (↑r.lo - ↑parent.lo) -
                velocity *
                  Chal.EditApproximation.rationalWidePrefixMinimum parent r actions hnonempty child (↑j)
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.bandCutShift parent states j)| ≤
            tau * theta * ↑b / ↑M
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryOnlineSourceGather.{u_1, u_2} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  {β : Type u_2} →
    {nx ny M : ℕ} →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
        ℕ →
          (P : ℕ) →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                ℕ →
                  0 < P →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                        (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                          (Fin M →
                              Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                            Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                              (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                                  ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
                                (List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
                                    List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι β) →
                                  Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι β :=
fun {ι} {β} {nx ny M} parent N P F exponent H hP tau a initial child q reader next =>
  have query := initial q;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.charge query.2
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryOnlineKeysWithWork N P F hP a query.1 q)).bind
      fun keys =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.collect
        (fun key =>
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute
                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryOnlineRangeWithWork parent P exponent H tau child key)).bind
            (reader key))
        keys (next keys))
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseLabelChildren.{u_1} : {B d : ℕ} →
  {α : Type u_1} →
    ℚ →
      ℚ →
        ℚ →
          (Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseSourceTree B α d → Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B d → ℚ → ℕ) →
            List
                (Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseSourceTree B α d ×
                  Fin B × Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B d) →
              ℕ :=
fun {B d} {α} Q lam allowance work x =>
  List.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseLabelChildren._f Q lam allowance work)
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedBandActions : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          ℚ →
            ℚ →
              ℚ →
                (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℚ) →
                  List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r b P tau theta velocity child =>
  have actions := Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionList M parent r b P;
  if h : actions = [] then []
  else
    if |velocity| ≤ 1 - tau then
      List.filter
        (fun states =>
          decide (Chal.EditApproximation.bandActionPredicate parent r b tau theta velocity actions h child states))
        actions
    else []
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalEndpointActionValue : {ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) → (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℚ) → ℚ :=
fun {ny M} r states child => ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.endpointActionConnection r states) + ∑ i, child i (states i)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalActualWideActions : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    List (ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
      ℕ →
        List
          (Chal.EditApproximation.RationalBellmanAction (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)
            (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) M) :=
fun {nx ny M} parent representatives P =>
  List.flatMap
    (fun br =>
      List.map
        (fun states =>
          { center := br.2, connection := ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.endpointActionConnection br.2 states),
            childState := fun i => (i, states i) })
        (Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionList M parent br.2 br.1 P))
    representatives
def Chal.EditApproximation.groupQueriedChildLabels : (M Q b : ℕ) →
  (h : ℚ) → (Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.groupSampleCount M Q b h) → Fin M) → Finset (Fin M) :=
fun M Q b h draw =>
  if Chal.EditApproximation.groupSampleCount M Q b h = M then Finset.univ else Finset.image draw Finset.univ
def Chal.EditApproximation.rationalWideActionMinimum : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  (parent : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx) →
    (r : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
      (b P : ℕ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionList M parent r b P ≠ [] →
          (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℚ) → ℚ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent r b P hnonempty child =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.rationalMinimum
    (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalEndpointActionValue r
      ((Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionList M parent r b P).head hnonempty) child)
    (List.map (fun states => Chal.EditApproximation.rationalEndpointActionValue r states child)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionList M parent r b P))
def Chal.EditApproximation.groupCurrentInputCover.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (source target : List α) →
    {M : ℕ} →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length →
        (b : ℕ) →
          ℕ →
            (Q : ℕ) →
              ℕ × ℕ →
                (h : ℚ) →
                  (Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.groupSampleCount M Q b h) → Fin M) →
                    Finset (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length) :=
fun {α} source target {M} parent b exponent Q cell h draw =>
  (Chal.EditApproximation.groupQueriedChildLabels M Q b h draw).biUnion fun i =>
    Finset.image (fun r => (i, r))
      (Chal.EditApproximation.groupRoundedStateList source target parent b exponent cell i h).toFinset
def Chal.EditApproximation.representativeBandActions.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (source target : List α) →
    {M : ℕ} →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length →
        Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℚ →
                ℚ →
                  (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℚ) →
                    List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length) :=
fun {α} source target {M} parent r b P tau theta child =>
  if h : Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionList M parent r b P = [] then []
  else
    have Z := Chal.EditApproximation.rationalWideActionMinimum parent r b P h child;
    if 0 < Z then
      Chal.EditApproximation.computedBandActions parent r b P tau theta
        (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalStateGap (Chal.EditApproximation.substring source parent.lo parent.hi) target
            r /
          Z)
        child
    else []

def Chal.EditApproximation.keyedOnlineBandG.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (source target : List α) →
    {M : ℕ} →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                ℚ →
                  (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℚ) →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℕ :=
fun {α} source target {M} parent P exponent H b tau child r =>
  H +
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bandCoordinates
          (Chal.EditApproximation.representativeBandActions source target parent r b P tau (2 ^ (-↑exponent))
              child).toFinset).card +
    2
def Chal.EditApproximation.testUnskippedBand.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (source target : List α) →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (parent : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length) →
        (b P thetaExponent : ℕ) →
          (tau F : ℚ) →
            (child initial : Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℚ) →
              Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length →
                Option
                  (Chal.EditApproximation.UnskippedBand source target parent b P thetaExponent tau F child initial) :=
fun {α} source target {M} parent b P thetaExponent tau F child initial center =>
  let band :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.representativeBandActions source target parent center b P tau (2 ^ (-↑thetaExponent)) child;
  if hband : band = [] then none
  else
    if hsum : ∑ i, Chal.EditApproximation.bandChildEnvelope b band initial i ≤ 64 * F * ↑b then
      let rounded := Chal.EditApproximation.canonicalRoundedBandAction thetaExponent b band hband initial;
      if hwide : rounded ∈ Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionList M parent center b P then
        if hgap :
            ∀ (i : Fin M),
              |Chal.EditApproximation.rationalStateGap
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.substring source (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).lo
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).hi)
                    target (rounded i)| ≤
                2 * Chal.EditApproximation.bandChildEnvelope b band initial i then
          some { center := center, nonempty := hband, sum_guard := hsum, wide_guard := hwide, imbalance_guard := hgap }
        else none
      else none
    else none
def Chal.EditApproximation.unskippedBandList.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (source target : List α) →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (parent : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length) →
        (b P thetaExponent : ℕ) →
          (tau F : ℚ) →
            (child initial : Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℚ) →
              List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length) →
                List
                  (Chal.EditApproximation.UnskippedBand source target parent b P thetaExponent tau F child initial) :=
fun {α} source target {M} parent b P thetaExponent tau F child initial centers =>
  List.filterMap (Chal.EditApproximation.testUnskippedBand source target parent b P thetaExponent tau F child initial)
    centers
def Chal.EditApproximation.keyedOnlineCandidate.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (source target : List α) →
    {M : ℕ} →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                ℕ →
                  ℚ →
                    ℚ →
                      ℚ →
                        (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℚ) →
                          (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℚ) →
                            Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalChildTables M target.length →
                              ℕ →
                                Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length →
                                  ℕ → Option (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalRationalAction M target.length) :=
fun {α} source target {M} parent P F exponent H b tau eta kappa child initial children t r integer =>
  have proof_optimizerTriangularMass_succ_66 := Chal.EditApproximation.keyedOnlineCandidate._proof_1;
  have proof_optimizerTriangularMass_twice_67 := ⋯;
  have proof_optimizerTriangularMass_positive_77 := ⋯;
  have proof_keyedOnlineBandG_positive_78 := @Chal.EditApproximation.keyedOnlineCandidate._proof_7;
  have band := Chal.EditApproximation.representativeBandActions source target parent r b P tau (2 ^ (-↑exponent)) child;
  have envelope := Chal.EditApproximation.bandChildEnvelope b band initial;
  let G := Chal.EditApproximation.keyedOnlineBandG source target parent P exponent H b tau child r;
  let K := G ^ 80;
  have accepted :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.boundedOnlineInteger (Chal.EditApproximation.optimizerTriangularMass K) ⋯ integer;
  if hband : band = [] then none
  else
    match Chal.EditApproximation.testUnskippedBand source target parent b P exponent tau (↑F) child initial r with
    | none => none
    | some val =>
      some
        (Chal.EditApproximation.sharedBandRationalAction r
          (Chal.EditApproximation.finiteOptimizerActionDraw band hband envelope
            (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalOnlineLinear eta kappa
              (Chal.EditApproximation.childGain envelope fun s coordinate => children coordinate.1 s coordinate.2)
              (Chal.EditApproximation.childDecrement envelope fun s coordinate => children coordinate.1 s coordinate.2)
              t)
            G K accepted))
def Chal.EditApproximation.cellUnskippedBands.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (source target : List α) →
    {M : ℕ} →
      (parent : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length) →
        (b P F thetaExponent : ℕ) →
          (tau : ℚ) →
            ℚ →
              (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℚ) →

                  ℕ × ℕ →
                    List
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.UnskippedBand source target parent b P thetaExponent tau (↑F) child
                        initial) :=

  Chal.EditApproximation.unskippedBandList source target parent b P thetaExponent tau (↑F) child initial
    (Chal.EditApproximation.cellRepresentativeStates target.length P F b a parentInitial (2 ^ (-↑thetaExponent)) cell)
def Chal.EditApproximation.localOnlineCandidates.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (source target : List α) →
    {M : ℕ} →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                ℕ →
                  ℚ →
                    ℚ →
                      ℚ →
                        ℚ →
                          (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℚ) →
                            (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℚ) →
                              (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℚ) →
                                Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalChildTables M target.length →
                                  ℕ →
                                    (ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℕ) →
                                      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length →
                                        List (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalRationalAction M target.length) :=
fun {α} source target {M} parent N P F exponent H tau a eta kappa parentInitial child initial children t integer q =>
  List.filterMap
    (fun b =>
      have r := Chal.EditApproximation.roundInterval (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacing b P) q;
      if ↑b / (4 * a) ≤ parentInitial r ∧ parentInitial r ≤ 8 * ↑F * ↑b then
        Chal.EditApproximation.keyedOnlineCandidate source target parent P F exponent H b tau eta kappa child initial
          children t r (integer b r)
      else none)
    (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicQueryWindow N (parentInitial q) a ↑F)

@[irreducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.rankedMemoEvaluate.{u_1} : {κ : Type u_1} →
  (rank : κ → ℕ) →
    ((key : κ) → Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery { child // rank child < rank key }) →
      ℕ → (κ → ℕ) → κ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryMemo ℚ → Chal.EditApproximation.RecursiveMemoResult κ :=

def Chal.EditApproximation.localWarmupStepQuery.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  {nx ny M : ℕ} →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            ℚ →
              (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery ι) →
                (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery ι) →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery ι :=
fun {ι} {nx ny M} parent N P F a initialRead childRead q =>
  (initialRead q).bind fun value =>
    have centers := Chal.EditApproximation.rawRefinementCenters N P F a value q;
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.collect initialRead centers fun answers =>
      have initial := fun r => if r = q then value else Chal.EditApproximation.finiteAnswerTable centers answers r;
      have representatives := Chal.EditApproximation.localRefinementRepresentatives N P F a initial q;
      have inputs := Chal.EditApproximation.wideWarmupInputs parent P representatives;
      Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.collect childRead inputs fun values =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
          (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalBellman initial
            (fun q r => ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.targetEndpointDistance q r)) (128 * ↑F)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalActualWideActions parent representatives P)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.finiteAnswerTable inputs values) q)

def Chal.EditApproximation.occurrenceBuild : ℕ →
  ℕ → List (ℕ × ℕ) → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryMemo Chal.EditApproximation.PositionCounts :=

def Chal.EditApproximation.occurrenceBuildWithWork : ℕ →
  ℕ → List (ℕ × ℕ) → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryMemo Chal.EditApproximation.PositionCounts × ℕ :=
fun symbolBits positionBits x =>
  List.brecOn x (Chal.EditApproximation.occurrenceBuildWithWork._f symbolBits positionBits)
def Chal.EditApproximation.occurrenceQueryWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryMemo
    Chal.EditApproximation.PositionCounts →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Bool × ℕ :=
fun table symbolBits positionBits a lo hi =>
  have key := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryMemoKey symbolBits a;
  have found := table.lookupCosted key;
  have tree := found.1.getD Chal.EditApproximation.PositionCounts.empty;
  have first := tree.prefixWithWork positionBits lo;
  have last := tree.prefixWithWork positionBits hi;
  (decide (first.1 < last.1), symbolBits + found.2 + first.2 + last.2 + 2)

def Chal.EditApproximation.indexedSingletonCostWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryMemo
    Chal.EditApproximation.PositionCounts →
  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun table symbolBits positionBits a lo hi =>
  if lo = hi then (1, 1)
  else
    have query := Chal.EditApproximation.occurrenceQueryWithWork table symbolBits positionBits a lo hi;
    (hi - lo - if query.1 = true then 1 else 0, query.2 + 4)

def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupRequestQuery.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  [DecidableEq α] →
    {M J : ℕ} →
      List α →
        (target : List α) →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                ℚ →
                  (pass copy T S j : ℕ) →
                    (node : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalNode M J) →
                      (q : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length) →
                        (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J target.length →
                            Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
                              { child //
                                Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                                  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S
                                    (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.warmup pass copy node j q) }) →
                          Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
                            { child //
                              Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S child <
                                Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.combinedRank T S
                                  (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.warmup pass copy node j q) } :=
fun {α} [DecidableEq α] {M J} source target N P F A pass copy T S j node q seedRead =>
  match j, seedRead with
  | 0, seedRead => Chal.EditApproximation.physicalInitialQuery source target N P F A seedRead (node, q)
  | t.succ, seedRead =>
    if hbelow : ↑node.fst < J then
      if
          (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalSourceInterval source.length node).hi -
              (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalSourceInterval source.length node).lo ≤
            1 then
        Chal.EditApproximation.physicalInitialQuery source target N P F A seedRead (node, q)
      else
        Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupStepQuery source target N P F A seedRead
          (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupChildQuery pass copy T S t node hbelow q) node q
    else Chal.EditApproximation.physicalInitialQuery source target N P F A seedRead (node, q)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedPreparedActionReadWithWork : {M n : ℕ} →
  Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
    (ℕ → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

          List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) →

  have coordinates := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coordinateVectorWithWork band;
  have vertices := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedBandVerticesWithWork coordinates.1 mass band;
  have linear :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.vectorMapWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.listedBandCoordinates band).length fun i =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineLinearReadWithWork (fun child => mass.get child) read eta kappa t
        (coordinates.1.get i);
  have selected := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.selectionWithWork vertices.1 linear.1 G j;
  (selected.1, coordinates.2 + vertices.2 + linear.2 + selected.2 + 3)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedBandActionReadWithWork : {M n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
      (ℕ → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) →
              ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Option (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) × ℕ :=
fun {M n} b initial read eta kappa band G j t =>
  have mass := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.envelopeVectorReadWithWork b band initial;
  have selected :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedPreparedActionReadWithWork mass.1 read eta kappa band G j t;
  (selected.1, mass.2 + selected.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedPreparedActionAllocation : {M n : ℕ} →
  Vector Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction M →
    (ℕ → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
      (ℕ → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun {M n} mass read footprint eta kappa band G j t =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coordinateVectorAllocation band +
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedPreparedActionKernelAllocation mass read footprint eta kappa band G j t
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedSampledOnlineReadWithWork : {n M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
    ℕ →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        (ℕ → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (band : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n)) →
                band ≠ [] →
                  ℕ →
                    (K : ℕ) →
                      ℕ →
                        Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.optimizerTriangularMass K) →
                          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n)
                              (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) M ×
                            ℕ :=
fun {n M} center b initial read eta kappa band hne G K t integer =>
  have chosen := Chal.EditApproximation.triangularChoiceWithWork K integer;
  have selected :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedBandActionReadWithWork b initial read eta kappa band G (↑chosen.1) t;
  have states := selected.1.getD (band.head hne);
  ({ center := center, connection := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero, childState := fun i => (i, states i) },
    chosen.2 + selected.2 + M + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedBandActionAllocation : {M n : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
        (ℕ → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
          (ℕ → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun {M n} b initial initialAllocation read footprint eta kappa band G j t =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.envelopeVectorReadAllocation b band initial initialAllocation +
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedPreparedActionAllocation
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.envelopeVectorReadWithWork b band initial).1 read footprint eta kappa band
      G j t
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedSampledOnlineAllocation : {n M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
    ℕ →
      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
        (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
          (ℕ → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
            (ℕ → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                  (band : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n)) →
                    band ≠ [] → ℕ → (K : ℕ) → ℕ → Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.optimizerTriangularMass K) → ℕ :=
fun {n M} _center b initial initialAllocation read readAllocation eta kappa band _hne G K t integer =>
  have chosen := (Chal.EditApproximation.triangularChoiceWithWork K integer).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.triangularChoiceAllocation K integer +
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedBandActionAllocation b initial initialAllocation read
          readAllocation eta kappa band G (↑chosen) t +
      M +
    1
def Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.rank.{u_1, u_2} : {σ : Type u_1} → {κ : Type u_2} → (κ → ℕ) → σ ⊕ κ → ℕ :=
fun {σ} {κ} tableRank x =>
  match x with
  | Sum.inl val => 0
  | Sum.inr key => tableRank key + 1
def Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.keyCode.{u_1, u_2} : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {κ : Type u_2} → (σ → ℕ) → (κ → ℕ) → σ ⊕ κ → ℕ :=
fun {σ} {κ} sourceCode tableCode x =>
  match x with
  | Sum.inl source => 2 * sourceCode source
  | Sum.inr table => 2 * tableCode table + 1
def Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.child.{u_1, u_2} : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {κ : Type u_2} →
    (tableRank : κ → ℕ) →
      (parent : κ) →
        σ ⊕ { key // tableRank key < tableRank parent } →
          { key //
            Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.rank tableRank key <
              Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.rank tableRank (Sum.inr parent) } :=
fun {σ} {κ} tableRank parent x =>
  match x with
  | Sum.inl source => ⟨Sum.inl source, ⋯⟩
  | Sum.inr table => ⟨Sum.inr ↑table, ⋯⟩
def Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.body.{u_1, u_2} : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {κ : Type u_2} →
    (tableRank : κ → ℕ) →
      ((parent : κ) → Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery (σ ⊕ { key // tableRank key < tableRank parent })) →
        (σ → ℚ) →
          (key : σ ⊕ κ) →
            Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
              { next //
                Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.rank tableRank next <
                  Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.rank tableRank key } :=
fun {σ} {κ} tableRank tableBody sourceValue key =>
  match key with
  | Sum.inl source => Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done (sourceValue source)
  | Sum.inr table =>
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.mapKeys (Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.child tableRank table)
      (tableBody table)
def Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.bitBody.{u_1, u_2} : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {κ : Type u_2} →
    (tableRank : κ → ℕ) →
      ((parent : κ) →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery (σ ⊕ { key // tableRank key < tableRank parent })
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
        (σ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
          (key : σ ⊕ κ) →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery
              { next //
                Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.rank tableRank next <
                  Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.rank tableRank key }
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun {σ} {κ} tableRank tableBody sourceValue key =>
  match key with
  | Sum.inl source => Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute (sourceValue source)
  | Sum.inr table =>
    Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.mapKeysWithWork
      (fun key => (Chal.EditApproximation.SourceRanked.child tableRank table key, 1)) (tableBody table)
def Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest.depth : {M J ny passes copies T S : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest M J ny passes copies T S → ℕ :=
fun {M J ny passes copies T S} x =>
  match x with
  | Sum.inl entry => J - ↑entry.1.fst
  | Sum.inr request => (↑request).remainingDepth
def Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest.index : {M J ny passes copies T S : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest M J ny passes copies T S → ℕ :=
fun {M J ny passes copies T S} x =>
  match x with
  | Sum.inl val => 0
  | Sum.inr request => Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.rank T S ↑request + 1
def Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest.rank : {M J ny passes copies T S : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest M J ny passes copies T S → ℕ :=
fun {M J ny passes copies T S} request => request.depth + request.index
def Chal.EditApproximation.chargedPreviousRead : {M J ny passes copies T S : ℕ} →
  (parent : { r // Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.Bounded passes copies T S r }) →
    0 < (↑parent).pass →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
        Fin copies →
          Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
            { child // child.rank < Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest.rank (Sum.inr parent) } :=
fun {M J ny passes copies T S} parent hpass state copy =>
  have proof_table_rank_lt_99 := @Chal.EditApproximation.chargedPreviousRead._proof_1;
  have proof_combinedRank_lt_of_progress_80 := @Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupChildQuery._proof_3;
  have proof_rank_lt_previous_pass_98 := @Chal.EditApproximation.previousPassRead._proof_2;
  have proof_previousPassRequest_progress_97 := ⋯;
  Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.read ⟨Sum.inr (Chal.EditApproximation.chargedPreviousPass parent state copy), ⋯⟩
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
def Chal.EditApproximation.chargedWarmupChild : {M J ny passes copies T S : ℕ} →
  (parent : { r // Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.Bounded passes copies T S r }) →
    ↑(↑parent).node.fst < J →
      0 < (↑parent).index →
        Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
          Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
            { child // child.rank < Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest.rank (Sum.inr parent) } :=
fun {M J ny passes copies T S} parent hbelow hindex input =>
  have proof_table_rank_lt_99 := @Chal.EditApproximation.chargedPreviousRead._proof_1;
  have proof_combinedRank_lt_of_progress_80 := @Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupChildQuery._proof_3;
  have proof_warmup_previous_child_progress_81 := ⋯;
  have proof_combinedRank_warmup_child_79 := ⋯;
  Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.read
    ⟨Sum.inr
        ⟨Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.warmup (↑parent).pass (↑parent).copy
            (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalChild (↑parent).node hbelow input.1) ((↑parent).index - 1) input.2,
          ⋯⟩,
      ⋯⟩
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
def Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSeedQuery : {M J ny passes copies T S : ℕ} →
  ℕ →
    (ℕ → ℕ) →
      (parent : { r // Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.Bounded passes copies T S r }) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J ny →
          Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
            { child // child.rank < Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest.rank (Sum.inr parent) } :=
fun {M J ny passes copies T S} N multiplier parent state =>
  have proof_coarse_rank_lt_100 := @Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSeedQuery._proof_2;
  if hn : state.1 = (↑parent).node then
    if hp : (↑parent).pass = 0 then
      Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.read ⟨Sum.inl state, ⋯⟩ Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
    else
      Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.collect (Chal.EditApproximation.chargedPreviousRead parent ⋯ state.2)
        (List.finRange copies) fun values =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
          ↑(min N
              (Chal.EditApproximation.upperMedian
                (List.map (fun value => ⌈↑(multiplier ((↑parent).pass - 1)) * value⌉₊) values)))
  else Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.chargedWarmupQuery.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  [DecidableEq α] →
    {M J passes copies T S : ℕ} →
      List α →
        (target : List α) →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                (ℕ → ℚ) →
                  (ℕ → ℕ) →
                    (parent : { r // Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.Bounded passes copies T S r }) →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
                        { child // child.rank < Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest.rank (Sum.inr parent) } :=
fun {α} [DecidableEq α] {M J passes copies T S} source target N P F factor multiplier parent =>
  if hz : (↑parent).index = 0 then
    Chal.EditApproximation.physicalInitialQuery source target N P F (factor (↑parent).pass)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSeedQuery N multiplier parent) ((↑parent).node, (↑parent).state)
  else
    if hbelow : ↑(↑parent).node.fst < J then
      if
          (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalSourceInterval source.length (↑parent).node).hi -
              (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalSourceInterval source.length (↑parent).node).lo ≤
            1 then
        Chal.EditApproximation.physicalInitialQuery source target N P F (factor (↑parent).pass)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSeedQuery N multiplier parent) ((↑parent).node, (↑parent).state)
      else
        Chal.EditApproximation.physicalWarmupStepQuery source target N P F (factor (↑parent).pass)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSeedQuery N multiplier parent)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.chargedWarmupChild parent hbelow ⋯) (↑parent).node (↑parent).state
    else
      Chal.EditApproximation.physicalInitialQuery source target N P F (factor (↑parent).pass)
        (Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSeedQuery N multiplier parent) ((↑parent).node, (↑parent).state)
@[reducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseEntryWidth.{u} : {α : Type u} → List α → List α → ℕ :=

fun n => Fin (Nat.clog 2 n + 1)

@[reducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseFullSeedDraws.{u_1, u_2} : ℕ →

def Chal.EditApproximation.indexedLeafWithWork : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryMemo

  | some a => Chal.EditApproximation.indexedSingletonCostWithWork table symbolBits positionBits a lo hi

def Chal.EditApproximation.queryIndexedSliceWithWork : (source : List ℕ) →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length →
    (targetLength : ℕ) →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval targetLength →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryMemo Chal.EditApproximation.PositionCounts →
          ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=

  have symbol := Chal.EditApproximation.querySliceHeadWithWork source interval;
  have result := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryIndexedLeafWithWork occurrence symbolBits positionBits symbol.1 q.lo q.hi;
  (result.1, symbol.2 + result.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryIndexedSliceAllocation : (source : List ℕ) →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length →
    (targetLength : ℕ) →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval targetLength →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryMemo Chal.EditApproximation.PositionCounts → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=

  interval.lo.bits.length + interval.hi.bits.length + 1 +
    Chal.EditApproximation.binaryIndexedLeafAllocation occurrence symbolBits positionBits
      (Chal.EditApproximation.querySliceHeadWithWork source interval).1 q.lo q.hi
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialGridReadAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List Bool × ℕ) →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
      ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun {n} read allocation P A radius q b =>
  have spacing := (Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingWithWork b P).1;
  have points :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxWithWork n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing) radius q.lo q.hi).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.seedGridSpacingAllocation b P +
      Chal.EditApproximation.gridStateBoxAllocation n (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue spacing) radius q.lo q.hi +
    Chal.EditApproximation.filterAllocation
      (fun r =>
        ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialCenterGuardWithWork b
              (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (read r).1) A).1,
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialCenterGuardWithWork b
                (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (read r).1) A).2 +
            (read r).2))
      (fun r =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialCenterGuardAllocation b
            (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (read r).1) A +
          allocation r)
      points
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialConeReadAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List Bool × ℕ) →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} read allocation sourceLength a L query center =>
  allocation center +
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialConeAllocation sourceLength
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (read center).1) a L query center
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialCentersReadAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List Bool × ℕ) →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
      ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} read allocation N P A q =>
  have Uq := Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (read q).1;
  have scales := (Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScalesWithWork N).1;
  have active :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.filterWithWork
        (fun b => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialScaleGuardWithWork Uq b A) scales).1;
  allocation q + Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScalesAllocation N +
      Chal.EditApproximation.filterAllocation
        (fun b => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialScaleGuardWithWork Uq b A)
        (fun b => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialScaleGuardAllocation Uq b A) scales +
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialGridReadWithWork P A read Uq q)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialGridReadAllocation read allocation P A Uq q) active
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialMinimumReadAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List Bool × ℕ) →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) → ℕ :=
fun {n} read allocation sourceLength N F a query centers =>
  have Uq := Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue (read query).1;
  allocation query + Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation Uq 0 +
    if (Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork Uq 0).1 = true then 0
    else
      have L :=
        ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 32).canonicalMulWithWork
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F)).1;
      have coefficient := (L.canonicalAddWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one).1;
      have fallback := (coefficient.canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat N)).1;
      have scores :=
        (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialConeReadWithWork sourceLength read a L query) centers).1;
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 32).canonicalMulAllocation
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F) +
                  L.canonicalAddAllocation Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.one +
                coefficient.canonicalMulAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat N) +
              Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation
                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialConeReadAllocation read allocation sourceLength a L query)
                centers +
            fallback.minimumAllocation scores +
          F.size +
        N.size
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialProgramReadAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List Bool × ℕ) →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} read allocation sourceLength N P F A a query =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialCentersReadAllocation read allocation N P A query +
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialMinimumReadAllocation read allocation sourceLength N F a query
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialCentersReadWithWork N P A read query).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cachedInitialProgramReadAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → List Bool × ℕ) →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} read allocation sourceLength N P F A a query =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.finishCachedAllocation
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialProgramReadWithWork sourceLength N P F A a read query)
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.initialProgramReadAllocation read allocation sourceLength N P F A a query)
    [true] Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.zero._proof_1 0
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineParametersAllocation : List Bool → ℕ :=
fun word => Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerAllocation word 5 + Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerAllocation word 4 + 2
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.refinementDecrementAllocation : List Bool → ℕ :=
fun word => Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerAllocation word 10 + 1
def Chal.EditApproximation.scheduledRefinementAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun N pass =>
  if pass < Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedPassCount N then
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.signedPowerTwoAllocation
        ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicSeedExponent (Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N)
              (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedInitialExponent N) pass -
            Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N) +
      2
  else 2
def Chal.EditApproximation.refinementBaseAllocation : List Bool → ℕ :=
fun word =>
  have power := Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerWithWork word 10;
  have increment := Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddWithWork power.1 [true] false;
  Chal.EditApproximation.bitPowerAllocation word 10 + Chal.EditApproximation.bitAddAllocation power.1 [true] false +
      Chal.EditApproximation.trimBitWordAllocation increment.1 +
    2
def Chal.EditApproximation.refinementParameterAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool → ℕ :=
fun N pass word =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineParametersAllocation word +
        Chal.EditApproximation.scheduledRefinementAllocation N pass +
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.refinementDecrementAllocation word +
    5
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedQueryPassAllocation : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun N pass =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.signedPowerTwoAllocation
        ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicSeedExponent (Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedInitialExponent N) pass) +
      Chal.EditApproximation.refinementParameterAllocation N pass (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N).bits +
    2
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedQuerySetupAllocation : ℕ → ℕ :=
fun N =>
  (Chal.EditApproximation.vectorMapAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedPassCount N + 1) fun i =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.computedQueryPassAllocation N ↑i) +
      Chal.EditApproximation.refinementBaseAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N).bits +
    5
def Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.nat : ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational :=
fun n => { num := ↑n, den := 1, den_pos := Chal.EditApproximation.UnreducedRational.zero._proof_1 }

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.unskippedGuardReadWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            (band : List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)) →
              List (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →
                band ≠ [] →
                  (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                    Bool × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent _center b exponent F band wide hne read =>
  have envelope := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.envelopeVectorReadWithWork b band read;
  have total := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandMassTotalWithWork envelope.1;
  have fb := F.canonicalMulWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b);
  have limit := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 64).canonicalMulWithWork fb.1;
  have sumGuard := total.1.leWithWork limit.1;
  have rounded := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.roundedBandReadWithWork exponent b band hne read;
  have wideGuard := Chal.EditApproximation.actionMemberWithWork rounded.1.get wide;
  have gapGuard :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.allWithWork
      (fun i =>
        have sourceLength :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalSubtractWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).hi
            (Chal.EditApproximation.sourceChild parent i).lo;
        have gap :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.stateGapWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue sourceLength.1)
            (rounded.1.get i);
        have bound := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulWithWork (envelope.1.get i);
        have test := gap.1.absolute.leWithWork bound.1;
        (test.1, sourceLength.2 + gap.2 + bound.2 + test.2 + 3))
      (List.finRange M);
  (sumGuard.1 && wideGuard.1 && gapGuard.1,
    envelope.2 + total.2 + fb.2 + limit.2 + sumGuard.2 + rounded.2 + wideGuard.2 + gapGuard.2 + 5)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupInputsWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    (b : ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        (Q : ℕ) →
          ℕ × ℕ →
            (h : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
              (Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.groupSampleCount M Q b h.value) → Fin M × ℕ) →
                List (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent b exponent Q cell h draw =>
  have labels := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupLabelsWithWork M Q b h draw;
  have inputs :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
      (fun i =>
        have states := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupRoundedStatesWithWork parent b exponent cell i h;
        have tagged := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun r => ((i, r), 1)) states.1;
        (tagged.1, states.2 + tagged.2 + 1))
      labels.1;
  (inputs.1, labels.2 + inputs.2 + 1)

  ℕ →
    (q L : ℕ) →
      0 < B →
        0 < q →
          0 < L →
            List ℕ →
              List ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B d → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {B d} k q L hB hq hL x y draws =>

  have proof_coarseRootDenominator_value_128 := ⋯;
  have proof_coarseRootDenominator_pos_126 := ⋯;

  have denPos := ⋯;
  have two := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseGridNatWithWork den.1 denPos 2;

      two.1 d 0 draws allowance.1 0;

    den.2 + two.2 + allowance.2 + evaluated.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupInputsAllocation : {nx : ℕ} →

      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
        (b : ℕ) →
          ℕ →

                    (Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.groupSampleCount M Q b h.value) → ℕ) → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent b exponent Q cell h draw allocation =>
  have build := fun i =>
    have states := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupRoundedStatesWithWork parent b exponent cell i h;
    have tagged := Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork (fun r => ((i, r), 1)) states.1;
    (tagged.1, states.2 + tagged.2 + 1);
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupLabelsAllocation M Q b h draw allocation +
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation build
      (fun i =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupRoundedStatesAllocation parent b exponent cell i h +
          Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapAllocation (fun x => 1)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupRoundedStatesWithWork parent b exponent cell i h).1)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupLabelsWithWork M Q b h draw).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.unskippedGuardReadAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

  have total := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandMassTotalWithWork envelope).1;

  have limit := ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 64).canonicalMulWithWork fb).1;
  have rounded := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.roundedBandReadWithWork exponent b band hne read).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.envelopeVectorReadAllocation b band read allocation +
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.bandMassAllocation envelope +
              F.canonicalMulAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat b) +

        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.roundedBandReadAllocation exponent b band hne read allocation +

      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gapGuardAllocation parent envelope rounded) (List.finRange M)

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseIndexedCandidateWithWork : {B d : ℕ} →

      0 < q →
        0 < L →

  have doubled := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat 2).canonicalMulWithWork shifted.1;
  (doubled.1, root.2 + shifted.2 + doubled.2 + k.size + 3)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedUnskippedReadAllocation : {nx ny M : ℕ} →

            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

                      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → ℕ) → ℕ :=

  have band :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedRepresentativeReadWithWork parent center (parent.hi - parent.lo) b P
        tau (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) read).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedRepresentativeReadAllocation parent center (parent.hi - parent.lo) b P
      tau (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) read readAllocation +
    if hband : band = [] then 0
    else
      have wide := (Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionGridWithWork M parent center b P).1;
      Chal.EditApproximation.wideActionGridAllocation M parent center b P + wide.length +
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.unskippedGuardReadAllocation parent center b exponent F band
