        if
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.unskippedGuardReadWithWork parent center b exponent F band
                  (List.map Vector.get wide) hband initial).1 =
              true then
          3
        else 0

  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.unskippedGuardReadWithWork parent center b exponent F band.1

    else (none, band.2 + wide.2 + guard.2 + wide.1.length + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseIndexedInitialWithWork : {B d : ℕ} →
  (q L : ℕ) →
    ℕ →
      0 < B →
        0 < q →
          0 < L →
            (x y : List ℕ) →
              (Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseGuessIndex (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseEntryWidth x y) →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B d) →
                ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {B d} q L N hB hq hL x y draws =>
  have long := Chal.EditApproximation.binaryNaturalCompareWithWork (2 * x.length) y.length;
  if long.1 = Ordering.lt then (min N y.length, long.2 + N.size + y.length.size + 4)
  else
    have equal := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.naturalListEqualWithWork x y;
    if equal.1 = true then (0, long.2 + equal.2 + 3)
    else
      have roots :=
        Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticMapWithWork
          (fun i => Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseIndexedCandidateWithWork q L hB hq hL x y i (draws i))
          (List.finRange (Nat.clog 2 (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseEntryWidth x y) + 1));
      have smallest := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coarseMinimumWithWork roots.1;
      have rounded := smallest.1.naturalCeilingWithWork;
      have result := Chal.EditApproximation.wordMinWithWork N.bits rounded.1;
      (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue result.1,
        long.2 + equal.2 + roots.2 + smallest.2 + rounded.2 + result.2 + N.size + 6)

                    ((t : Fin T) → Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.groupSampleCount M Q b (scales t).value) → ℕ) →
                      (members : List (Chal.EditApproximation.RawUnskippedBand M ny)) → members ≠ [] → ℕ :=
fun {ny M T} b exponent Q initial current initialAllocation currentAllocation scales drawSource drawAllocation members
    hne =>
  have selected :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.chooseUnskippedSourceWithWorkRaw b exponent Q initial current scales
        drawSource members hne).1;
  have rounded :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.roundedBandReadWithWork exponent b selected.actions ⋯ initial).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.chooseUnskippedSourceAllocationRaw b exponent Q initial current
        initialAllocation currentAllocation scales drawSource drawAllocation members +
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.roundedBandReadAllocation exponent b selected.actions ⋯ initial
        initialAllocation +
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.endpointActionAllocation selected.center rounded.get
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedOnlineReadWithWorkRaw.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  (source target : List α) →
    {M : ℕ} →
      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval source.length →
        (P : ℕ) →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                (b : ℕ) →
                  0 < b →
                    0 < P →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                            (child initial :
                                Fin M →
                                  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length →

                              (ℕ →
                                  Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length →

                                (R : ℕ) →
                                  (∀ (i : Fin M) (q : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length),
                                      (child i q).2 ≤ R) →
                                    (∀ (i : Fin M) (q : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length),
                                        (initial i q).2 ≤ R) →
                                      ℕ →
                                        Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length →
                                          ℕ →
                                            Option
                                                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction

                                                  (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length) M) ×
                                              ℕ :=
fun {α} source target {M} parent P F exponent H b _hb _hP tau eta kappa child initial table R _hc _hi t center
    integer =>
  have proof_arithmeticFlatMapWithWork_value_69 :=
    @Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coordinateVectorWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_arithmeticMapWithWork_value_70 := @Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coordinateVectorWithWork._proof_2;
  have proof_memberByWithWork_value_71 := @Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coordinateVectorWithWork._proof_3;
  have proof_dedupByWithWork_value_72 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitWordValue_bits_15 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_19;
  have proof_bitOrdering_matches_4 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_matches_5 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_eq_3 := ⋯;
  have proof_binaryNaturalCompareWithWork_eq_73 := ⋯;
  have proof_naturalEqualWithWork_value_74 := ⋯;
  have proof_coordinateEqualWithWork_value_75 := ⋯;
  have proof_bandCoordinatesWithWork_value_68 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitAdder_value_1 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineParametersWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_bitAddWithWork_value_2 := ⋯;
  have proof_binaryNaturalAddWithWork_value_52 := ⋯;
  have proof_onlineIndexSetupWithWork_value_129 := ⋯;
  let band :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedRepresentativeReadWithWork parent center (parent.hi - parent.lo) b P
      tau (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) child;
  let setup := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineIndexSetupWithWork H band.1;
  let G := setup.1;
  have accepted := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.reduceOnlineIntegerWithWork (G ^ 80) ⋯ integer;
  if hband : band.1 = [] then (none, band.2 + setup.2 + accepted.2 + 1)
  else
    have guard :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedUnskippedReadWithWorkRaw parent b P exponent tau
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat F) child initial center;
    if guard.1.isSome = true then
      have sampled :=
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedSampledOnlineReadWithWork center b initial table eta kappa band.1
          hband G (G ^ 80) t accepted.1;
      (some sampled.1, band.2 + setup.2 + accepted.2 + guard.2 + sampled.2 + 2)
    else (none, band.2 + setup.2 + accepted.2 + guard.2 + 1)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedOnlineReadAllocationRaw.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →

        (P : ℕ) →
          ℕ →
            ℕ →
              ℕ →
                (b : ℕ) →
                  0 < b →
                    0 < P →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →

                            (child initial :

                                    (∀ (i : Fin M) (q : Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length),

                                      (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℕ) →
                                        (Fin M → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℕ) →
                                          (ℕ → Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℕ) →
                                            ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length → ℕ → ℕ :=
fun {α} source target {M} parent P F exponent H b _hb _hP tau eta kappa child initial table R _hc _hi childAllocation
    initialAllocation tableAllocation t center integer =>
  have proof_arithmeticFlatMapWithWork_value_69 :=
    @Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coordinateVectorWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_arithmeticMapWithWork_value_70 := @Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coordinateVectorWithWork._proof_2;
  have proof_memberByWithWork_value_71 := @Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.coordinateVectorWithWork._proof_3;
  have proof_dedupByWithWork_value_72 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitWordValue_bits_15 := Chal.EditApproximation.queryFinOfNatWithWork._proof_19;
  have proof_bitOrdering_matches_4 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_matches_5 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitCompareWithWork_eq_3 := ⋯;
  have proof_binaryNaturalCompareWithWork_eq_73 := ⋯;
  have proof_naturalEqualWithWork_value_74 := ⋯;
  have proof_coordinateEqualWithWork_value_75 := ⋯;
  have proof_bandCoordinatesWithWork_value_68 := ⋯;
  have proof_bitAdder_value_1 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.onlineParametersWithWork._proof_1;
  have proof_bitAddWithWork_value_2 := ⋯;
  have proof_binaryNaturalAddWithWork_value_52 := ⋯;
  have proof_onlineIndexSetupWithWork_value_129 := ⋯;
  let band :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedRepresentativeReadWithWork parent center (parent.hi - parent.lo) b P
        tau (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) child).1;

    if hband : band = [] then 0

number of parameters: 2
constructors:
Chal.EditDistortion.Step.insert : ∀ {substitutions : Bool} {Alpha : Type u} (p q : List Alpha) (a : Alpha),
  Chal.EditDistortion.Step substitutions (p ++ q) (p ++ a :: q)
Chal.EditDistortion.Step.delete : ∀ {substitutions : Bool} {Alpha : Type u} (p q : List Alpha) (a : Alpha),
  Chal.EditDistortion.Step substitutions (p ++ a :: q) (p ++ q)

  substitutions = true →
    ∀ (p q : List Alpha) (a b : Alpha), Chal.EditDistortion.Step substitutions (p ++ a :: q) (p ++ b :: q)

    Chal.EditDistortion.Script substitutions n y z → Chal.EditDistortion.Script substitutions (n + 1) x z

                Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B d) →

def Chal.EditApproximation.groupScalarKeys : (M F Q : ℕ) →
  List (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) → List (Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q) :=

  List.flatMap

      List.flatMap

          List.map (fun sample => ⟨key, ⟨scale, sample⟩⟩)
            (List.finRange
              (Chal.EditApproximation.groupSampleCount M Q key.1
                (Chal.EditApproximation.groupDyadicScaleAt M key.1 (↑F) scale))))
        (List.finRange (Chal.EditApproximation.groupDyadicScales M key.1 ↑F).length))
    groups

  Fin.ofNat M ⌊Chal.EditApproximation.finiteAnswerTable keys values ⟨(b, cell), ⟨scale, sample⟩⟩⌋₊
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryGroupKeyEqualWithWork : {M F Q : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q → Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q → Bool × ℕ :=
fun {M F Q} a b =>
  have scale := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork a.fst.1 b.fst.1;
  have lo := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork a.fst.2.1 b.fst.2.1;
  have hi := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork a.fst.2.2 b.fst.2.2;
  have label := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork ↑a.snd.fst ↑b.snd.fst;
  have sample := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualWithWork ↑a.snd.snd ↑b.snd.snd;
  (scale.1 && lo.1 && hi.1 && label.1 && sample.1, scale.2 + lo.2 + hi.2 + label.2 + sample.2 + 4)
def Chal.EditApproximation.queryGroupKeyEqualAllocation : {M F Q : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q → Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q → ℕ :=
fun {M F Q} a b =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation a.fst.1 b.fst.1 +
            Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation a.fst.2.1 b.fst.2.1 +
          Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation a.fst.2.2 b.fst.2.2 +
        Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation ↑a.snd.fst ↑b.snd.fst +
      Chal.EditApproximation.naturalEqualAllocation ↑a.snd.snd ↑b.snd.snd +
    4
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeySamplesWithWork : (M F Q eM : ℕ) →
  ℕ → (eF : ℕ) → M = 2 ^ eM → F = 2 ^ eF → ℕ × ℕ → List (Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q) × ℕ :=
fun M F Q eM eb eF hM hF cell =>
  have proof_representation_value_32 := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.countedGroupMemberSourceWithWork._proof_7;

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.querySharedInputsWithWork : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  (M : ℕ) →
    ℕ →
      (F Q : ℕ) →
        ℕ →
          (eM eF : ℕ) →
            M = 2 ^ eM →
              F = 2 ^ eF →
                Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                        Chal.EditApproximation.CountedCellGroupDraws M F Q →
                          List (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M N F Q exponent eM eF hM hF parent a value query draw =>
  have scales := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryExponentsWithWork N F a value;
  have radius := value.naturalCeilingWithWork;
  have inputs :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
      (fun eb =>
        have side :=
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent).canonicalMulWithWork
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (2 ^ eb));
        have cells := side.1.targetCellsWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius.1) query;
        have states :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
            (fun cell =>
              Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.querySharedCellInputsWithWork M F Q eM eb eF hM hF parent exponent
                cell (draw (2 ^ eb) cell))
            cells.1;
        (states.1, side.2 + cells.2 + states.2 + eb + exponent + 4))
      scales.1;
  have sorted := Chal.EditApproximation.queryOrderedChildInputsWithWork inputs.1;
  (sorted.1, scales.2 + radius.2 + inputs.2 + sorted.2 + 3)

        have sources :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeySamplesWithWork M F Q eM eb eF hM hF) cells.1;
        (sources.1, side.2 + cells.2 + sources.2 + eb + exponent + 4))
      scales.1;
  (keys.1, scales.2 + radius.2 + keys.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupDrawReadAllocation : {M F Q : ℕ} →
  [NeZero M] →
    List (Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q) →
      List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
        (b : ℕ) →
          ℕ × ℕ →
            (scale : Fin (Chal.EditApproximation.groupDyadicScales M b ↑F).length) →
              Fin
                  (Chal.EditApproximation.groupSampleCount M Q b
                    (Chal.EditApproximation.groupDyadicScaleAt M b (↑F) scale)) →
                ℕ :=
fun {M F Q} [NeZero M] keys values b cell scale sample =>
  have key := ⟨(b, cell), ⟨scale, sample⟩⟩;
  have word :=
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gatheredWordLookupWithWork Chal.EditApproximation.queryGroupKeyEqualWithWork
        keys values key).1;
  have floor := word.naturalFloorWithWork.1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.gatheredLookupAllocation Chal.EditApproximation.queryGroupKeyEqualWithWork
        Chal.EditApproximation.queryGroupKeyEqualAllocation keys values key +
      word.naturalFloorAllocation +
    Chal.EditApproximation.bitDivModAllocation M.bits (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue floor).bits
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupSourceKeysAllocation : {n : ℕ} →
  (M : ℕ) →
    ℕ →
      (F : ℕ) →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            (eM eF : ℕ) →
              M = 2 ^ eM →
                F = 2 ^ eF →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → ℕ :=
fun {n} M N F Q exponent eM eF hM hF a value q =>
  have radius := value.naturalCeilingWithWork.1;
  have build := fun eb =>
    have side :=
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent).canonicalMulWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (2 ^ eb));
    have cells := side.1.targetCellsWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) q;
    have sources :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeySamplesWithWork M F Q eM eb eF hM hF) cells.1;
    (sources.1, side.2 + cells.2 + sources.2 + eb + exponent + 4);
  have allocation := fun eb =>
    have side :=
      ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent).canonicalMulWithWork
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (2 ^ eb))).1;
    have cells := (side.targetCellsWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) q).1;
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent).canonicalMulAllocation
                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (2 ^ eb)) +
              side.targetCellsAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) q +
            Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeySamplesWithWork M F Q eM eb eF hM hF)
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupKeySamplesAllocation M F Q eM eb eF hM hF) cells +
          eb +
        exponent +
      2;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryExponentsAllocation N F a value + value.naturalCeilingAllocation +
    Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation build allocation
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryExponentsWithWork N F a value).1
def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.querySharedInputsAllocation : {nx ny : ℕ} →
  (M : ℕ) →
    ℕ →
      (F Q : ℕ) →
        ℕ →
          (eM eF : ℕ) →
            M = 2 ^ eM →
              F = 2 ^ eF →
                Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                      Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                        Chal.EditApproximation.CountedCellGroupDraws M F Q →
                          Chal.EditApproximation.CountedCellGroupAllocations M F Q → ℕ :=
fun {nx ny} M N F Q exponent eM eF hM hF parent a value query draw allocation =>
  have scales := (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryExponentsWithWork N F a value).1;
  have radius := value.naturalCeilingWithWork.1;
  have build := fun eb =>
    have side :=
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent).canonicalMulWithWork
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (2 ^ eb));
    have cells := side.1.targetCellsWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) query;
    have states :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork
        (fun cell =>
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.querySharedCellInputsWithWork M F Q eM eb eF hM hF parent exponent cell
            (draw (2 ^ eb) cell))
        cells.1;
    (states.1, side.2 + cells.2 + states.2 + eb + exponent + 4);
  have alloc := fun eb =>
    have side :=
      ((Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent).canonicalMulWithWork
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (2 ^ eb))).1;
    have cells := (side.targetCellsWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) query).1;
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent).canonicalMulAllocation
                (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.nat (2 ^ eb)) +
              side.targetCellsAllocation (Chal.EditApproximation.bitWordValue radius) query +
            Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation
              (fun cell =>
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.querySharedCellInputsWithWork M F Q eM eb eF hM hF parent exponent
                  cell (draw (2 ^ eb) cell))
              (fun cell =>
                Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.querySharedCellInputsAllocation M F Q eM eb eF hM hF parent
                  exponent cell (draw (2 ^ eb) cell) (allocation (2 ^ eb) cell))
              cells +
          eb +
        exponent +
      2;
  have inputs := (Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapWithWork build scales).1;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryExponentsAllocation N F a value + value.naturalCeilingAllocation +
      Chal.EditApproximation.arithmeticFlatMapAllocation build alloc scales +
    Chal.EditApproximation.queryOrderedChildInputsAllocation inputs

    (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.cellCentersReadWithWork P F b a
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.inversePowerTwo exponent) parentInitial cell).1;

    (Chal.EditApproximation.filterMapWithWork

          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.preparedUnskippedReadAllocation parent center b P exponent tau

          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.indexedGroupScales raw M b

def Chal.EditApproximation.queryGroupSourceGather.{u_1, u_2} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  {β : Type u_2} →
    {n : ℕ} →
      (M : ℕ) →
        ℕ →
          (F Q : ℕ) →
            ℕ →
              (eM eF : ℕ) →
                M = 2 ^ eM →
                  F = 2 ^ eF →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                        Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
                          (Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q →
                              Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
                            (List (Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q) →
                                List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι β) →
                              Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι β :=
fun {ι} {β} {n} M N F Q exponent eM eF hM hF a initial q reader next =>
  have query := initial q;
  Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.charge query.2
    ((Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryGroupSourceKeysWithWork M N F Q exponent eM eF hM hF a query.1
            q)).bind
      fun keys => Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.collect reader keys (next keys))
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalScalarCodeWithWork : {M J N n exponent F Q R B : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalScalarKey M J N n exponent F Q R B → ℕ × ℕ :=
fun {M J N n exponent F Q R B} key =>
  match key with
  | ⟨Sum.inl online, time⟩ =>
    have entry := Chal.EditApproximation.physicalEntryCodeWithWork (↑online.1.1, online.1.2.2);
    have first := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalPairWithWork ↑↑online.2 ↑time;
    have second := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalPairWithWork (↑online.1.2.1) first.1;
    have last := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalPairWithWork entry.1 second.1;
    (2 * last.1, entry.2 + first.2 + second.2 + last.2 + 2)
  | ⟨Sum.inr group, index⟩ =>
    have node := Chal.EditApproximation.physicalNodeCodeWithWork ↑group.1;
    have a := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalPairWithWork ↑index.snd.fst ↑index.snd.snd;
    have b := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalPairWithWork (↑index.fst) a.1;
    have c := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalPairWithWork (↑group.2.2.2) b.1;
    have d := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalPairWithWork (↑group.2.2.1) c.1;
    have e := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalPairWithWork (↑group.2.1) d.1;
    have f := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalPairWithWork node.1 e.1;
    (2 * f.1 + 1, node.2 + a.2 + b.2 + c.2 + d.2 + e.2 + f.2 + 3)

@[reducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalGroupQueries : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Type :=

def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalScalarOnlineRead : (M J N n exponent F Q R B : ℕ) →
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalInternalNode M J →
    Fin R →
      ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n →
        ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalScalarKey M J N n exponent F Q R B) :=
fun M J N n exponent F Q R B node time key range =>
  if hb : key.1 ∈ Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScales N then
    if hr : 0 < range ∧ range ≤ B then
      Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.read
        ⟨Sum.inl
            ((node, Chal.EditApproximation.physicalScaleIndex N key.1 hb, key.2),
              Chal.EditApproximation.positiveDrawRangeOfLE B range ⋯ ⋯),
          time⟩
        Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
    else Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done 0
  else Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done 0

@[reducible] def Chal.EditApproximation.BitPhysicalGroupQueries : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Type :=

fun {ι} {α} source target {M} parent N P F exponent H Q tau a eta kappa delta t parentInitial child initial draw integer
    q readEarlier readCurrent =>
  have proof_mixedRadix_injective_84 := @Chal.EditApproximation.localRefinementStepQuery._proof_5;
  have proof_childInputCode_injective_83 := ⋯;
  have proof_historyInputCode_injective_82 := ⋯;
  have earlierKeys :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.orderedInputs Chal.EditApproximation.historyInputCode ⋯
      (Chal.EditApproximation.queryEarlierInputCover parent N P F exponent t a parentInitial q);
  Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.collect readEarlier earlierKeys fun earlierAnswers =>
    have earlier := fun i s r => Chal.EditApproximation.finiteAnswerTable earlierKeys earlierAnswers (i, s, r);
    have online :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.localOnlineCandidates source target parent N P F exponent H tau a eta kappa parentInitial
        child initial earlier (t - 1) integer q;
    have sharedKeys :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.orderedInputs Chal.EditApproximation.childInputCode ⋯
        (Chal.EditApproximation.querySharedInputCover source target parent N F exponent Q a parentInitial q draw);
    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.collect readCurrent sharedKeys fun sharedAnswers =>
      have current := fun i r => Chal.EditApproximation.finiteAnswerTable sharedKeys sharedAnswers (i, r);
      have selected :=
        Chal.EditApproximation.localCellGroupActions source target parent N P F exponent Q tau a parentInitial child
          initial current draw q;
      have needed :=
        Chal.EditApproximation.actionCurrentInputCover selected ∪ Chal.EditApproximation.actionCurrentInputCover online;
      have currentKeys := Chal.EditApproximation.orderedInputs Chal.EditApproximation.childInputCode ⋯ needed;
      Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.collect readCurrent currentKeys fun currentAnswers =>
        have value :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.rationalActionValue (fun q r => ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.targetEndpointDistance q r))
            (128 * ↑F) (Chal.EditApproximation.finiteAnswerTable currentKeys currentAnswers) q;
        have fallback :=
          Chal.EditApproximation.rationalBellman parentInitial
            (fun q r => ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.targetEndpointDistance q r)) (128 * ↑F)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalActualWideActions parent
              (Chal.EditApproximation.localRefinementRepresentatives N P F a parentInitial q) P)
            (fun input => earlier input.1 (t - 1) input.2) q;
        Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done
          (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalRefinementUpdate delta
            (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalMinimum fallback (List.map value selected))
            (Chal.EditApproximation.rationalOnlineMinimum (List.map value online)))

def Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryRefinementFinishWithWork : {nx ny M : ℕ} →

    ℕ →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ) →
                ℕ →
                  List (Fin M × ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →

                      List
                          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryBellmanAction (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny)

                          List (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny) →

                              Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction × ℕ :=
fun {nx ny M} parent N P F a delta initial t earlierKeys earlierWords groups online currentKeys currentWords query =>
  have fallback := initial query;
  have representatives := Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localRepresentativeReadWithWork N P F a initial query;
  have result :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.physicalContinuationReadWithWork parent representatives.1 P F delta fallback.1
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryHistoryReadWithWork earlierKeys earlierWords (t - 1))
      (fun input =>
        Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryChildReadWithWork currentKeys currentWords input.1 input.2)
      groups online query;
  (result.1, fallback.2 + representatives.2 + result.2 + 2)

def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalScalarCode : {M J N n exponent F Q R B : ℕ} →
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalScalarKey M J N n exponent F Q R B → ℕ :=
fun {M J N n exponent F Q R B} key =>
  match key with
  | ⟨Sum.inl online, time⟩ =>
    2 *
      Nat.pair (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalEntryCode (↑online.1.1, online.1.2.2))
        (Nat.pair (↑online.1.2.1) (Nat.pair ↑↑online.2 ↑time))
  | ⟨Sum.inr group, index⟩ =>
    2 *
        Nat.pair (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalNodeCode ↑group.1)
          (Nat.pair (↑group.2.1)
            (Nat.pair (↑group.2.2.1)
              (Nat.pair (↑group.2.2.2) (Nat.pair (↑index.fst) (Nat.pair ↑index.snd.fst ↑index.snd.snd))))) +
      1
def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalScalarGroupQueries : (M J N n exponent F Q R B : ℕ) →
  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalInternalNode M J →
    Fin R → (b : ℕ) → ℕ × ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalGroupQueries M J N n exponent F Q R B b :=
fun M J N n exponent F Q R B node time b cell =>
  have proof_physicalScaleIndex_get_93 := Chal.EditApproximation.physicalScalarGroupQueries._proof_1;
  if hb : b ∈ Chal.EditApproximation.dyadicScales N then
    if hc : cell.1 ≤ n * 2 ^ exponent ∧ cell.2 ≤ n * 2 ^ exponent then
      let key := (node, Chal.EditApproximation.physicalScaleIndex N b hb, ⟨cell.1, ⋯⟩, ⟨cell.2, ⋯⟩);
      ⋯.mp (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalScalarGroupQueriesAt M J N n exponent F Q R B key time)
    else fun x x_1 => Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done 0
  else fun x x_1 => Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done 0

  Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalInternalNode M J →
    Fin R →
      Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q →
        Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalScalarKey M J N n exponent F Q R B) :=
fun M J N n exponent F Q R B node time key =>
  Chal.EditApproximation.physicalScalarGroupQueries M J N n exponent F Q R B node time key.fst.1 key.fst.2 key.snd.fst
    key.snd.snd

def Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.entryCapacity : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ :=

  ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest M J n → ℕ :=
fun {M J n} copies T S request =>
  request.index +
    (T + S + 1) *
      (request.copy +
        copies *
          (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalEntryCode (request.node, request.state) +
            Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.entryCapacity M J n * request.pass))

def Chal.EditApproximation.chargedRandomGlobalQuery.{u_1, u_2} : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {α : Type u_2} →
    [DecidableEq α] →
      {M J R : ℕ} →
        [NeZero M] →
          [NeZero R] →
            List α →
              (target : List α) →
                ℕ →
                  ℕ →
                    (F : ℕ) →
                      ℕ →
                        ℕ →
                          (Q T S passes copies : ℕ) →
                            (ℕ → ℚ) →
                              (ℕ → ℕ) →
                                ℚ →
                                  ℚ →
                                    ℚ →
                                      ℚ →
                                        (ℕ →
                                            ℕ →
                                              Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalInternalNode M J →
                                                Fin R →
                                                  Chal.EditApproximation.GroupScalarKey M F Q →
                                                    Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery σ) →
                                          (ℕ →
                                              ℕ →
                                                Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalInternalNode M J →
                                                  Fin R →
                                                    ℕ × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval target.length →
                                                      ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery σ) →
                                            (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J target.length → ℕ) →
                                              (request :
                                                  Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest M J target.length passes
                                                    copies T S) →
                                                Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery
                                                  (σ ⊕ { child // child.rank < request.rank }) :=
fun {σ} {α} [DecidableEq α] {M J R} [NeZero M] [NeZero R] source target N P F exponent H Q T S passes copies factor
    multiplier tau eta kappa delta readGroup readInteger initial request =>
  have proof_table_rank_lt_99 := @Chal.EditApproximation.chargedPreviousRead._proof_1;
  match request with
  | Sum.inl entry => Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.done ↑(initial entry)
  | Sum.inr parent =>
    if (↑parent).index ≤ T then
      Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.mapKeys Sum.inr
        (Chal.EditApproximation.chargedWarmupQuery source target N P F factor multiplier parent)
    else
      if ↑(↑parent).node.fst < J then
        if
            (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalSourceInterval source.length (↑parent).node).hi -
                (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalSourceInterval source.length (↑parent).node).lo ≤
              1 then
          Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.mapKeys Sum.inr
            (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalInitialQuery source target N P F (factor (↑parent).pass)
              (Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSeedQuery N multiplier parent) ((↑parent).node, (↑parent).state))
        else
          Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.mapKeys (Sum.map id fun child => ⟨Sum.inr ↑child, ⋯⟩)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalRandomBoundedQuery source target N P F exponent H Q T S passes copies factor
              multiplier tau eta kappa delta readGroup readInteger initial parent)
      else
        Chal.EditApproximation.FiniteQuery.mapKeys Sum.inr
          (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalInitialQuery source target N P F (factor (↑parent).pass)
            (Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSeedQuery N multiplier parent) ((↑parent).node, (↑parent).state))

      (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedPassCount N) (Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N ^ 2))
    Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest.code
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseInitialCandidate.{u} : {α : Type u} →
  [DecidableEq α] →
    (B D : ℕ) →
      ℚ →
        ℚ →
          (x y : List α) →
            Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseGuessIndex (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseEntryWidth x y) →
              Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B D → ℚ :=
fun {α} [DecidableEq α] B D Q lam x y i draws =>
  have k := Chal.EditApproximation.coarseGuess (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseEntryWidth x y) i;
  2 *
    (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseThresholdEstimate k Q lam
        (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseTargetFrame k
          (Chal.EditApproximation.coarsePadTo (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseEntryWidth x y) y))
        (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseEntryTree B D x y) draws (↑k) 0 (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseRootShift k) +
      ↑k)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseInitialMinimum.{u} : {α : Type u} →
  [DecidableEq α] →
    (B D : ℕ) →
      ℚ →
        ℚ →
          (x y : List α) →
            (Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseGuessIndex (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseEntryWidth x y) →

              ℚ :=
fun {α} [DecidableEq α] B D Q lam x y draws =>
  Finset.univ.inf' ⋯ fun i => Chal.EditApproximation.coarseInitialCandidate B D Q lam x y i (draws i)
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseInitialValue.{u} : {α : Type u} →
  [DecidableEq α] →
    (B D : ℕ) →
      ℚ →
        ℚ →
          ℕ →
            (x y : List α) →
              (Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseGuessIndex (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseEntryWidth x y) →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B D) →
                ℕ :=
fun {α} [DecidableEq α] B D Q lam N x y draws =>
  if 2 * x.length < y.length then min N y.length
  else if x = y then 0 else min N ⌈Chal.EditApproximation.coarseInitialMinimum B D Q lam x y draws⌉₊
def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseActiveArrayWork.{u} : {B : ℕ} →

    (Chal.EditApproximation.coarseActiveArrayWork._f k Q lam) x_1 x_2 x_3

def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseInitialArrayWork.{u} : {α : Type u} →
  [DecidableEq α] →
    (B D : ℕ) →
      ℚ →
        ℚ →
          (x y : List α) →

                Chal.EditApproximation.CoarseThresholdDraws B D) →
              ℕ :=

  if 2 * x.length < y.length then 0

def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalFamilyCodeWithWork.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {M J R : ℕ} →
    (target : List α) →
      (N P F exponent H Q passes copies : ℕ) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalFamilyScalarKey target N P F exponent H Q passes copies → ℕ × ℕ :=

  have copy := Chal.EditApproximation.naturalPairWithWork (↑key.2.1) scalar.1;

  (pass.1, scalar.2 + copy.2 + pass.2 + 2)
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedFamilyMemoCodeWithWork : (source target : List ℕ) →
  (N R : ℕ) →
    Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFamilyScalarKey source target N R ⊕
        Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFamilyTableKey source target N →
      ℕ × ℕ :=
fun source target N R x =>
  match x with
  | Sum.inl key =>
    have result :=
      Chal.EditApproximation.physicalFamilyCodeWithWork target N (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).P
        (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N) (40 * Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N)

        (Chal.EditApproximation.computedSeedPassCount N) (Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N ^ 2) key;
    (2 * result.1, result.2 + 2)
  | Sum.inr key =>
    have result := Chal.EditApproximation.chargedPhysicalCodeWithWork key;
    (2 * result.1 + 1, result.2 + 3)

def Chal.EditApproximation.queryWarmupProgram.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  {nx ny M : ℕ} →
    Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval nx →
      ℕ →
        ℕ →
          ℕ →
            Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction →
              (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
                (Fin M × Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →
                  Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval ny →
                    Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction :=
fun {ι} {nx ny M} parent N P F a initialRead childRead q =>
  (initialRead q).bind fun value =>
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryRawCentersWithWork N P F a value q)).bind
      fun centers =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.collect initialRead centers fun words =>
        have initial := value.queryOverrideParentReadWithWork q centers words;
        (Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryWarmupInputsWithWork M parent N P F a initial q)).bind
          fun inputs =>
          Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.collect childRead inputs fun childWords =>
            Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute
              (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.localWarmupReadKernelWithWork parent N P F a initial
                (fun input =>
                  Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryChildReadWithWork inputs childWords input.1 input.2)
                q)

def Chal.EditApproximation.coarseIndexedEntryCostSum : {M J B : ℕ} →
  [NeZero B] →
    (source target : List ℕ) →
      ℕ →
        (depth : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J target.length → ℕ) →
          Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalCoarseDraw source target B depth →
            (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J target.length → Prop) → ℝ :=
fun {M J B} [NeZero B] source target N depth draw selected =>
  ∑ entry,
    Chal.EditApproximation.selectionIndicator (selected entry) *
      ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.coarseIndexedEntryBinaryCost N B (depth entry)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalSource source entry.1)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.substring target entry.2.lo entry.2.hi) (draw entry))
def Chal.EditApproximation.querySupportedChildAllocation.{u_1} : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {M J n : ℕ} →
    (passes copies T S : ℕ) →
      (parent : { r // Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalTableRequest.Bounded passes copies T S r }) →
        Chal.EditApproximation.QueryPhysicalChild passes copies T S parent → ℕ :=
fun {σ} {M J n} passes copies T S parent key =>
  match key with
  | Sum.inl val => 0
  | Sum.inr child => Chal.EditApproximation.queryPhysicalBoundedAllocation passes copies T S ↑child
def Chal.EditApproximation.rejectionFailureLaw.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  (range : ι → ℕ) → [∀ (i : ι), NeZero (range i)] → ι → MeasureTheory.Measure ℕ :=
fun {ι} range [∀ (i : ι), NeZero (range i)] i =>
  have proof_rejectionWord_range_124 := Chal.EditApproximation.rejectionFailureLaw._proof_1;
  ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure
    (Chal.EditApproximation.rejectionSuccessParameter (range i) (2 ^ Chal.EditApproximation.rejectionBitCount (range i))
      ⋯ ⋯)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rejectionRuntimeArrayLaw.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  [Fintype ι] →
    (range : ι → ℕ) →
      [∀ (i : ι), NeZero (range i)] → MeasureTheory.Measure (Chal.EditApproximation.RejectionRuntimeArray range) :=
fun {ι} [Fintype ι] range [∀ (i : ι), NeZero (range i)] =>
  (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi (Chal.EditApproximation.rejectionFailureLaw range)).prod
    (Chal.EditApproximation.rejectionAcceptedLaw range)
def Chal.EditApproximation.rejectionSelectedBits.{u_1} : {ι : Type u_1} →
  [Fintype ι] →
    (range : ι → ℕ) → (ι → ((i : ι) → Fin (range i)) → Prop) → Chal.EditApproximation.RejectionRuntimeArray range → ℝ :=
fun {ι} [Fintype ι] range selected execution =>
  ∑ i,
    (↑(execution.1 i) + 1) * ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.rejectionBitCount (range i)) *
      Chal.EditApproximation.selectionIndicator (selected i execution.2)

    (Chal.EditApproximation.localOnlineMassBound M P H) key.2.2

def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalLargeInput : ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Prop :=
fun N epsilon =>
  (Chal.EditApproximation.inspectAccuracyWithWork (Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N) epsilon).1.isSome = true ∧
    Chal.EditApproximation.largeAccuracyInput N epsilon.value ∧
      (Chal.EditApproximation.localOnlineMassBound (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).M
            (Chal.EditApproximation.integerParameters N).P (Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N)).size ≤
        Chal.EditApproximation.inputHeight N

def Chal.EditApproximation.physicalFamilyMemoCoarseWork.{u_1} : {α : Type u_1} →
  [DecidableEq α] →
    {M J R : ℕ} →
      [NeZero M] →
        [NeZero R] →
          (source target : List α) →
            (N P H T S passes copies : ℕ) →
              (ℕ → ℚ) →
                (ℕ → ℕ) →
                  ℚ →
                    ℚ →
                      ℚ →
                        ℚ →
                          Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalFamilyScalarDraw target N P
                              (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N) (40 * Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N)
                              H (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N ^ 80) passes copies →
                            (B : ℕ) →
                              (depth : Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalEntry M J target.length → ℕ) →
                                ℕ →
                                  (Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalFamilyScalarKey target N P
                                          (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N)
                                          (40 * Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N) H
                                          (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N ^ 80) passes copies ⊕
                                        Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest M J target.length (passes + 1)
                                          copies T S →
                                      ℕ) →
                                    Chal.EditApproximation.ChargedPhysicalRequest M J target.length (passes + 1) copies
                                        T S →
                                      Chal.EditApproximation.PhysicalCoarseDraw source target B depth → ℝ :=
fun {α} [DecidableEq α] {M J R} [NeZero M] [NeZero R] source target N P H T S passes copies factor multiplier tau eta
    kappa delta draw B depth bits encode root coarse =>
  have initial :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.clampedSeedNat
      (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalCoarseSeedTable source target N B depth coarse);
  have result :=
    Chal.EditApproximation.chargedRandomMemoEvaluate source target N P (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N)
      (40 * Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N) H (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N ^ 80) T S (passes + 1)
      copies factor multiplier tau eta kappa delta
      (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalFamilyGroupRead target N P (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N)
        (40 * Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N) H (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N ^ 80) passes copies)
      (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalFamilyOnlineRead target N P (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N)
        (40 * Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N) H (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N ^ 80) passes copies)
      initial
      (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalFamilyAnswer target N P (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N)
        (40 * Chal.EditApproximation.smallLogExponent N) H (Chal.EditApproximation.inputSmallLog N ^ 80) passes copies
        draw)
      bits encode root;
  ∑ entry,
    Chal.EditApproximation.selectionIndicator (Sum.inr (Sum.inl entry) ∈ result.freshKeys) *
      ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.coarseInitialArrayWork B (depth entry) (Chal.EditApproximation.initialThresholdQ N)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.initialLambda N) (Chal.EditApproximation.physicalSource source entry.1)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.substring target entry.2.lo entry.2.hi) (coarse entry))

  Chal.EditApproximation.computedExecutionIndexedCoarseWork source target N execution +
        Chal.EditApproximation.computedExecutionCoarseSamplingWork source target N execution +

def Chal.EditApproximation.computedExecutionTotalWork : (source target : List ℕ) →
  (N : ℕ) →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFamilyInput source target N →
        Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFamilyMemoKey source target N → ℕ) →
      Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedExecutionOutcome source target N → ℝ :=

  Chal.EditApproximation.computedExecutionReadChargedWork source target N execution +
    Chal.EditApproximation.computedExecutionKernelWork source target N cost execution
def Chal.EditApproximation.computedFullOutputWork : (source target : List ℕ) →
  (N : ℕ) →
    (Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFamilyInput source target N →
        Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFamilyMemoKey source target N → ℕ) →
      ℝ →
        ℕ →
          (Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFamilyInput source target N → ℕ) →
            ℕ → Chal.EditApproximation.ComputedFullOutcome source target N → ℝ :=
fun source target N cost setup shared output fallbackOutput x =>
  match x with
  | Sum.inl val => setup + ↑(Chal.EditApproximation.chargedSuffixDP source target).2 + ↑fallbackOutput
  | Sum.inr execution =>
    setup + ↑shared + Chal.EditApproximation.computedExecutionTotalWork source target N cost execution +
      ↑(output (Chal.EditApproximation.computedExecutionAccepted source target N execution))

def Chal.EditApproximation.queryInitialGatherFootprint.{u_1, u_2} : {ι : Type u_1} →

    {n : ℕ} →
      (N P F exponent : ℕ) →
        (hP : 0 < P) →
          (a : Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →

                    Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) →

                  (next :
                      List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n) →
                        List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction → Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery ι β) →
                    ((keys : List (Chal.EditApproximation.TargetInterval n)) →
                        (words : List Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction) → (next keys words).Footprint) →
                      (Chal.EditApproximation.queryInitialGather N P F exponent hP a q reader next).Footprint :=

  (hr q).bind
    (fun value =>
      (Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.compute
            (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryInitialSupportWithWork N P F exponent hP a value q)).bind
        fun keys => Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.collect reader keys (next keys))
    fun value =>
    (Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.Footprint.computeOf
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryInitialSupportWithWork N P F exponent hP a value q)
          (Chal.EditApproximation.BinaryFraction.queryInitialSupportAllocation N P F exponent hP a value q)).bind
      (fun keys => Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.collect reader keys (next keys)) fun keys =>
      Chal.EditApproximation.BitQuery.Footprint.collect reader hr keys (next keys) (hn keys)
